Preserve ApplicationRevision’s recovered composite key. journey(application_id, application_revision) references application_revision(application_id, revision); no new application-revision UUID is introduced. Local AEAD AAD includes immutable object ID, object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version. Deployment KMS context, if ever authorized, contains non-sensitive constant service/payload-class/version labels only.
Field envelopes do not encrypt every metadata column, foreign key or index. Deployment preparation separately requires authenticated TLS for browser/API and application/database links, encrypted database volumes and backups, key separation, authorized restore and application/proxy/error-log redaction. Local loopback tests prove none of those deployment controls. No configuration/security mutation is authorized here.
An ephemeral in-memory teaching key supports only its declared process lifetime. In-process round-trip, application restart, database restart and restored-backup recovery are separate experiments. Cross-process encrypted recovery is BLOCKED until an approved retained teaching-key mechanism is prepared and verified. A lost key returns KEY_UNAVAILABLE and retains ciphertext; it is never interpreted as empty data or a passing restore. Persist a pending operation/provider reference before any external mock call. If recording a provider result rolls back, retain the prior pending/unknown reference for reconciliation; do not claim a FAILED audit row survived rollback.

### Planned shared frontend foundation

Planned frontend convention: the instructor-supplied SPA shell uses TanStack React Query for server state, shared parameterized UI primitives and compositions, Tailwind design tokens and an Inter/system-ui font stack. This replaces repeated bespoke view blocks while preserving CoverStory’s warm paper surfaces, category accents, accessible controls, responsive spacing and light/dark behavior. Query cache is not form or navigation state. Keep unsubmitted input and device-local public selections in their appropriate bounded state. Use typed, versioned query keys containing the relevant public catalog revision or authenticated owner/session generation. A fresh SPA load authenticates, then refetches /api/v1/me/journeys and validates current allowed actions; this is refresh/resume, not an SSR hydration claim. Cancel and clear private queries on logout/account change and ignore late prior-session responses. Do not persist sensitive query data in browser storage. Mutation completion invalidates or updates only the affected owned query/version after authoritative server success; a click, optimistic animation or analytics receipt cannot establish paid/submitted state. ### Fixed scope, architecture and privacy

Proposed React → Spring API → owning Catalog/Shortlist/Application/Payments/Policy/Support public module interface → one PostgreSQL. No cross-module repository access. No runtime broker, Redis cache or second database. Additional technology requires a product need/measured bottleneck, alternatives, failure/cost analysis and linked ADR.
Health-first discovery with health/term/motor/ULIP entry links. Anonymous browse, compare 1–3 unique same-category and matching-scenario versions, and device-local save/export need no phone, OTP or marketing gate. Keep Unknown as Unknown, critical restrictions expanded, source version/date/evidence label visible. Login is required only for owned objects and mock purchase. Catalog editor, Applicant, assigned Support and sandbox simulator are distinct actors.
All new money uses currency INR and integer minor units. SYNTHETIC fixture quotes exercise contracts only. Captured illustrations, base tariffs and historical rates are SOURCE_EVIDENCE, not accepted payable quotes. Unknown tax/total or unsupported scenario blocks payable review. Every changed amount, terms, quote/configuration or revision requires explicit review/acceptance, including changes at or below 100 paise. The >100-paise threshold adds escalation, never permits silent acceptance.
Mock Juspay and simulated insurer only; no real PII, payments, refunds, policy sales, cloud resources or insurer dispatch. Payment confirmation unlocks one owned ONBOARDING application; it does not submit a proposal or create active cover. Explicit final submit after complete fields/disclosures, confirmed corrections, current exact revision/quote/options/terms acceptance and fully reconciled payments produces SUBMISSION_PENDING. Only retained simulated external-dispatch reference evidence can produce SUBMITTED. Policy issuance and active-cover evidence remain separate later states.
Proposed canonical API /api/v1 and noun catalog; no route, package or alias is claimed implemented. Later recovered /api/... routes are documented legacy aliases only pending explicit adapter tests; unversioned /applications, /orders, /quote-validations, /me routes normalize under /api/v1. Historical /api/catalogue/options maps to proposed /api/v1/catalog/options. Historical correlationId maps to requestId in safe errors {code, message, fieldErrors, requestId, retryable}. Old /api/events, /api/pipelines and operator-v1 are historical generic contracts, NOT automatic aliases. Schemas get separate typed adapters and fixtures, never enum renames.
Use trusted actor + operation + resource + key and canonical payload hash. Same key/hash replays stored result; different payload conflicts. A proposed 7-day sandbox response cache does not bound durable resource-effect uniqueness; effect records and reconciliation evidence must survive the applicable retry/retention window. Real legal/provider retention remains a launch gate. UNKNOWN money or dispatch outcomes require same-reference reconciliation before another effect.

### Proposed journey, audit, analytics and encryption foundations

New user-required foundations are proposed instructor scaffolds, not implemented integrations. Anonymous comparison and device-local save remain open; private journey resume requires an authenticated owner. journey.id is a UUID identifier, never an access credential. Journey stores a server-maintained navigation projection and references exact owned domain records, including ApplicationRevision; it does not duplicate plaintext or encrypted application answers. GET /api/v1/me/journeys returns minimal owner-bound homepage summaries with limit 1–50 and a safe cursor. Browser-supplied steps never establish paid, submitted or issued state.
A validated domain transition, required transaction_audit_event, journey projection update and journey_step_event commit atomically in one PostgreSQL unit of work through public module interfaces. Audit refers to existing orders, attempts, journal effects, adjustments and submission records; it is not a second money ledger. Keep initiated, pending, failed, unknown, reconciled and succeeded observations append-only, with operation/provider references and server-derived integer amounts where applicable. Corrections append; they never erase an earlier observation. No raw provider payload, form values, credentials or free-text exception is copied into audit.
Consumer payloads reside in protected_payload_envelope referenced by their owning domain revision. The instructor must supply and verify a maintained authenticated-encryption adapter before the first private write. Proposed AES-256-GCM uses a 12-byte nonce, 128-bit tag, separate wrapped DEK and KEK reference, unique nonce per encryption under a key, and object/revision/payload-kind/schema-version AAD. Authorization occurs before decrypt. Malformed/tampered envelope, wrong object binding or missing key fails closed with zero plaintext fallback. Keys never enter the repository, browser, database as plaintext, logs or telemetry. Fixed keys/nonces are isolated test-vector fixtures only; no real KMS/key/grant creation is authorized.
PAGE_VIEW and CONTROL_CLICK analytics are separate best-effort observations. POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most 10 events within 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Use versioned page/step/target allowlists and no arbitrary properties, form values, health answers, amounts, contact data, secrets, raw URLs/queries/referrers or DOM text. Validate ownership before linking a journey. Client time/order is untrusted; store server_received_at separately and never use analytics to advance journey or financial state. Policy-disallowed clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals receive DISCARDED_BY_POLICY without payload persistence. 202 receipts mean RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY only; changed payload under the same event UUID is 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT. Invalid 400, oversized 413 and rate-limited 429 are safe. Browser queue maximum 20 and retries maximum 3 may drop telemetry; checkout, save and resume remain independent. No third-party analytics destination is introduced.
Retention windows remain configurable synthetic teaching values, not legal policy. Keep audit/backup/key recovery references under reviewed holds; the encryption/key-rotation/deletion plan cannot silently destroy required history. All implementation, prerequisite, encryption, privacy and timebox evidence remains NOT_RUN/BLOCKED.

Instructor must deliberately configure the six-module bootstrap, public interfaces and private persistence; add a test rejecting a forbidden cross-module repository import and a dependency cycle. JdbcEventDatabase is only a generic transaction harness and contains no insurance logic.

### Fixed scope, architecture and privacy

Proposed React → Spring API → owning Catalog/Shortlist/Application/Payments/Policy/Support public module interface → one PostgreSQL. No cross-module repository access. No runtime broker, Redis cache or second database. Additional technology requires a product need/measured bottleneck, alternatives, failure/cost analysis and linked ADR.
Health-first discovery with health/term/motor/ULIP entry links. Anonymous browse, compare 1–3 unique same-category and matching-scenario versions, and device-local save/export need no phone, OTP or marketing gate. Keep Unknown as Unknown, critical restrictions expanded, source version/date/evidence label visible. Login is required only for owned objects and mock purchase. Catalog editor, Applicant, assigned Support and sandbox simulator are distinct actors.
All new money uses currency INR and integer minor units. SYNTHETIC fixture quotes exercise contracts only. Captured illustrations, base tariffs and historical rates are SOURCE_EVIDENCE, not accepted payable quotes. Unknown tax/total or unsupported scenario blocks payable review. Every changed amount, terms, quote/configuration or revision requires explicit review/acceptance, including changes at or below 100 paise. The >100-paise threshold adds escalation, never permits silent acceptance.
Mock Juspay and simulated insurer only; no real PII, payments, refunds, policy sales, cloud resources or insurer dispatch. Payment confirmation unlocks one owned ONBOARDING application; it does not submit a proposal or create active cover. Explicit final submit after complete fields/disclosures, confirmed corrections, current exact revision/quote/options/terms acceptance and fully reconciled payments produces SUBMISSION_PENDING. Only retained simulated external-dispatch reference evidence can produce SUBMITTED. Policy issuance and active-cover evidence remain separate later states.
Proposed canonical API /api/v1 and noun catalog; no route, package or alias is claimed implemented. Later recovered /api/... routes are documented legacy aliases only pending explicit adapter tests; unversioned /applications, /orders, /quote-validations, /me routes normalize under /api/v1. Historical /api/catalogue/options maps to proposed /api/v1/catalog/options. Historical correlationId maps to requestId in safe errors {code, message, fieldErrors, requestId, retryable}. Use trusted actor + operation + resource + key and canonical payload hash. Same key/hash replays stored result; different payload conflicts. A proposed 7-day sandbox response cache does not bound durable resource-effect uniqueness; effect records and reconciliation evidence must survive the applicable retry/retention window. Real legal/provider retention remains a launch gate. UNKNOWN money or dispatch outcomes require same-reference reconciliation before another effect.

### Proposed journey, audit, analytics and encryption foundations

New user-required foundations are proposed instructor scaffolds, not implemented integrations. Anonymous comparison and device-local save remain open; private journey resume requires an authenticated owner. journey.id is a UUID identifier, never an access credential. Journey stores a server-maintained navigation projection and references exact owned domain records, including ApplicationRevision; it does not duplicate plaintext or encrypted application answers. GET /api/v1/me/journeys returns minimal owner-bound homepage summaries with limit 1–50 and a safe cursor. Browser-supplied steps never establish paid, submitted or issued state.
A validated domain transition, required transaction_audit_event, journey projection update and journey_step_event commit atomically in one PostgreSQL unit of work through public module interfaces. Audit refers to existing orders, attempts, journal effects, adjustments and submission records; it is not a second money ledger. Keep initiated, pending, failed, unknown, reconciled and succeeded observations append-only, with operation/provider references and server-derived integer amounts where applicable. Corrections append; they never erase an earlier observation. No raw provider payload, form values, credentials or free-text exception is copied into audit.
Consumer payloads reside in protected_payload_envelope referenced by their owning domain revision. The instructor must supply and verify a maintained authenticated-encryption adapter before the first private write. Proposed AES-256-GCM uses a 12-byte nonce, 128-bit tag, separate wrapped DEK and KEK reference, unique nonce per encryption under a key, and object/revision/payload-kind/schema-version AAD. Authorization occurs before decrypt. Malformed/tampered envelope, wrong object binding or missing key fails closed with zero plaintext fallback. Keys never enter the repository, browser, database as plaintext, logs or telemetry. Fixed keys/nonces are isolated test-vector fixtures only; no real KMS/key/grant creation is authorized.

BLOCKED / NOT_READY_FOR_LEARNER. This is a proposed instructor contract, not installed scaffolding, runnable acceptance proof or learner completion. Instructor must reconcile actual code paths/signatures, pin compatible versions, supply starter TODOs and mutually satisfiable fixtures, repair existing SQL boundary/seeded-map/smoke-501 oracle defects, run setup independent of TODO success, prove a known defect fails and correct behavior passes privately, then rehearse the whole 95-minute task with actual timing. The audited baseline currently exposes Spring /health with scanning limited to capstone.app, and React is in fixture mode. Instructor must deliberately configure the six-module bootstrap, public interfaces and private persistence; add a test rejecting a forbidden cross-module repository import and a dependency cycle. JdbcEventDatabase is only a generic transaction harness and contains no insurance logic.

### Fixed scope, architecture and privacy

Proposed React → Spring API → owning Catalog/Shortlist/Application/Payments/Policy/Support public module interface → one PostgreSQL. No cross-module repository access. No runtime broker, Redis cache or second database. Additional technology requires a product need/measured bottleneck, alternatives, failure/cost analysis and linked ADR.
Health-first discovery with health/term/motor/ULIP entry links. Anonymous browse, compare 1–3 unique same-category and matching-scenario versions, and device-local save/export need no phone, OTP or marketing gate. Keep Unknown as Unknown, critical restrictions expanded, source version/date/evidence label visible. Login is required only for owned objects and mock purchase. Catalog editor, Applicant, assigned Support and sandbox simulator are distinct actors.
All new money uses currency INR and integer minor units. SYNTHETIC fixture quotes exercise contracts only. Captured illustrations, base tariffs and historical rates are SOURCE_EVIDENCE, not accepted payable quotes. Unknown tax/total or unsupported scenario blocks payable review. Every changed amount, terms, quote/configuration or revision requires explicit review/acceptance, including changes at or below 100 paise. The >100-paise threshold adds escalation, never permits silent acceptance.
Mock Juspay and simulated insurer only; no real PII, payments, refunds, policy sales, cloud resources or insurer dispatch. Payment confirmation unlocks one owned ONBOARDING application; it does not submit a proposal or create active cover. Explicit final submit after complete fields/disclosures, confirmed corrections, current exact revision/quote/options/terms acceptance and fully reconciled payments produces SUBMISSION_PENDING. Only retained simulated external-dispatch reference evidence can produce SUBMITTED. Policy issuance and active-cover evidence remain separate later states.
Proposed canonical API /api/v1 and noun catalog; no route, package or alias is claimed implemented. Later recovered /api/... routes are documented legacy aliases only pending explicit adapter tests; unversioned /applications, /orders, /quote-validations, /me routes normalize under /api/v1. Historical /api/catalogue/options maps to proposed /api/v1/catalog/options. Historical correlationId maps to requestId in safe errors {code, message, fieldErrors, requestId, retryable}. Old /api/events, /api/pipelines and operator-v1 are historical generic contracts, NOT automatic aliases. Schemas get separate typed adapters and fixtures, never enum renames.
Use trusted actor + operation + resource + key and canonical payload hash. Same key/hash replays stored result; different payload conflicts. A proposed 7-day sandbox response cache does not bound durable resource-effect uniqueness; effect records and reconciliation evidence must survive the applicable retry/retention window. Real legal/provider retention remains a launch gate. UNKNOWN money or dispatch outcomes require same-reference reconciliation before another effect.

### Proposed journey, audit, analytics and encryption foundations

New user-required foundations are proposed instructor scaffolds, not implemented integrations. Anonymous comparison and device-local save remain open; private journey resume requires an authenticated owner. journey.id is a UUID identifier, never an access credential. Journey stores a server-maintained navigation projection and references exact owned domain records, including ApplicationRevision; it does not duplicate plaintext or encrypted application answers. GET /api/v1/me/journeys returns minimal owner-bound homepage summaries with limit 1–50 and a safe cursor. Browser-supplied steps never establish paid, submitted or issued state.
A validated domain transition, required transaction_audit_event, journey projection update and journey_step_event commit atomically in one PostgreSQL unit of work through public module interfaces. Audit refers to existing orders, attempts, journal effects, adjustments and submission records; it is not a second money ledger. Keep initiated, pending, failed, unknown, reconciled and succeeded observations append-only, with operation/provider references and server-derived integer amounts where applicable. Corrections append; they never erase an earlier observation. No raw provider payload, form values, credentials or free-text exception is copied into audit.
Consumer payloads reside in protected_payload_envelope referenced by their owning domain revision. The instructor must supply and verify a maintained authenticated-encryption adapter before the first private write. Proposed AES-256-GCM uses a 12-byte nonce, 128-bit tag, separate wrapped DEK and KEK reference, unique nonce per encryption under a key, and object/revision/payload-kind/schema-version AAD. Authorization occurs before decrypt. Malformed/tampered envelope, wrong object binding or missing key fails closed with zero plaintext fallback. Keys never enter the repository, browser, database as plaintext, logs or telemetry. Fixed keys/nonces are isolated test-vector fixtures only; no real KMS/key/grant creation is authorized.
PAGE_VIEW and CONTROL_CLICK analytics are separate best-effort observations. POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most 10 events within 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Use versioned page/step/target allowlists and no arbitrary properties, form values, health answers, amounts, contact data, secrets, raw URLs/queries/referrers or DOM text. Validate ownership before linking a journey. Client time/order is untrusted; store server_received_at separately and never use analytics to advance journey or financial state. Policy-disallowed clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals receive DISCARDED_BY_POLICY without payload persistence. 202 receipts mean RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY only; changed payload under the same event UUID is 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT. Invalid 400, oversized 413 and rate-limited 429 are safe. Browser queue maximum 20 and retries maximum 3 may drop telemetry; checkout, save and resume remain independent. No third-party analytics destination is introduced.
Retention windows remain configurable synthetic teaching values, not legal policy. Keep audit/backup/key recovery references under reviewed holds; the encryption/key-rotation/deletion plan cannot silently destroy required history. All implementation, prerequisite, encryption, privacy and timebox evidence remains NOT_RUN/BLOCKED.

### Updated protection, revision and recovery boundaries

Preserve ApplicationRevision’s recovered composite key. journey(application_id, application_revision) references application_revision(application_id, revision); no new application-revision UUID is introduced. Local AEAD AAD includes immutable object ID, object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version. Deployment KMS context, if ever authorized, contains non-sensitive constant service/payload-class/version labels only.
Field envelopes do not encrypt every metadata column, foreign key or index. Deployment preparation separately requires authenticated TLS for browser/API and application/database links, encrypted database volumes and backups, key separation, authorized restore and application/proxy/error-log redaction. Local loopback tests prove none of those deployment controls. No configuration/security mutation is authorized here.
An ephemeral in-memory teaching key supports only its declared process lifetime. In-process round-trip, application restart, database restart and restored-backup recovery are separate experiments. Cross-process encrypted recovery is BLOCKED until an approved retained teaching-key mechanism is prepared and verified. A lost key returns KEY_UNAVAILABLE and retains ciphertext; it is never interpreted as empty data or a passing restore. Persist a pending operation/provider reference before any external mock call. If recording a provider result rolls back, retain the prior pending/unknown reference for reconciliation; do not claim a FAILED audit row survived rollback.

### Planned shared frontend foundation

Planned frontend convention: the instructor-supplied SPA shell uses TanStack React Query for server state, shared parameterized UI primitives and compositions, Tailwind design tokens and an Inter/system-ui font stack. This replaces repeated bespoke view blocks while preserving CoverStory’s warm paper surfaces, category accents, accessible controls, responsive spacing and light/dark behavior. Inter is the latest approved open-source font choice; there is no Proxima Nova purchase or licensing blocker. All package versions, setup, components and browser behavior remain unimplemented until the instructor reconciles them with the actual fixture-only frontend.
Query cache is not form or navigation state. Keep unsubmitted input and device-local public selections in their appropriate bounded state. Use typed, versioned query keys containing the relevant public catalog revision or authenticated owner/session generation. A fresh SPA load authenticates, then refetches /api/v1/me/journeys and validates current allowed actions; this is refresh/resume, not an SSR hydration claim. Cancel and clear private queries on logout/account change and ignore late prior-session responses. Do not persist sensitive query data in browser storage. Mutation completion invalidates or updates only the affected owned query/version after authoritative server success; a click, optimistic animation or analytics receipt cannot establish paid/submitted state. The instructor supplies adapters and reusable components; each day retains its single bounded learner seam.

### Frontend provider and build guardrails

The current proposed framework is TanStack React Query v5; verify the actual package version before implementation. Supply one stable QueryClient at the app boundary and domain-owned typed query-key/options factories. Shared primitives do not fetch another module’s data. Stale time, garbage-collection time and retry limits are chosen by data class; authentication and validation failures do not loop. Pass AbortSignal to the actual transport. Refresh and refetch effects never initiate payment, submission or renewal mutations. Do not introduce Next.js, TanStack Start or SSR. Later optional cache-restoration exercises use synthetic public reference data only, with version buster, finite maxAge and suitable gcTime; private cache and queued mutations remain excluded.
Planned shared paths are frontend/src/coverstory/shared/ui/, shared/theme/ and shared/query/. Tailwind semantic tokens centralize color, spacing, radius, focus and typography; finite variant/size/tone props map to complete static utility strings, never dynamic class fragments. The instructor checks the installed Tailwind major before using v4 @theme and verifies production source scanning. Inter/system-ui remains a font token; retain the Inter copyright and SIL Open Font License with later distributed assets. No font download, package install or production build is performed by this draft.

One existing 228-day CAP calendar, 14 October 2026–29 May 2027; this draft changes only Day001–076. Preserve IDs, active dates, roles, board membership, native links, original history and statuses. Instructor must deliberately configure the six-module bootstrap, public interfaces and private persistence; add a test rejecting a forbidden cross-module repository import and a dependency cycle. ### Fixed scope, architecture and privacy

Proposed React → Spring API → owning Catalog/Shortlist/Application/Payments/Policy/Support public module interface → one PostgreSQL. No cross-module repository access. No runtime broker, Redis cache or second database. Additional technology requires a product need/measured bottleneck, alternatives, failure/cost analysis and linked ADR.
Health-first discovery with health/term/motor/ULIP entry links. Anonymous browse, compare 1–3 unique same-category and matching-scenario versions, and device-local save/export need no phone, OTP or marketing gate. Keep Unknown as Unknown, critical restrictions expanded, source version/date/evidence label visible. Login is required only for owned objects and mock purchase. Catalog editor, Applicant, assigned Support and sandbox simulator are distinct actors.
All new money uses currency INR and integer minor units. SYNTHETIC fixture quotes exercise contracts only. Captured illustrations, base tariffs and historical rates are SOURCE_EVIDENCE, not accepted payable quotes. Unknown tax/total or unsupported scenario blocks payable review. Every changed amount, terms, quote/configuration or revision requires explicit review/acceptance, including changes at or below 100 paise. The >100-paise threshold adds escalation, never permits silent acceptance.
Mock Juspay and simulated insurer only; no real PII, payments, refunds, policy sales, cloud resources or insurer dispatch. Payment confirmation unlocks one owned ONBOARDING application; it does not submit a proposal or create active cover. Explicit final submit after complete fields/disclosures, confirmed corrections, current exact revision/quote/options/terms acceptance and fully reconciled payments produces SUBMISSION_PENDING. Only retained simulated external-dispatch reference evidence can produce SUBMITTED. Policy issuance and active-cover evidence remain separate later states.
Proposed canonical API /api/v1 and noun catalog; no route, package or alias is claimed implemented. Later recovered /api/... routes are documented legacy aliases only pending explicit adapter tests; unversioned /applications, /orders, /quote-validations, /me routes normalize under /api/v1. Historical /api/catalogue/options maps to proposed /api/v1/catalog/options. Historical correlationId maps to requestId in safe errors {code, message, fieldErrors, requestId, retryable}. Old /api/events, /api/pipelines and operator-v1 are historical generic contracts, NOT automatic aliases. Schemas get separate typed adapters and fixtures, never enum renames.
Use trusted actor + operation + resource + key and canonical payload hash. Same key/hash replays stored result; different payload conflicts. A proposed 7-day sandbox response cache does not bound durable resource-effect uniqueness; effect records and reconciliation evidence must survive the applicable retry/retention window. Real legal/provider retention remains a launch gate. UNKNOWN money or dispatch outcomes require same-reference reconciliation before another effect.

### Proposed journey, audit, analytics and encryption foundations

New user-required foundations are proposed instructor scaffolds, not implemented integrations. Anonymous comparison and device-local save remain open; private journey resume requires an authenticated owner. journey.id is a UUID identifier, never an access credential. Journey stores a server-maintained navigation projection and references exact owned domain records, including ApplicationRevision; it does not duplicate plaintext or encrypted application answers. GET /api/v1/me/journeys returns minimal owner-bound homepage summaries with limit 1–50 and a safe cursor. Browser-supplied steps never establish paid, submitted or issued state.
A validated domain transition, required transaction_audit_event, journey projection update and journey_step_event commit atomically in one PostgreSQL unit of work through public module interfaces. Audit refers to existing orders, attempts, journal effects, adjustments and submission records; it is not a second money ledger. Keep initiated, pending, failed, unknown, reconciled and succeeded observations append-only, with operation/provider references and server-derived integer amounts where applicable. Corrections append; they never erase an earlier observation. No raw provider payload, form values, credentials or free-text exception is copied into audit.
Consumer payloads reside in protected_payload_envelope referenced by their owning domain revision. The instructor must supply and verify a maintained authenticated-encryption adapter before the first private write. Proposed AES-256-GCM uses a 12-byte nonce, 128-bit tag, separate wrapped DEK and KEK reference, unique nonce per encryption under a key, and object/revision/payload-kind/schema-version AAD. Authorization occurs before decrypt. Malformed/tampered envelope, wrong object binding or missing key fails closed with zero plaintext fallback. Keys never enter the repository, browser, database as plaintext, logs or telemetry. Fixed keys/nonces are isolated test-vector fixtures only; no real KMS/key/grant creation is authorized.
PAGE_VIEW and CONTROL_CLICK analytics are separate best-effort observations. POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most 10 events within 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Use versioned page/step/target allowlists and no arbitrary properties, form values, health answers, amounts, contact data, secrets, raw URLs/queries/referrers or DOM text. Validate ownership before linking a journey. Client time/order is untrusted; store server_received_at separately and never use analytics to advance journey or financial state. Policy-disallowed clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals receive DISCARDED_BY_POLICY without payload persistence. 202 receipts mean RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY only; changed payload under the same event UUID is 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT. Invalid 400, oversized 413 and rate-limited 429 are safe. Browser queue maximum 20 and retries maximum 3 may drop telemetry; checkout, save and resume remain independent. No third-party analytics destination is introduced.
Retention windows remain configurable synthetic teaching values, not legal policy. Keep audit/backup/key recovery references under reviewed holds; the encryption/key-rotation/deletion plan cannot silently destroy required history. All implementation, prerequisite, encryption, privacy and timebox evidence remains NOT_RUN/BLOCKED.

### Updated protection, revision and recovery boundaries

Preserve ApplicationRevision’s recovered composite key. journey(application_id, application_revision) references application_revision(application_id, revision); no new application-revision UUID is introduced. Local AEAD AAD includes immutable object ID, object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version. Deployment KMS context, if ever authorized, contains non-sensitive constant service/payload-class/version labels only.
Field envelopes do not encrypt every metadata column, foreign key or index. Deployment preparation separately requires authenticated TLS for browser/API and application/database links, encrypted database volumes and backups, key separation, authorized restore and application/proxy/error-log redaction. Local loopback tests prove none of those deployment controls. No configuration/security mutation is authorized here.
An ephemeral in-memory teaching key supports only its declared process lifetime. In-process round-trip, application restart, database restart and restored-backup recovery are separate experiments. Cross-process encrypted recovery is BLOCKED until an approved retained teaching-key mechanism is prepared and verified. A lost key returns KEY_UNAVAILABLE and retains ciphertext; it is never interpreted as empty data or a passing restore. Persist a pending operation/provider reference before any external mock call. If recording a provider result rolls back, retain the prior pending/unknown reference for reconciliation; do not claim a FAILED audit row survived rollback.

### Planned shared frontend foundation

Planned frontend convention: the instructor-supplied SPA shell uses TanStack React Query for server state, shared parameterized UI primitives and compositions, Tailwind design tokens and an Inter/system-ui font stack. This replaces repeated bespoke view blocks while preserving CoverStory’s warm paper surfaces, category accents, accessible controls, responsive spacing and light/dark behavior. Inter is the latest approved open-source font choice; there is no Proxima Nova purchase or licensing blocker. All package versions, setup, components and browser behavior remain unimplemented until the instructor reconciles them with the actual fixture-only frontend.
Query cache is not form or navigation state. Keep unsubmitted input and device-local public selections in their appropriate bounded state. Use typed, versioned query keys containing the relevant public catalog revision or authenticated owner/session generation. A fresh SPA load authenticates, then refetches /api/v1/me/journeys and validates current allowed actions; this is refresh/resume, not an SSR hydration claim. Cancel and clear private queries on logout/account change and ignore late prior-session responses. Do not persist sensitive query data in browser storage. Mutation completion invalidates or updates only the affected owned query/version after authoritative server success; a click, optimistic animation or analytics receipt cannot establish paid/submitted state. The instructor supplies adapters and reusable components; each day retains its single bounded learner seam.

### Frontend provider and build guardrails

The current proposed framework is TanStack React Query v5; verify the actual package version before implementation. Supply one stable QueryClient at the app boundary and domain-owned typed query-key/options factories. Shared primitives do not fetch another module’s data. Stale time, garbage-collection time and retry limits are chosen by data class; authentication and validation failures do not loop. Pass AbortSignal to the actual transport. Refresh and refetch effects never initiate payment, submission or renewal mutations. Do not introduce Next.js, TanStack Start or SSR. Later optional cache-restoration exercises use synthetic public reference data only, with version buster, finite maxAge and suitable gcTime; private cache and queued mutations remain excluded.
Planned shared paths are frontend/src/coverstory/shared/ui/, shared/theme/ and shared/query/. Tailwind semantic tokens centralize color, spacing, radius, focus and typography; finite variant/size/tone props map to complete static utility strings, never dynamic class fragments. The instructor checks the installed Tailwind major before using v4 @theme and verifies production source scanning. Inter/system-ui remains a font token; retain the Inter copyright and SIL Open Font License with later distributed assets. No font download, package install or production build is performed by this draft.

Consumer payloads reside in protected_payload_envelope referenced by their owning domain revision. The instructor must supply and verify a maintained authenticated-encryption adapter before the first private write. Proposed AES-256-GCM uses a 12-byte nonce, 128-bit tag, separate wrapped DEK and KEK reference, unique nonce per encryption under a key, and object/revision/payload-kind/schema-version AAD. Authorization occurs before decrypt. Malformed/tampered envelope, wrong object binding or missing key fails closed with zero plaintext fallback. ### Fixed scope, architecture and privacy

Proposed React → Spring API → owning Catalog/Shortlist/Application/Payments/Policy/Support public module interface → one PostgreSQL. No cross-module repository access. No runtime broker, Redis cache or second database. Additional technology requires a product need/measured bottleneck, alternatives, failure/cost analysis and linked ADR.
Health-first discovery with health/term/motor/ULIP entry links. Anonymous browse, compare 1–3 unique same-category and matching-scenario versions, and device-local save/export need no phone, OTP or marketing gate. Keep Unknown as Unknown, critical restrictions expanded, source version/date/evidence label visible. Login is required only for owned objects and mock purchase. Catalog editor, Applicant, assigned Support and sandbox simulator are distinct actors.
All new money uses currency INR and integer minor units. SYNTHETIC fixture quotes exercise contracts only. Captured illustrations, base tariffs and historical rates are SOURCE_EVIDENCE, not accepted payable quotes. Unknown tax/total or unsupported scenario blocks payable review. Every changed amount, terms, quote/configuration or revision requires explicit review/acceptance, including changes at or below 100 paise. The >100-paise threshold adds escalation, never permits silent acceptance.
Mock Juspay and simulated insurer only; no real PII, payments, refunds, policy sales, cloud resources or insurer dispatch. Payment confirmation unlocks one owned ONBOARDING application; it does not submit a proposal or create active cover. Explicit final submit after complete fields/disclosures, confirmed corrections, current exact revision/quote/options/terms acceptance and fully reconciled payments produces SUBMISSION_PENDING. Only retained simulated external-dispatch reference evidence can produce SUBMITTED. Policy issuance and active-cover evidence remain separate later states.
Proposed canonical API /api/v1 and noun catalog; no route, package or alias is claimed implemented. Later recovered /api/... routes are documented legacy aliases only pending explicit adapter tests; unversioned /applications, /orders, /quote-validations, /me routes normalize under /api/v1. Historical /api/catalogue/options maps to proposed /api/v1/catalog/options. Historical correlationId maps to requestId in safe errors {code, message, fieldErrors, requestId, retryable}. Old /api/events, /api/pipelines and operator-v1 are historical generic contracts, NOT automatic aliases. Schemas get separate typed adapters and fixtures, never enum renames.
Use trusted actor + operation + resource + key and canonical payload hash. Same key/hash replays stored result; different payload conflicts. A proposed 7-day sandbox response cache does not bound durable resource-effect uniqueness; effect records and reconciliation evidence must survive the applicable retry/retention window. Real legal/provider retention remains a launch gate. UNKNOWN money or dispatch outcomes require same-reference reconciliation before another effect.

### Proposed journey, audit, analytics and encryption foundations

New user-required foundations are proposed instructor scaffolds, not implemented integrations. Anonymous comparison and device-local save remain open; private journey resume requires an authenticated owner. journey.id is a UUID identifier, never an access credential. Journey stores a server-maintained navigation projection and references exact owned domain records, including ApplicationRevision; it does not duplicate plaintext or encrypted application answers. GET /api/v1/me/journeys returns minimal owner-bound homepage summaries with limit 1–50 and a safe cursor. Browser-supplied steps never establish paid, submitted or issued state.
A validated domain transition, required transaction_audit_event, journey projection update and journey_step_event commit atomically in one PostgreSQL unit of work through public module interfaces. Audit refers to existing orders, attempts, journal effects, adjustments and submission records; it is not a second money ledger. Keep initiated, pending, failed, unknown, reconciled and succeeded observations append-only, with operation/provider references and server-derived integer amounts where applicable. Corrections append; they never erase an earlier observation. No raw provider payload, form values, credentials or free-text exception is copied into audit.
Consumer payloads reside in protected_payload_envelope referenced by their owning domain revision. The instructor must supply and verify a maintained authenticated-encryption adapter before the first private write. Proposed AES-256-GCM uses a 12-byte nonce, 128-bit tag, separate wrapped DEK and KEK reference, unique nonce per encryption under a key, and object/revision/payload-kind/schema-version AAD. Authorization occurs before decrypt. Malformed/tampered envelope, wrong object binding or missing key fails closed with zero plaintext fallback. Keys never enter the repository, browser, database as plaintext, logs or telemetry. Fixed keys/nonces are isolated test-vector fixtures only; no real KMS/key/grant creation is authorized.
PAGE_VIEW and CONTROL_CLICK analytics are separate best-effort observations. POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most 10 events within 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Use versioned page/step/target allowlists and no arbitrary properties, form values, health answers, amounts, contact data, secrets, raw URLs/queries/referrers or DOM text. Validate ownership before linking a journey. Client time/order is untrusted; store server_received_at separately and never use analytics to advance journey or financial state. Policy-disallowed clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals receive DISCARDED_BY_POLICY without payload persistence. 202 receipts mean RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY only; changed payload under the same event UUID is 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT. Invalid 400, oversized 413 and rate-limited 429 are safe. Browser queue maximum 20 and retries maximum 3 may drop telemetry; checkout, save and resume remain independent. No third-party analytics destination is introduced.
Retention windows remain configurable synthetic teaching values, not legal policy. Keep audit/backup/key recovery references under reviewed holds; the encryption/key-rotation/deletion plan cannot silently destroy required history. All implementation, prerequisite, encryption, privacy and timebox evidence remains NOT_RUN/BLOCKED.

### Updated protection, revision and recovery boundaries

Preserve ApplicationRevision’s recovered composite key. journey(application_id, application_revision) references application_revision(application_id, revision); no new application-revision UUID is introduced. Local AEAD AAD includes immutable object ID, object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version. Deployment KMS context, if ever authorized, contains non-sensitive constant service/payload-class/version labels only.
Field envelopes do not encrypt every metadata column, foreign key or index. Deployment preparation separately requires authenticated TLS for browser/API and application/database links, encrypted database volumes and backups, key separation, authorized restore and application/proxy/error-log redaction. Local loopback tests prove none of those deployment controls. No configuration/security mutation is authorized here.
An ephemeral in-memory teaching key supports only its declared process lifetime. In-process round-trip, application restart, database restart and restored-backup recovery are separate experiments. Cross-process encrypted recovery is BLOCKED until an approved retained teaching-key mechanism is prepared and verified. A lost key returns KEY_UNAVAILABLE and retains ciphertext; it is never interpreted as empty data or a passing restore. Persist a pending operation/provider reference before any external mock call. If recording a provider result rolls back, retain the prior pending/unknown reference for reconciliation; do not claim a FAILED audit row survived rollback.

### Planned shared frontend foundation

Planned frontend convention: the instructor-supplied SPA shell uses TanStack React Query for server state, shared parameterized UI primitives and compositions, Tailwind design tokens and an Inter/system-ui font stack. This replaces repeated bespoke view blocks while preserving CoverStory’s warm paper surfaces, category accents, accessible controls, responsive spacing and light/dark behavior. All package versions, setup, components and browser behavior remain unimplemented until the instructor reconciles them with the actual fixture-only frontend.
Query cache is not form or navigation state. Keep unsubmitted input and device-local public selections in their appropriate bounded state. Use typed, versioned query keys containing the relevant public catalog revision or authenticated owner/session generation. A fresh SPA load authenticates, then refetches /api/v1/me/journeys and validates current allowed actions; this is refresh/resume, not an SSR hydration claim. Cancel and clear private queries on logout/account change and ignore late prior-session responses. Do not persist sensitive query data in browser storage. Mutation completion invalidates or updates only the affected owned query/version after authoritative server success; a click, optimistic animation or analytics receipt cannot establish paid/submitted state. The instructor supplies adapters and reusable components; each day retains its single bounded learner seam.

The current proposed framework is TanStack React Query v5; verify the actual package version before implementation. Supply one stable QueryClient at the app boundary and domain-owned typed query-key/options factories. Shared primitives do not fetch another module’s data. Stale time, garbage-collection time and retry limits are chosen by data class; authentication and validation failures do not loop. Pass AbortSignal to the actual transport. Planned shared paths are frontend/src/coverstory/shared/ui/, shared/theme/ and shared/query/. Tailwind semantic tokens centralize color, spacing, radius, focus and typography; finite variant/size/tone props map to complete static utility strings, never dynamic class fragments. Application and immutable ApplicationRevision remain the business source of truth. Each sensitive revision references protected_payload_envelope; journey contains no duplicate plaintext or encrypted draft. Journey UUID is an identifier, never authority. Authenticated owner or separately assigned support checks precede every read, link, write and decrypt. Anonymous discovery remains device-local; no private anonymous resume. Importing selections after login revalidates versions and does not transfer a private journey or turn telemetry into trusted history. journey holds id, owner_user_id, category, current_step, journey_status, version, shortlist_id, application_id, application_revision, quote_id, created_at, updated_at, expires_at and retention_policy_version. It is a server-maintained navigation projection; current domain/source validity determines allowed actions. journey_step_event holds id, journey_id, sequence, event_code, from_step, to_step, actor_ref, domain_record_type, domain_record_id, domain_revision, causation_id, request_id, occurred_at and recorded_at. Unique (aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_sequence); existing owning modules enforce operation/effect uniqueness. Preserve initiated, pending, failed, unknown, reconciled and succeeded observations; append corrections and reversals. Link real mock journal/effect records rather than inventing a second ledger. No raw provider payload, consumer form, secret or free-text exception. Every server-authorized domain transition, required audit event, journey projection update and step event commit in one PostgreSQL unit of work through public interfaces; any failure rolls all back. No external call is inside that transaction. Domain expected version and supplied journey version must both match. No public endpoint sets paid/submitted/issued. GET /api/v1/me/journeys?status=active&limit=20&cursor=... requires owner authentication, limit 1–50 and an opaque owner-bound cursor; it returns minimal summaries/actions, never decrypted consumer fields. GET /api/v1/journeys/{id} returns the same safe 404 for foreign/unknown IDs and validates navigation against current domain state. These are new proposed routes, not existing aliases. analytics_event holds event_id UUID, schema_version=1, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id nullable, event_name, page_id, step_code nullable, target_id nullable, optional_duration_ms nullable, client_time nullable, server_received_at, policy_version and expires_at. PAGE_VIEW and CONTROL_CLICK only; screen/step/target IDs use a versioned allowlist. No arbitrary properties, PII, health/payment/form values, amounts, secrets, DOM text, raw URL/query/referrer or document text in analytics, URLs or logs. Pseudonymous tracking is consent/purpose-policy gated, not anonymous by definition. Private journey links require ownership validation. POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or a batch of at most 10 and at most 8 KiB of JSON UTF-8. Return 202 with per-event RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY; changed validated payload under the same event ID returns 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT, invalid schema 400, oversized body 413 and rate limit 429. The browser queue is at most 20 events and retry is at most 3 attempts; telemetry is best-effort and can drop. When policy forbids collection the client emits nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without payload persistence. No third-party analytics destination. Telemetry failure/order/loss cannot block or establish checkout, draft save, resume or authoritative state. protected_payload_envelope holds id, owner_user_id, object_type, object_id, object_revision, payload_kind, encryption_schema_version, algorithm, nonce, ciphertext_with_tag, wrapped_dek, kek_reference, envelope_revision, created_at and retirement_state. Proposed AES-256-GCM uses a 12-byte IV and 128-bit tag, unique IV per data key outside fixed test vectors; no homemade cipher or real keys. AAD binds immutable opaque object ID plus object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version; authorization precedes decrypt, and AAD is never logged. Invalid version/envelope/tag/ciphertext/AAD or missing key fails closed with no partial plaintext or fallback. Only wrapped data keys accompany ciphertext. Wrapping keys stay outside database, repository and browser; ephemeral test keys only. A future KMS context may contain only non-sensitive constant service/payload-class/version labels, never consumer fields, owner/journey IDs, quote details or secrets. No KMS grant, key creation or persistent access. Key-envelope rotation preserves business identity, accepted content and authorized old-backup recoverability; missing old key means KEY_UNAVAILABLE, not successful restore. Use distinct configurable fixture retention windows, for example analytics 7 days and abandoned drafts 30 days. These are teaching values, not legal policy. Retained audit references and reviewed holds remain intact; no indefinite-retention or crypto-deletion compliance claim. All errors use safe requestId. All of this remains planned instructor preparation and NOT_RUN until independently checked.

Journey preserves the recovered composite foreign key: (application_id, application_revision) references ApplicationRevision(application_id, revision); no revision UUID or rekeying. A pending attempt/operation reference is committed before any external mock call. A definitive provider failure commits FAILED plus its audit event; if that recording transaction rolls back, the prior pending/unknown reference remains for reconciliation. Do not claim the failed transaction preserved its new audit row or invent a definitive outcome. Deployment protection remains planned and unverified: authenticated TLS for browser/API and application/database connections, encrypted database volumes/backups, separate key access, authorized restore access and redacted application/proxy/error logs. Field encryption does not encrypt every index or metadata field; local loopback is not proof of deployment TLS or disk encryption. Ephemeral teaching keys last only for their test process. It is a server-maintained navigation projection; current domain/source validity determines allowed actions. journey_step_event holds id, journey_id, sequence, event_code, from_step, to_step, actor_ref, domain_record_type, domain_record_id, domain_revision, causation_id, request_id, occurred_at and recorded_at. GET /api/v1/me/journeys?status=active&limit=20&cursor=... requires owner authentication, limit 1–50 and an opaque owner-bound cursor; it returns minimal summaries/actions, never decrypted consumer fields. GET /api/v1/journeys/{id} returns the same safe 404 for foreign/unknown IDs and validates navigation against current domain state. These are new proposed routes, not existing aliases. analytics_event holds event_id UUID, schema_version=1, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id nullable, event_name, page_id, step_code nullable, target_id nullable, optional_duration_ms nullable, client_time nullable, server_received_at, policy_version and expires_at. When policy forbids collection the client emits nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without payload persistence. No third-party analytics destination. Telemetry failure/order/loss cannot block or establish checkout, draft save, resume or authoritative state. protected_payload_envelope holds id, owner_user_id, object_type, object_id, object_revision, payload_kind, encryption_schema_version, algorithm, nonce, ciphertext_with_tag, wrapped_dek, kek_reference, envelope_revision, created_at and retirement_state. ## Active CoverStory semantic migration — proposed

CoverStory is a proposed health-first insurance marketplace teaching application, with entry points for health, term life, motor and ULIP. This card deepens the cumulative target journey; it does not claim that target is implemented today. The current repository audit reports only a Spring /health endpoint under capstone.app, fixture-mode React, and reusable generic AI/evaluation mechanisms. The six product modules, public interfaces, private persistence, component scanning and boundary tests are planned instructor prerequisites. Existing OperatorApi/EventStatus are historical contracts, never automatic insurance aliases.

Use React → Spring → Catalog, Shortlist, Application, Payments, Policy and Support public interfaces → PostgreSQL. Cross-module repository access and circular module imports fail the boundary test. No initial runtime broker, server/shared cache or second database. The newly required TanStack Query v5 in-memory browser server-state cache is a separate frontend mechanism, never a source of business truth or a sensitive persisted cache. Kafka offsets, Redis-style cache keys and distributed concepts remain isolated CoverStory experiments or measured later evolution. Reuse actual decoder, stale-response and session-reset mechanisms only through explicit product adapters.

Payment success unlocks owned onboarding exactly once; it cannot submit a proposal or issue coverage. Submission requires complete disclosures, confirmed corrections, the exact currently reviewed proposal/quote/configuration/terms revision, explicit user acceptance, confirmed net-payment reconciliation with pending amounts reserved, and an explicit submit command. Every changed amount, terms hash or revision requires renewed review/acceptance, including a 1-paise change; the 100-paise escalation test is never permission to accept a smaller change implicitly. The command returns SUBMISSION_PENDING until simulated external acknowledgement establishes SUBMITTED. Insurer review, revised offer, acceptance, issuance-pending and evidence-backed policy state remain distinct.

Serialize cancellation with the dispatch claim. A cancellation winner invalidates queued work atomically; in-flight or unknown dispatch is reconciled before unsubmitted treatment or refund eligibility. Confirmed submission routes to verified insurer-contact information; an alert is not cancellation/refund completion. Money is integer minor units plus currency. Confirmed application net = external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed application-attributed wallet credits. Pending allocations are reserved, not settled. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations and cannot be negative. A unique allocation prevents origin and wallet returning the same funds; an uncertain/pending origin attempt cannot switch route until cancellation is confirmed. Posted entries are immutable; reversals reference originals. A fresh renewal is a new linked application with new quote/configuration review; it never overwrites the prior policy or promises uninterrupted/backdated cover.

All provider, insurer, payment, wallet and mandate behavior is mock/simulated. Approved-source AI only explains or reads scoped evidence; it cannot underwrite, accept, submit, cancel, refund, spend or renew. No personal health data, real credentials, real money, hosted model calls, cloud deployment or live legal/launch readiness is authorized. Historical illustrations/tariffs and old signed-event/replay-epoch fixtures are not accepted payable quotes or retroactive insurance evidence.

CoverStory is a proposed health-first insurance marketplace teaching application, with entry points for health, term life, motor and ULIP. Payment success unlocks owned onboarding exactly once; it cannot submit a proposal or issue coverage. Submission requires complete disclosures, confirmed corrections, the exact currently reviewed proposal/quote/configuration/terms revision, explicit user acceptance, confirmed net-payment reconciliation with pending amounts reserved, and an explicit submit command. Every changed amount, terms hash or revision requires renewed review/acceptance, including a 1-paise change; the 100-paise escalation test is never permission to accept a smaller change implicitly. The command returns SUBMISSION_PENDING until simulated external acknowledgement establishes SUBMITTED. Insurer review, revised offer, acceptance, issuance-pending and evidence-backed policy state remain distinct.

Serialize cancellation with the dispatch claim. A cancellation winner invalidates queued work atomically; in-flight or unknown dispatch is reconciled before unsubmitted treatment or refund eligibility. Confirmed submission routes to verified insurer-contact information; an alert is not cancellation/refund completion. Money is integer minor units plus currency. Confirmed application net = external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed application-attributed wallet credits. Pending allocations are reserved, not settled. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations and cannot be negative. A unique allocation prevents origin and wallet returning the same funds; an uncertain/pending origin attempt cannot switch route until cancellation is confirmed. Posted entries are immutable; reversals reference originals. A fresh renewal is a new linked application with new quote/configuration review; it never overwrites the prior policy or promises uninterrupted/backdated cover.

All provider, insurer, payment, wallet and mandate behavior is mock/simulated. Approved-source AI only explains or reads scoped evidence; it cannot underwrite, accept, submit, cancel, refund, spend or renew. No personal health data, real credentials, real money, hosted model calls, cloud deployment or live legal/launch readiness is authorized. ## Active CoverStory semantic migration — proposed

CoverStory is a proposed health-first insurance marketplace teaching application, with entry points for health, term life, motor and ULIP. This card deepens the cumulative target journey; it does not claim that target is implemented today. The current repository audit reports only a Spring /health endpoint under capstone.app, fixture-mode React, and reusable generic AI/evaluation mechanisms. The six product modules, public interfaces, private persistence, component scanning and boundary tests are planned instructor prerequisites. Existing OperatorApi/EventStatus are historical contracts, never automatic insurance aliases.

Use React → Spring → Catalog, Shortlist, Application, Payments, Policy and Support public interfaces → PostgreSQL. Cross-module repository access and circular module imports fail the boundary test. No initial runtime broker, server/shared cache or second database. The newly required TanStack Query v5 in-memory browser server-state cache is a separate frontend mechanism, never a source of business truth or a sensitive persisted cache. Kafka offsets, Redis-style cache keys and distributed concepts remain isolated CoverStory experiments or measured later evolution. Reuse actual decoder, stale-response and session-reset mechanisms only through explicit product adapters.

Payment success unlocks owned onboarding exactly once; it cannot submit a proposal or issue coverage. Submission requires complete disclosures, confirmed corrections, the exact currently reviewed proposal/quote/configuration/terms revision, explicit user acceptance, confirmed net-payment reconciliation with pending amounts reserved, and an explicit submit command. Every changed amount, terms hash or revision requires renewed review/acceptance, including a 1-paise change; the 100-paise escalation test is never permission to accept a smaller change implicitly. The command returns SUBMISSION_PENDING until simulated external acknowledgement establishes SUBMITTED. Insurer review, revised offer, acceptance, issuance-pending and evidence-backed policy state remain distinct.

Serialize cancellation with the dispatch claim. A cancellation winner invalidates queued work atomically; in-flight or unknown dispatch is reconciled before unsubmitted treatment or refund eligibility. Confirmed submission routes to verified insurer-contact information; an alert is not cancellation/refund completion. Money is integer minor units plus currency. Confirmed application net = external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed application-attributed wallet credits. Pending allocations are reserved, not settled. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations and cannot be negative. A unique allocation prevents origin and wallet returning the same funds; an uncertain/pending origin attempt cannot switch route until cancellation is confirmed. Posted entries are immutable; reversals reference originals. A fresh renewal is a new linked application with new quote/configuration review; it never overwrites the prior policy or promises uninterrupted/backdated cover.

All provider, insurer, payment, wallet and mandate behavior is mock/simulated. Approved-source AI only explains or reads scoped evidence; it cannot underwrite, accept, submit, cancel, refund, spend or renew. No personal health data, real credentials, real money, hosted model calls, cloud deployment or live legal/launch readiness is authorized. Historical illustrations/tariffs and old signed-event/replay-epoch fixtures are not accepted payable quotes or retroactive insurance evidence.

NEW_USER_REQUIREMENT, 14 October 2026: protect necessary consumer payloads with maintained authenticated encryption and authorized decryption; keep key-encryption keys separate from data and wrapped data keys. Domain records reference protected envelopes; journey is an owned UUID navigation projection, not a second editable draft. Server domain transition, required transaction audit, journey projection and step event commit together. UUID knowledge grants no access. Browser PAGE_VIEW/CONTROL_CLICK analytics is a separate lossy, bounded, minimal-data observation stream and never proof of payment, submission or progress. Consent/purpose and retention are configurable teaching policy with legal decisions still gated. No raw credentials, medical/personal data, arbitrary analytics properties or live implementation claim. See planned docs/coverstory/journey-security-schema.md; this requirement is new user direction, not recovered ECOS evidence.

SPA refresh bootstraps the authenticated session and refetches owned journey state; SSR hydration is out of scope unless actual SSR is introduced later. ## Active CoverStory semantic migration — proposed

CoverStory is a proposed health-first insurance marketplace teaching application, with entry points for health, term life, motor and ULIP. This card deepens the cumulative target journey; it does not claim that target is implemented today. The current repository audit reports only a Spring /health endpoint under capstone.app, fixture-mode React, and reusable generic AI/evaluation mechanisms. The six product modules, public interfaces, private persistence, component scanning and boundary tests are planned instructor prerequisites. Existing OperatorApi/EventStatus are historical contracts, never automatic insurance aliases.

Use React → Spring → Catalog, Shortlist, Application, Payments, Policy and Support public interfaces → PostgreSQL. Cross-module repository access and circular module imports fail the boundary test. No initial runtime broker, server/shared cache or second database. The newly required TanStack Query v5 in-memory browser server-state cache is a separate frontend mechanism, never a source of business truth or a sensitive persisted cache. Kafka offsets, Redis-style cache keys and distributed concepts remain isolated CoverStory experiments or measured later evolution. Reuse actual decoder, stale-response and session-reset mechanisms only through explicit product adapters.

Payment success unlocks owned onboarding exactly once; it cannot submit a proposal or issue coverage. Submission requires complete disclosures, confirmed corrections, the exact currently reviewed proposal/quote/configuration/terms revision, explicit user acceptance, confirmed net-payment reconciliation with pending amounts reserved, and an explicit submit command. Every changed amount, terms hash or revision requires renewed review/acceptance, including a 1-paise change; the 100-paise escalation test is never permission to accept a smaller change implicitly. The command returns SUBMISSION_PENDING until simulated external acknowledgement establishes SUBMITTED. Insurer review, revised offer, acceptance, issuance-pending and evidence-backed policy state remain distinct.

Serialize cancellation with the dispatch claim. A cancellation winner invalidates queued work atomically; in-flight or unknown dispatch is reconciled before unsubmitted treatment or refund eligibility. Confirmed submission routes to verified insurer-contact information; an alert is not cancellation/refund completion. Money is integer minor units plus currency. Confirmed application net = external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed application-attributed wallet credits. Pending allocations are reserved, not settled. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations and cannot be negative. A unique allocation prevents origin and wallet returning the same funds; an uncertain/pending origin attempt cannot switch route until cancellation is confirmed. Posted entries are immutable; reversals reference originals. A fresh renewal is a new linked application with new quote/configuration review; it never overwrites the prior policy or promises uninterrupted/backdated cover.

All provider, insurer, payment, wallet and mandate behavior is mock/simulated. Approved-source AI only explains or reads scoped evidence; it cannot underwrite, accept, submit, cancel, refund, spend or renew. No personal health data, real credentials, real money, hosted model calls, cloud deployment or live legal/launch readiness is authorized. Historical illustrations/tariffs and old signed-event/replay-epoch fixtures are not accepted payable quotes or retroactive insurance evidence.

Serialize cancellation with the dispatch claim. A cancellation winner invalidates queued work atomically; in-flight or unknown dispatch is reconciled before unsubmitted treatment or refund eligibility. Confirmed application net = external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed application-attributed wallet credits. Pending allocations are reserved, not settled. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations and cannot be negative. A unique allocation prevents origin and wallet returning the same funds; an uncertain/pending origin attempt cannot switch route until cancellation is confirmed. Posted entries are immutable; reversals reference originals. A fresh renewal is a new linked application with new quote/configuration review; it never overwrites the prior policy or promises uninterrupted/backdated cover.

## Active CoverStory semantic migration — proposed

CoverStory is a proposed health-first insurance marketplace teaching application, with entry points for health, term life, motor and ULIP. This card deepens the cumulative target journey; it does not claim that target is implemented today. The current repository audit reports only a Spring /health endpoint under capstone.app, fixture-mode React, and reusable generic AI/evaluation mechanisms. The six product modules, public interfaces, private persistence, component scanning and boundary tests are planned instructor prerequisites. Existing OperatorApi/EventStatus are historical contracts, never automatic insurance aliases.

Use React → Spring → Catalog, Shortlist, Application, Payments, Policy and Support public interfaces → PostgreSQL. Cross-module repository access and circular module imports fail the boundary test. No initial runtime broker, server/shared cache or second database. The newly required TanStack Query v5 in-memory browser server-state cache is a separate frontend mechanism, never a source of business truth or a sensitive persisted cache. Kafka offsets, Redis-style cache keys and distributed concepts remain isolated CoverStory experiments or measured later evolution. Reuse actual decoder, stale-response and session-reset mechanisms only through explicit product adapters.

Payment success unlocks owned onboarding exactly once; it cannot submit a proposal or issue coverage. Submission requires complete disclosures, confirmed corrections, the exact currently reviewed proposal/quote/configuration/terms revision, explicit user acceptance, confirmed net-payment reconciliation with pending amounts reserved, and an explicit submit command. Every changed amount, terms hash or revision requires renewed review/acceptance, including a 1-paise change; the 100-paise escalation test is never permission to accept a smaller change implicitly. The command returns SUBMISSION_PENDING until simulated external acknowledgement establishes SUBMITTED. Insurer review, revised offer, acceptance, issuance-pending and evidence-backed policy state remain distinct.

Serialize cancellation with the dispatch claim. A cancellation winner invalidates queued work atomically; in-flight or unknown dispatch is reconciled before unsubmitted treatment or refund eligibility. Confirmed submission routes to verified insurer-contact information; an alert is not cancellation/refund completion. Money is integer minor units plus currency. Confirmed application net = external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed application-attributed wallet credits. Pending allocations are reserved, not settled. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations and cannot be negative. A unique allocation prevents origin and wallet returning the same funds; an uncertain/pending origin attempt cannot switch route until cancellation is confirmed. Posted entries are immutable; reversals reference originals. A fresh renewal is a new linked application with new quote/configuration review; it never overwrites the prior policy or promises uninterrupted/backdated cover.

All provider, insurer, payment, wallet and mandate behavior is mock/simulated. Approved-source AI only explains or reads scoped evidence; it cannot underwrite, accept, submit, cancel, refund, spend or renew. No personal health data, real credentials, real money, hosted model calls, cloud deployment or live legal/launch readiness is authorized. Historical illustrations/tariffs and old signed-event/replay-epoch fixtures are not accepted payable quotes or retroactive insurance evidence.

Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations and cannot be negative. A unique allocation prevents origin and wallet returning the same funds; an uncertain/pending origin attempt cannot switch route until cancellation is confirmed. Posted entries are immutable; reversals reference originals. A fresh renewal is a new linked application with new quote/configuration review; it never overwrites the prior policy or promises uninterrupted/backdated cover.

Confirmed application net = external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed application-attributed wallet credits. Pending allocations are reserved, not settled. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations and cannot be negative. A unique allocation prevents origin and wallet returning the same funds; an uncertain/pending origin attempt cannot switch route until cancellation is confirmed. Posted entries are immutable; reversals reference originals. A fresh renewal is a new linked application with new quote/configuration review; it never overwrites the prior policy or promises uninterrupted/backdated cover.

All provider, insurer, payment, wallet and mandate behavior is mock/simulated. Approved-source AI only explains or reads scoped evidence; it cannot underwrite, accept, submit, cancel, refund, spend or renew. ## Active CoverStory semantic migration — proposed

Payment success unlocks owned onboarding exactly once; it cannot submit a proposal or issue coverage. Submission requires complete disclosures, confirmed corrections, the exact currently reviewed proposal/quote/configuration/terms revision, explicit user acceptance, confirmed net-payment reconciliation with pending amounts reserved, and an explicit submit command. Every changed amount, terms hash or revision requires renewed review/acceptance, including a 1-paise change; the 100-paise escalation test is never permission to accept a smaller change implicitly. The command returns SUBMISSION_PENDING until simulated external acknowledgement establishes SUBMITTED. Insurer review, revised offer, acceptance, issuance-pending and evidence-backed policy state remain distinct.

Serialize cancellation with the dispatch claim. A cancellation winner invalidates queued work atomically; in-flight or unknown dispatch is reconciled before unsubmitted treatment or refund eligibility. Confirmed submission routes to verified insurer-contact information; an alert is not cancellation/refund completion. Money is integer minor units plus currency. Confirmed application net = external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed application-attributed wallet credits. Pending allocations are reserved, not settled. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations and cannot be negative. A unique allocation prevents origin and wallet returning the same funds; an uncertain/pending origin attempt cannot switch route until cancellation is confirmed. Posted entries are immutable; reversals reference originals. A fresh renewal is a new linked application with new quote/configuration review; it never overwrites the prior policy or promises uninterrupted/backdated cover.

## Active CoverStory semantic migration — proposed

CoverStory is a proposed health-first insurance marketplace teaching application, with entry points for health, term life, motor and ULIP. This card deepens the cumulative target journey; it does not claim that target is implemented today. The current repository audit reports only a Spring /health endpoint under capstone.app, fixture-mode React, and reusable generic AI/evaluation mechanisms. The six product modules, public interfaces, private persistence, component scanning and boundary tests are planned instructor prerequisites.
