CAP-25 · Day 167 · 2027-03-29 · Package the existing CoverStory build reproducibly

Execution/readiness gate: PROPOSED_NOT_PREPARED and NOT_RUN. The earlier mapped health capability is contingent on prerequisite evidence. At this audit the current repository has React fixture mode and a Spring /health seam, not verified CoverStory product wiring. Existing frontend decoders, cancellation/stale-response handling, session reset, safe errors and accessibility scaffolds may be reused only after inspection. OperatorApi/EventStatus require explicit replacement or adapter; product modules, public interfaces and forbidden-import/cycle checks remain planned instructor prerequisites.
The published Java 21/Maven and embedded PostgreSQL starter, including reported commit d623bf4bd16c6b437aa9e8908b2454c5e0256410, establishes only narrow scaffolding. Historical TODO failures, reported later fixes, this mapping and recovered design documents do not prove a solvable exercise or completed product. Before assignment, inspect the current checkout, prepare the named fixture/glue, reconcile exact API/command/test selectors and independently rehearse the full day inside its budget. If a predecessor is HOLD or physical evidence is absent, the dependent integrated result remains blocked. An explicitly isolated contract exercise may continue but cannot close that product gate.
The user-requested journey/audit/analytics/encryption schema is also proposed. An existing fixture-mode UI is not proof that these endpoints, transactions, keys or controls exist; instructor preparation and candidate-bound evidence are required.

### One concrete daily outcome

Add one reproducible-build manifest/check seam covering the already prepared React/Spring/PostgreSQL application and versioned synthetic fixtures.

### Earlier mapped prerequisites

- CAP-24, Day 166 (2027-03-28): reviewed evidence required.

### Recovered source rules and explicit teaching choices

- [ECOS-2](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-2), sections: Decision; Validation and reversal.
- [ECOS-16](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-16), sections: Decision and requirements; Validation and revisit trigger.
- [ECOS-20](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-20), sections: Signals and proposed targets; Capacity and benchmark; Failure and recovery matrix; QA acceptance matrix.
- [ECOS-44](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-44), sections: Scope; Acceptance criteria.
- [ECOS-48](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-48), sections: Scope; Acceptance criteria.

Recovered product constraints for this slice:
- React → Spring modular monolith → PostgreSQL. Catalog, Shortlist, Application, Payments, Policy and Support own their data and communicate through public interfaces; no cross-module repositories. Initial runtime has no shared cache, broker or second database.
- Unknown, Verified and Synthetic describe distinct evidence states. Historical ECOS illustrations/tariffs and teaching fixture prices are not current payable quotes. Unsupported scenarios show Quote unavailable; source version, scenario and terms remain attributable.
- Product money is integer minor units plus currency. Preserve original versus edited rating/configuration revisions. Every changed amount, terms, options or revision requires explicit review and exact acceptance, including changes of 1 or 100 paise. The historical 100-paise threshold is an escalation boundary, not permission to accept small changes silently.
- Confirmed mock payment unlocks onboarding only. Explicit final submit requires complete disclosures, confirmed extraction corrections, no unresolved questions, exact current reviewed revision and reconciled confirmed/pending payment allocations. Commit SUBMISSION_PENDING and dispatch intent together. SUBMITTED requires external mock dispatch evidence; ISSUED/active-cover language requires simulated issuance/effective-cover evidence.
- Serialize cancellation with dispatch claim. Unknown/in-flight dispatch must be reconciled before claiming unsubmitted cancellation or refundable entitlement. Origin refund and wallet credit consume one unique adjustment allocation and cannot both happen. Never reroute an uncertain origin refund to a new wallet credit.
- Application net settled = confirmed external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed wallet credits allocated to the application. Pending effects reserve funds. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations, never negative; a wallet-funded portion is not also counted as an external capture.
- Renewal creates a fresh linked application and quote and leaves the old policy unchanged. A renewal nudge cannot charge, create a real mandate or promise continuous/backdated cover.
- All insurer/payment decisions and funds remain mock/simulated. Assistance is source-grounded, read-only and owner-scoped; it cannot underwrite, mutate confirmed answers, submit proposals or move money. No real PII, medical documents, credentials, provider calls, cloud spending or launch is authorized.
These are constraints on the bounded daily seam, not additional daily implementation tasks.

User-requested extension, proposed 14 October 2026:
Journey UUIDs identify records and never authorize access. ApplicationRevision and the quote own answers and accepted terms; journey is a server-maintained navigation projection, not a second mutable draft. Anonymous discovery keeps only public device-local selections; after login an explicit owned handoff validates the source/scenario. GET /api/v1/me/journeys returns minimal owned resume summaries, limit 1–50, default 20, with owner-bound cursors. GET /api/v1/journeys/{id} returns the same safe 404 for missing and foreign IDs. Reload/new session recomputes allowed actions from authoritative domain state.
A server-validated domain transition, required transaction audit, journey projection and journey step event share one PostgreSQL unit of work through public interfaces. Unique (journey_id, sequence) and (journey_id, causation_id, event_code) prevent duplicate advancement. Transaction audit references actual payment/journal/adjustment/submission/renewal effects, retains failed/unknown/reconciled observations and appends corrections. Browser clicks and client timestamps never prove or order these effects.
POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most ten per batch, maximum 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Schema 1 permits only event_id, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id when ownership permits, event_name PAGE_VIEW or CONTROL_CLICK, allowlisted page_id/step_code/target_id, optional bounded duration/client time and policy metadata. No arbitrary properties, forms, health answers, amounts, email, tokens, raw URLs/referrers or DOM text. Server receive time is authoritative for receipt only. Exact event-ID replay is DUPLICATE; changed payload conflicts 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT. Invalid schema is 400, oversized body 413, rate limit 429. A 202 receipt is RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY and says nothing about business success. Browser queue is capped at twenty events and three attempts; loss/drop/reordering is allowed and cannot block checkout or owned resume. Policy-disabled clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without persisted payload. Retention/purpose/consent rules are configurable; no third-party destination or indefinite storage is assumed.
Selected synthetic consumer payloads use the prepared maintained AEAD/envelope port, proposed AES-256-GCM with a 12-byte IV and 128-bit tag. Owner checks precede decrypt. AAD binds immutable opaque object ID plus object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version; it is not secret and never enters logs/analytics. Store ciphertext and wrapped data key, never plaintext fallback or wrapping key in the database/browser/repository. IV uniqueness is required under each data key outside fixed test-vector mode. Rotation preserves business IDs/content and has its own envelope revision. In-memory test keys prove only their process lifetime; restart/restore recovery is BLOCKED without a prepared authorized retained teaching-key mechanism. Missing key is KEY_UNAVAILABLE, not empty data or recovery success. Field encryption does not prove deployment TLS, encrypted volumes/backups or legal compliance; those remain explicit configuration/evidence gates. No real key creation, KMS grant, credential or security-setting mutation is authorized.
These additions replace existing seam work; they do not add minutes. The exact new interfaces and fixtures are teaching proposals, distinct from recovered ECOS rules.
Preserve ApplicationRevision's recovered composite key: journey (application_id, application_revision) references ApplicationRevision (application_id, revision). Do not add a revision UUID or mutable plaintext journey copy. Initial journey statuses are ACTIVE, WAITING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED and EXPIRED. Current steps use the shared registry, including FINAL_REVIEW rather than an invented REVIEW step. The analytics allowlist uses lower-case page and control IDs from the versioned registry. PAGE_VIEW requires target_id absent. optional_duration_ms is an integer from 0 through 300000, with booleans invalid; client_time is absent or a valid aware timestamp, never authoritative order.
A pending operation reference is durable before an external mock call. A definite provider failure is committed with its FAILED state and audit observation in the result transaction. If that transaction rolls back, its audit row also rolls back; the prior pending/unknown reference remains for reconciliation. Never fabricate a definite outcome or claim a rolled-back audit row persisted.
Every model/isolated experiment is a bounded CoverStory module or engineering-evidence seam in the same capstone, feeding its actual ADR/release gate. It is not a detached toy project. Frontend exercises show component/state ownership, contract/data flow, route/reload/resume behavior, accessibility, safe errors and tests. Operating exercises show configuration/key boundaries, CI/rollback, SLO/failure, backups, capacity/cost evidence and ownership at the scope actually exercised.
Latest frontend teaching stack: TanStack React Query v5 owns server state and its in-memory cache. Form edits and router/UI state remain separate; no duplicate global store for fetched journey/application/quote data. SPA refresh uses session/bootstrap plus authenticated refetch and server-valid journey resume, not an assumed SSR hydration path. Query keys include bounded resource/version and owner/session scope; never put consumer answers or raw tokens in keys. Sensitive server-state cache is not persisted to browser storage. Cancel and clear owner-scoped queries on logout, expiry or owner change; late responses cannot repopulate a new session. Guard mutations with current domain/journey versions and exact accepted terms, then invalidate/refetch the affected server state. Cached data never authorizes payment, dispatch or issuance.
Shared UI uses parameterized accessible primitives and feature compositions, with Tailwind design tokens and finite typed variants. Avoid arbitrary dynamically constructed class names or a separate per-screen styling system. Use verified open-source Inter with system-ui fallback and readable hierarchy/spacing; Proxima Nova is no longer a dependency or licensing gate. Query, Tailwind and font packages are planned until the current repository and instructor scaffold are inspected. These changes replace the same frontend-state/design tasks and add no minutes.
Frontend stack details: one stable QueryClient at the app boundary; each domain owns typed key/options factories and query hooks. Shared primitives do not fetch from other domains. Preserve URL/deep-link filters. Set finite staleTime, gcTime and retry for each data class; 401/403/validation errors do not loop and writes have no blanket retry. Background refetch must not overwrite unsaved local form input. Optional persistence is restricted to a separately supplied synthetic public-reference experiment with a version buster and finite maxAge/gcTime; private caches and queued mutations remain excluded. No Next.js, TanStack Start or SSR is added.
Use Inter source and SIL Open Font License, retaining copyright/OFL with any later distributed assets. Font-display swap and observed fallback/layout-shift checks belong to the bounded design task. Shared paths are frontend/src/coverstory/shared/ui/, shared/theme/ and shared/query/. Tailwind official pages currently describe v4 @theme; inspect the actual installed major and do not upgrade silently.

Proposed canonical API v1 reconciliation, pending instructor review:
Use /api/v1 and catalog spelling. Recovered ECOS-19 contains both /api/v1/... and later /api/.../catalogue routes, and requestId versus correlationId errors. Map these explicitly in a versioned teaching adapter; no aliases, route implementation or compatibility are assumed. Canonical safe error is {code, message, fieldErrors, requestId, retryable}. Later correlationId is mapped to requestId without copying unsafe body text. Expected version and reviewed revision remain distinct.
The proposed acceptance record binds applicationId, expectedVersion, reviewedRevision, ratingRevision, quoteId, scenarioHash, configurationHash, sourceVersion, ruleVersion, termsHash, totalMinor, currency and consent to the authenticated owner. Exact field names/available DTOs must be reconciled at preflight; client owner/amount is never authority. The later source's SUBMISSION_PENDING/dispatch-evidence boundary supersedes the earlier shorthand that returned SUBMITTED immediately on submit. These are proposed teaching interfaces, not claims about existing endpoints.

### Concrete proposed inputs and output

One exact commit or working-tree digest; pinned Java/Maven/Node dependencies; two clean disposable workspaces; non-secret config keys; source/quote/schema/UI bundle identities. Build manifest pins the prepared React Query v5 and Tailwind versions, open-source font assets/license identity and lockfile; their planned inclusion does not prove installation or current product wiring.

The receipt includes state, candidateIdentity, cases, mode, measurements, newBoundaryTest, architectureDeltaRef, history. All expected examples are proposed tests, not observed runs.

Expected: Record artifact hashes and measured comparison; explain any nondeterminism rather than asserting bit equality.

Instructor ownership: supply typed DTOs and public-port signatures, exact synthetic inputs and visible fixed acceptance fixtures, fake Clock/deterministic scheduler, isolated PostgreSQL wiring where durability matters, read-only mock/model ports, safe fixture reset and an evidence serializer. OperatorApi/EventStatus require explicit replacement or adapter; product modules, public interfaces and forbidden-import/cycle checks remain planned instructor prerequisites.
The published Java 21/Maven and embedded PostgreSQL starter, including reported commit d623bf4bd16c6b437aa9e8908b2454c5e0256410, establishes only narrow scaffolding. Historical TODO failures, reported later fixes, this mapping and recovered design documents do not prove a solvable exercise or completed product. Before assignment, inspect the current checkout, prepare the named fixture/glue, reconcile exact API/command/test selectors and independently rehearse the full day inside its budget. The user-requested journey/audit/analytics/encryption schema is also proposed. An existing fixture-mode UI is not proof that these endpoints, transactions, keys or controls exist; instructor preparation and candidate-bound evidence are required.

### One concrete daily outcome

Complete dependency-inventory validation and one forbidden-module-import check over supplied current build metadata.

### Earlier mapped prerequisites

- CAP-25, Day 167 (2027-03-29): reviewed evidence required.

### Recovered source rules and explicit teaching choices

- [ECOS-2](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-2), sections: Decision; Validation and reversal.
- [ECOS-14](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-14), sections: Decision and requirements; Cost, operations, migration and reversal; Validation and revisit trigger.
- [ECOS-19](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-19), sections: Context and modules; API v1; Configuration, wallet and policy lifecycle contract.
- [ECOS-44](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-44), sections: Scope; Acceptance criteria.

Recovered product constraints for this slice:
- React → Spring modular monolith → PostgreSQL. Catalog, Shortlist, Application, Payments, Policy and Support own their data and communicate through public interfaces; no cross-module repositories. Initial runtime has no shared cache, broker or second database.
- Unknown, Verified and Synthetic describe distinct evidence states. Historical ECOS illustrations/tariffs and teaching fixture prices are not current payable quotes. Unsupported scenarios show Quote unavailable; source version, scenario and terms remain attributable.
- Product money is integer minor units plus currency. Preserve original versus edited rating/configuration revisions. Every changed amount, terms, options or revision requires explicit review and exact acceptance, including changes of 1 or 100 paise. The historical 100-paise threshold is an escalation boundary, not permission to accept small changes silently.
- Confirmed mock payment unlocks onboarding only. Explicit final submit requires complete disclosures, confirmed extraction corrections, no unresolved questions, exact current reviewed revision and reconciled confirmed/pending payment allocations. Commit SUBMISSION_PENDING and dispatch intent together. SUBMITTED requires external mock dispatch evidence; ISSUED/active-cover language requires simulated issuance/effective-cover evidence.
- Serialize cancellation with dispatch claim. Unknown/in-flight dispatch must be reconciled before claiming unsubmitted cancellation or refundable entitlement. Origin refund and wallet credit consume one unique adjustment allocation and cannot both happen. Never reroute an uncertain origin refund to a new wallet credit.
- Application net settled = confirmed external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed wallet credits allocated to the application. Pending effects reserve funds. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations, never negative; a wallet-funded portion is not also counted as an external capture.
- Renewal creates a fresh linked application and quote and leaves the old policy unchanged. A renewal nudge cannot charge, create a real mandate or promise continuous/backdated cover.
- All insurer/payment decisions and funds remain mock/simulated. Assistance is source-grounded, read-only and owner-scoped; it cannot underwrite, mutate confirmed answers, submit proposals or move money. No real PII, medical documents, credentials, provider calls, cloud spending or launch is authorized.
These are constraints on the bounded daily seam, not additional daily implementation tasks.

User-requested extension, proposed 14 October 2026:
Journey UUIDs identify records and never authorize access. ApplicationRevision and the quote own answers and accepted terms; journey is a server-maintained navigation projection, not a second mutable draft. Anonymous discovery keeps only public device-local selections; after login an explicit owned handoff validates the source/scenario. GET /api/v1/me/journeys returns minimal owned resume summaries, limit 1–50, default 20, with owner-bound cursors. GET /api/v1/journeys/{id} returns the same safe 404 for missing and foreign IDs. Reload/new session recomputes allowed actions from authoritative domain state.
A server-validated domain transition, required transaction audit, journey projection and journey step event share one PostgreSQL unit of work through public interfaces. Unique (journey_id, sequence) and (journey_id, causation_id, event_code) prevent duplicate advancement. Transaction audit references actual payment/journal/adjustment/submission/renewal effects, retains failed/unknown/reconciled observations and appends corrections. Browser clicks and client timestamps never prove or order these effects.
POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most ten per batch, maximum 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Schema 1 permits only event_id, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id when ownership permits, event_name PAGE_VIEW or CONTROL_CLICK, allowlisted page_id/step_code/target_id, optional bounded duration/client time and policy metadata. No arbitrary properties, forms, health answers, amounts, email, tokens, raw URLs/referrers or DOM text. Server receive time is authoritative for receipt only. Exact event-ID replay is DUPLICATE; changed payload conflicts 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT. Invalid schema is 400, oversized body 413, rate limit 429. A 202 receipt is RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY and says nothing about business success. Browser queue is capped at twenty events and three attempts; loss/drop/reordering is allowed and cannot block checkout or owned resume. Policy-disabled clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without persisted payload. Retention/purpose/consent rules are configurable; no third-party destination or indefinite storage is assumed.
Selected synthetic consumer payloads use the prepared maintained AEAD/envelope port, proposed AES-256-GCM with a 12-byte IV and 128-bit tag. Owner checks precede decrypt. AAD binds immutable opaque object ID plus object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version; it is not secret and never enters logs/analytics. Store ciphertext and wrapped data key, never plaintext fallback or wrapping key in the database/browser/repository. IV uniqueness is required under each data key outside fixed test-vector mode. Rotation preserves business IDs/content and has its own envelope revision. In-memory test keys prove only their process lifetime; restart/restore recovery is BLOCKED without a prepared authorized retained teaching-key mechanism. Missing key is KEY_UNAVAILABLE, not empty data or recovery success. Field encryption does not prove deployment TLS, encrypted volumes/backups or legal compliance; those remain explicit configuration/evidence gates. No real key creation, KMS grant, credential or security-setting mutation is authorized.
These additions replace existing seam work; they do not add minutes. The exact new interfaces and fixtures are teaching proposals, distinct from recovered ECOS rules.
Preserve ApplicationRevision's recovered composite key: journey (application_id, application_revision) references ApplicationRevision (application_id, revision). Do not add a revision UUID or mutable plaintext journey copy. Initial journey statuses are ACTIVE, WAITING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED and EXPIRED. Current steps use the shared registry, including FINAL_REVIEW rather than an invented REVIEW step. The analytics allowlist uses lower-case page and control IDs from the versioned registry. PAGE_VIEW requires target_id absent. optional_duration_ms is an integer from 0 through 300000, with booleans invalid; client_time is absent or a valid aware timestamp, never authoritative order.
A pending operation reference is durable before an external mock call. A definite provider failure is committed with its FAILED state and audit observation in the result transaction. If that transaction rolls back, its audit row also rolls back; the prior pending/unknown reference remains for reconciliation. Never fabricate a definite outcome or claim a rolled-back audit row persisted.
Every model/isolated experiment is a bounded CoverStory module or engineering-evidence seam in the same capstone, feeding its actual ADR/release gate. It is not a detached toy project. Frontend exercises show component/state ownership, contract/data flow, route/reload/resume behavior, accessibility, safe errors and tests. Operating exercises show configuration/key boundaries, CI/rollback, SLO/failure, backups, capacity/cost evidence and ownership at the scope actually exercised.
Latest frontend teaching stack: TanStack React Query v5 owns server state and its in-memory cache. Form edits and router/UI state remain separate; no duplicate global store for fetched journey/application/quote data. SPA refresh uses session/bootstrap plus authenticated refetch and server-valid journey resume, not an assumed SSR hydration path. Query keys include bounded resource/version and owner/session scope; never put consumer answers or raw tokens in keys. Sensitive server-state cache is not persisted to browser storage. Cancel and clear owner-scoped queries on logout, expiry or owner change; late responses cannot repopulate a new session. Guard mutations with current domain/journey versions and exact accepted terms, then invalidate/refetch the affected server state. Cached data never authorizes payment, dispatch or issuance.
Shared UI uses parameterized accessible primitives and feature compositions, with Tailwind design tokens and finite typed variants. Avoid arbitrary dynamically constructed class names or a separate per-screen styling system. Use verified open-source Inter with system-ui fallback and readable hierarchy/spacing; Proxima Nova is no longer a dependency or licensing gate. Query, Tailwind and font packages are planned until the current repository and instructor scaffold are inspected. These changes replace the same frontend-state/design tasks and add no minutes.
Frontend stack details: one stable QueryClient at the app boundary; each domain owns typed key/options factories and query hooks. Shared primitives do not fetch from other domains. Preserve URL/deep-link filters. Set finite staleTime, gcTime and retry for each data class; 401/403/validation errors do not loop and writes have no blanket retry. Background refetch must not overwrite unsaved local form input. Optional persistence is restricted to a separately supplied synthetic public-reference experiment with a version buster and finite maxAge/gcTime; private caches and queued mutations remain excluded. No Next.js, TanStack Start or SSR is added.
Use Inter source and SIL Open Font License, retaining copyright/OFL with any later distributed assets. Font-display swap and observed fallback/layout-shift checks belong to the bounded design task. Shared paths are frontend/src/coverstory/shared/ui/, shared/theme/ and shared/query/. Tailwind official pages currently describe v4 @theme; inspect the actual installed major and do not upgrade silently.

Proposed canonical API v1 reconciliation, pending instructor review:
Use /api/v1 and catalog spelling. Recovered ECOS-19 contains both /api/v1/... and later /api/.../catalogue routes, and requestId versus correlationId errors. Map these explicitly in a versioned teaching adapter; no aliases, route implementation or compatibility are assumed. Canonical safe error is {code, message, fieldErrors, requestId, retryable}. Later correlationId is mapped to requestId without copying unsafe body text. Expected version and reviewed revision remain distinct.
The proposed acceptance record binds applicationId, expectedVersion, reviewedRevision, ratingRevision, quoteId, scenarioHash, configurationHash, sourceVersion, ruleVersion, termsHash, totalMinor, currency and consent to the authenticated owner. Exact field names/available DTOs must be reconciled at preflight; client owner/amount is never authority. The later source's SUBMISSION_PENDING/dispatch-evidence boundary supersedes the earlier shorthand that returned SUBMITTED immediately on submit. These are proposed teaching interfaces, not claims about existing endpoints.

The user-requested journey/audit/analytics/encryption schema is also proposed. An existing fixture-mode UI is not proof that these endpoints, transactions, keys or controls exist; instructor preparation and candidate-bound evidence are required.

### One concrete daily outcome

Exercise the existing local CI-equivalent check graph with one deliberate duplicate-submission failure and restore the disposable test change.

### Earlier mapped prerequisites

### Recovered source rules and explicit teaching choices

- [ECOS-2](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-2), sections: Decision; Validation and reversal.
- [ECOS-20](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-20), sections: Signals and proposed targets; Capacity and benchmark; Failure and recovery matrix; QA acceptance matrix.
- [ECOS-48](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-48), sections: Scope; Acceptance criteria.
- [ECOS-65](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-65), sections: Onboarding and proposal boundary; Dependencies and evidence.

Recovered product constraints for this slice:
- React → Spring modular monolith → PostgreSQL. Catalog, Shortlist, Application, Payments, Policy and Support own their data and communicate through public interfaces; no cross-module repositories. Initial runtime has no shared cache, broker or second database.
- Unknown, Verified and Synthetic describe distinct evidence states. Historical ECOS illustrations/tariffs and teaching fixture prices are not current payable quotes. Unsupported scenarios show Quote unavailable; source version, scenario and terms remain attributable.
- Product money is integer minor units plus currency. Preserve original versus edited rating/configuration revisions. Every changed amount, terms, options or revision requires explicit review and exact acceptance, including changes of 1 or 100 paise. The historical 100-paise threshold is an escalation boundary, not permission to accept small changes silently.
- Confirmed mock payment unlocks onboarding only. Explicit final submit requires complete disclosures, confirmed extraction corrections, no unresolved questions, exact current reviewed revision and reconciled confirmed/pending payment allocations. Commit SUBMISSION_PENDING and dispatch intent together. SUBMITTED requires external mock dispatch evidence; ISSUED/active-cover language requires simulated issuance/effective-cover evidence.
- Serialize cancellation with dispatch claim. Unknown/in-flight dispatch must be reconciled before claiming unsubmitted cancellation or refundable entitlement. Origin refund and wallet credit consume one unique adjustment allocation and cannot both happen. Never reroute an uncertain origin refund to a new wallet credit.
- Application net settled = confirmed external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed wallet credits allocated to the application. Pending effects reserve funds. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations, never negative; a wallet-funded portion is not also counted as an external capture.
- Renewal creates a fresh linked application and quote and leaves the old policy unchanged. A renewal nudge cannot charge, create a real mandate or promise continuous/backdated cover.
- All insurer/payment decisions and funds remain mock/simulated. Assistance is source-grounded, read-only and owner-scoped; it cannot underwrite, mutate confirmed answers, submit proposals or move money. No real PII, medical documents, credentials, provider calls, cloud spending or launch is authorized.
These are constraints on the bounded daily seam, not additional daily implementation tasks.

User-requested extension, proposed 14 October 2026:
Journey UUIDs identify records and never authorize access. ApplicationRevision and the quote own answers and accepted terms; journey is a server-maintained navigation projection, not a second mutable draft. Anonymous discovery keeps only public device-local selections; after login an explicit owned handoff validates the source/scenario. GET /api/v1/me/journeys returns minimal owned resume summaries, limit 1–50, default 20, with owner-bound cursors. GET /api/v1/journeys/{id} returns the same safe 404 for missing and foreign IDs. Reload/new session recomputes allowed actions from authoritative domain state.
A server-validated domain transition, required transaction audit, journey projection and journey step event share one PostgreSQL unit of work through public interfaces. Unique (journey_id, sequence) and (journey_id, causation_id, event_code) prevent duplicate advancement. Transaction audit references actual payment/journal/adjustment/submission/renewal effects, retains failed/unknown/reconciled observations and appends corrections. Browser clicks and client timestamps never prove or order these effects.
POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most ten per batch, maximum 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Schema 1 permits only event_id, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id when ownership permits, event_name PAGE_VIEW or CONTROL_CLICK, allowlisted page_id/step_code/target_id, optional bounded duration/client time and policy metadata. No arbitrary properties, forms, health answers, amounts, email, tokens, raw URLs/referrers or DOM text. Server receive time is authoritative for receipt only. Exact event-ID replay is DUPLICATE; changed payload conflicts 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT. Invalid schema is 400, oversized body 413, rate limit 429. A 202 receipt is RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY and says nothing about business success. Browser queue is capped at twenty events and three attempts; loss/drop/reordering is allowed and cannot block checkout or owned resume. Policy-disabled clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without persisted payload. Retention/purpose/consent rules are configurable; no third-party destination or indefinite storage is assumed.
Selected synthetic consumer payloads use the prepared maintained AEAD/envelope port, proposed AES-256-GCM with a 12-byte IV and 128-bit tag. Owner checks precede decrypt. AAD binds immutable opaque object ID plus object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version; it is not secret and never enters logs/analytics. Store ciphertext and wrapped data key, never plaintext fallback or wrapping key in the database/browser/repository. IV uniqueness is required under each data key outside fixed test-vector mode. Rotation preserves business IDs/content and has its own envelope revision. In-memory test keys prove only their process lifetime; restart/restore recovery is BLOCKED without a prepared authorized retained teaching-key mechanism. Missing key is KEY_UNAVAILABLE, not empty data or recovery success. Field encryption does not prove deployment TLS, encrypted volumes/backups or legal compliance; those remain explicit configuration/evidence gates. No real key creation, KMS grant, credential or security-setting mutation is authorized.
These additions replace existing seam work; they do not add minutes. The exact new interfaces and fixtures are teaching proposals, distinct from recovered ECOS rules.
Preserve ApplicationRevision's recovered composite key: journey (application_id, application_revision) references ApplicationRevision (application_id, revision). Do not add a revision UUID or mutable plaintext journey copy. Initial journey statuses are ACTIVE, WAITING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED and EXPIRED. Current steps use the shared registry, including FINAL_REVIEW rather than an invented REVIEW step. The analytics allowlist uses lower-case page and control IDs from the versioned registry. PAGE_VIEW requires target_id absent. optional_duration_ms is an integer from 0 through 300000, with booleans invalid; client_time is absent or a valid aware timestamp, never authoritative order.
A pending operation reference is durable before an external mock call. A definite provider failure is committed with its FAILED state and audit observation in the result transaction. If that transaction rolls back, its audit row also rolls back; the prior pending/unknown reference remains for reconciliation. Never fabricate a definite outcome or claim a rolled-back audit row persisted.
Every model/isolated experiment is a bounded CoverStory module or engineering-evidence seam in the same capstone, feeding its actual ADR/release gate. It is not a detached toy project. Frontend exercises show component/state ownership, contract/data flow, route/reload/resume behavior, accessibility, safe errors and tests. Operating exercises show configuration/key boundaries, CI/rollback, SLO/failure, backups, capacity/cost evidence and ownership at the scope actually exercised.
Latest frontend teaching stack: TanStack React Query v5 owns server state and its in-memory cache. Form edits and router/UI state remain separate; no duplicate global store for fetched journey/application/quote data. SPA refresh uses session/bootstrap plus authenticated refetch and server-valid journey resume, not an assumed SSR hydration path. Query keys include bounded resource/version and owner/session scope; never put consumer answers or raw tokens in keys. Sensitive server-state cache is not persisted to browser storage. Cancel and clear owner-scoped queries on logout, expiry or owner change; late responses cannot repopulate a new session. Guard mutations with current domain/journey versions and exact accepted terms, then invalidate/refetch the affected server state. Cached data never authorizes payment, dispatch or issuance.
Shared UI uses parameterized accessible primitives and feature compositions, with Tailwind design tokens and finite typed variants. Avoid arbitrary dynamically constructed class names or a separate per-screen styling system. Use verified open-source Inter with system-ui fallback and readable hierarchy/spacing; Proxima Nova is no longer a dependency or licensing gate. Query, Tailwind and font packages are planned until the current repository and instructor scaffold are inspected. These changes replace the same frontend-state/design tasks and add no minutes.
Frontend stack details: one stable QueryClient at the app boundary; each domain owns typed key/options factories and query hooks. Shared primitives do not fetch from other domains. Preserve URL/deep-link filters. Set finite staleTime, gcTime and retry for each data class; 401/403/validation errors do not loop and writes have no blanket retry. Background refetch must not overwrite unsaved local form input. Optional persistence is restricted to a separately supplied synthetic public-reference experiment with a version buster and finite maxAge/gcTime; private caches and queued mutations remain excluded. No Next.js, TanStack Start or SSR is added.
Use Inter source and SIL Open Font License, retaining copyright/OFL with any later distributed assets. Font-display swap and observed fallback/layout-shift checks belong to the bounded design task. Shared paths are frontend/src/coverstory/shared/ui/, shared/theme/ and shared/query/. Tailwind official pages currently describe v4 @theme; inspect the actual installed major and do not upgrade silently.

Proposed canonical API v1 reconciliation, pending instructor review:
Use /api/v1 and catalog spelling. Recovered ECOS-19 contains both /api/v1/... and later /api/.../catalogue routes, and requestId versus correlationId errors. Map these explicitly in a versioned teaching adapter; no aliases, route implementation or compatibility are assumed. Canonical safe error is {code, message, fieldErrors, requestId, retryable}. The proposed acceptance record binds applicationId, expectedVersion, reviewedRevision, ratingRevision, quoteId, scenarioHash, configurationHash, sourceVersion, ruleVersion, termsHash, totalMinor, currency and consent to the authenticated owner. Exact field names/available DTOs must be reconciled at preflight; client owner/amount is never authority. The later source's SUBMISSION_PENDING/dispatch-evidence boundary supersedes the earlier shorthand that returned SUBMITTED immediately on submit. These are proposed teaching interfaces, not claims about existing endpoints.

Existing frontend decoders, cancellation/stale-response handling, session reset, safe errors and accessibility scaffolds may be reused only after inspection. OperatorApi/EventStatus require explicit replacement or adapter; product modules, public interfaces and forbidden-import/cycle checks remain planned instructor prerequisites.
The published Java 21/Maven and embedded PostgreSQL starter, including reported commit d623bf4bd16c6b437aa9e8908b2454c5e0256410, establishes only narrow scaffolding. Historical TODO failures, reported later fixes, this mapping and recovered design documents do not prove a solvable exercise or completed product. Before assignment, inspect the current checkout, prepare the named fixture/glue, reconcile exact API/command/test selectors and independently rehearse the full day inside its budget. If a predecessor is HOLD or physical evidence is absent, the dependent integrated result remains blocked. An explicitly isolated contract exercise may continue but cannot close that product gate.
The user-requested journey/audit/analytics/encryption schema is also proposed. An existing fixture-mode UI is not proof that these endpoints, transactions, keys or controls exist; instructor preparation and candidate-bound evidence are required.

### One concrete daily outcome

Implement/test one configuration preflight for the existing local target; produce a priced-cloud/access gate only as an unexecuted note.

### Earlier mapped prerequisites

- CAP-25, Day 167 (2027-03-29): reviewed evidence required.
- CAP-188, Day 168 (2027-03-30): reviewed evidence required.

### Recovered source rules and explicit teaching choices

- [ECOS-16](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-16), sections: Decision and requirements; Validation and revisit trigger.
- [ECOS-19](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-19), sections: Context and modules; API v1; Configuration, wallet and policy lifecycle contract.
- [ECOS-20](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-20), sections: Signals and proposed targets; Capacity and benchmark; Failure and recovery matrix; QA acceptance matrix.
- [ECOS-44](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-44), sections: Scope; Acceptance criteria.

Recovered product constraints for this slice:
- React → Spring modular monolith → PostgreSQL. Catalog, Shortlist, Application, Payments, Policy and Support own their data and communicate through public interfaces; no cross-module repositories. Initial runtime has no shared cache, broker or second database.
- Unknown, Verified and Synthetic describe distinct evidence states. Historical ECOS illustrations/tariffs and teaching fixture prices are not current payable quotes. Unsupported scenarios show Quote unavailable; source version, scenario and terms remain attributable.
- Product money is integer minor units plus currency. Preserve original versus edited rating/configuration revisions. Every changed amount, terms, options or revision requires explicit review and exact acceptance, including changes of 1 or 100 paise. The historical 100-paise threshold is an escalation boundary, not permission to accept small changes silently.
- Confirmed mock payment unlocks onboarding only. Explicit final submit requires complete disclosures, confirmed extraction corrections, no unresolved questions, exact current reviewed revision and reconciled confirmed/pending payment allocations. Commit SUBMISSION_PENDING and dispatch intent together. SUBMITTED requires external mock dispatch evidence; ISSUED/active-cover language requires simulated issuance/effective-cover evidence.
- Serialize cancellation with dispatch claim. Unknown/in-flight dispatch must be reconciled before claiming unsubmitted cancellation or refundable entitlement. Origin refund and wallet credit consume one unique adjustment allocation and cannot both happen. Never reroute an uncertain origin refund to a new wallet credit.
- Application net settled = confirmed external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed wallet credits allocated to the application. Pending effects reserve funds. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations, never negative; a wallet-funded portion is not also counted as an external capture.
- Renewal creates a fresh linked application and quote and leaves the old policy unchanged. A renewal nudge cannot charge, create a real mandate or promise continuous/backdated cover.
- All insurer/payment decisions and funds remain mock/simulated. Assistance is source-grounded, read-only and owner-scoped; it cannot underwrite, mutate confirmed answers, submit proposals or move money. No real PII, medical documents, credentials, provider calls, cloud spending or launch is authorized.
These are constraints on the bounded daily seam, not additional daily implementation tasks.

User-requested extension, proposed 14 October 2026:
Journey UUIDs identify records and never authorize access. ApplicationRevision and the quote own answers and accepted terms; journey is a server-maintained navigation projection, not a second mutable draft. Anonymous discovery keeps only public device-local selections; after login an explicit owned handoff validates the source/scenario. GET /api/v1/me/journeys returns minimal owned resume summaries, limit 1–50, default 20, with owner-bound cursors. GET /api/v1/journeys/{id} returns the same safe 404 for missing and foreign IDs. Reload/new session recomputes allowed actions from authoritative domain state.
A server-validated domain transition, required transaction audit, journey projection and journey step event share one PostgreSQL unit of work through public interfaces. Unique (journey_id, sequence) and (journey_id, causation_id, event_code) prevent duplicate advancement. Transaction audit references actual payment/journal/adjustment/submission/renewal effects, retains failed/unknown/reconciled observations and appends corrections. Browser clicks and client timestamps never prove or order these effects.
POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most ten per batch, maximum 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Schema 1 permits only event_id, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id when ownership permits, event_name PAGE_VIEW or CONTROL_CLICK, allowlisted page_id/step_code/target_id, optional bounded duration/client time and policy metadata. No arbitrary properties, forms, health answers, amounts, email, tokens, raw URLs/referrers or DOM text. Server receive time is authoritative for receipt only. Exact event-ID replay is DUPLICATE; changed payload conflicts 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT. Invalid schema is 400, oversized body 413, rate limit 429. A 202 receipt is RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY and says nothing about business success. Browser queue is capped at twenty events and three attempts; loss/drop/reordering is allowed and cannot block checkout or owned resume. Policy-disabled clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without persisted payload. Retention/purpose/consent rules are configurable; no third-party destination or indefinite storage is assumed.
Selected synthetic consumer payloads use the prepared maintained AEAD/envelope port, proposed AES-256-GCM with a 12-byte IV and 128-bit tag. Owner checks precede decrypt. AAD binds immutable opaque object ID plus object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version; it is not secret and never enters logs/analytics. Store ciphertext and wrapped data key, never plaintext fallback or wrapping key in the database/browser/repository. IV uniqueness is required under each data key outside fixed test-vector mode. Rotation preserves business IDs/content and has its own envelope revision. In-memory test keys prove only their process lifetime; restart/restore recovery is BLOCKED without a prepared authorized retained teaching-key mechanism. Missing key is KEY_UNAVAILABLE, not empty data or recovery success. Field encryption does not prove deployment TLS, encrypted volumes/backups or legal compliance; those remain explicit configuration/evidence gates. No real key creation, KMS grant, credential or security-setting mutation is authorized.
These additions replace existing seam work; they do not add minutes. The exact new interfaces and fixtures are teaching proposals, distinct from recovered ECOS rules.
Preserve ApplicationRevision's recovered composite key: journey (application_id, application_revision) references ApplicationRevision (application_id, revision). Do not add a revision UUID or mutable plaintext journey copy. Initial journey statuses are ACTIVE, WAITING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED and EXPIRED. Current steps use the shared registry, including FINAL_REVIEW rather than an invented REVIEW step. The analytics allowlist uses lower-case page and control IDs from the versioned registry. PAGE_VIEW requires target_id absent. optional_duration_ms is an integer from 0 through 300000, with booleans invalid; client_time is absent or a valid aware timestamp, never authoritative order.
A pending operation reference is durable before an external mock call. A definite provider failure is committed with its FAILED state and audit observation in the result transaction. If that transaction rolls back, its audit row also rolls back; the prior pending/unknown reference remains for reconciliation. Never fabricate a definite outcome or claim a rolled-back audit row persisted.
Every model/isolated experiment is a bounded CoverStory module or engineering-evidence seam in the same capstone, feeding its actual ADR/release gate. It is not a detached toy project. Frontend exercises show component/state ownership, contract/data flow, route/reload/resume behavior, accessibility, safe errors and tests. Operating exercises show configuration/key boundaries, CI/rollback, SLO/failure, backups, capacity/cost evidence and ownership at the scope actually exercised.
Latest frontend teaching stack: TanStack React Query v5 owns server state and its in-memory cache. Form edits and router/UI state remain separate; no duplicate global store for fetched journey/application/quote data. SPA refresh uses session/bootstrap plus authenticated refetch and server-valid journey resume, not an assumed SSR hydration path. Query keys include bounded resource/version and owner/session scope; never put consumer answers or raw tokens in keys. Sensitive server-state cache is not persisted to browser storage. Cancel and clear owner-scoped queries on logout, expiry or owner change; late responses cannot repopulate a new session. Guard mutations with current domain/journey versions and exact accepted terms, then invalidate/refetch the affected server state. Cached data never authorizes payment, dispatch or issuance.
Shared UI uses parameterized accessible primitives and feature compositions, with Tailwind design tokens and finite typed variants. Avoid arbitrary dynamically constructed class names or a separate per-screen styling system. Use verified open-source Inter with system-ui fallback and readable hierarchy/spacing; Proxima Nova is no longer a dependency or licensing gate. Query, Tailwind and font packages are planned until the current repository and instructor scaffold are inspected. These changes replace the same frontend-state/design tasks and add no minutes.
Frontend stack details: one stable QueryClient at the app boundary; each domain owns typed key/options factories and query hooks. Shared primitives do not fetch from other domains. Preserve URL/deep-link filters. Set finite staleTime, gcTime and retry for each data class; 401/403/validation errors do not loop and writes have no blanket retry. Background refetch must not overwrite unsaved local form input. Optional persistence is restricted to a separately supplied synthetic public-reference experiment with a version buster and finite maxAge/gcTime; private caches and queued mutations remain excluded. No Next.js, TanStack Start or SSR is added.
Use Inter source and SIL Open Font License, retaining copyright/OFL with any later distributed assets. Font-display swap and observed fallback/layout-shift checks belong to the bounded design task. Shared paths are frontend/src/coverstory/shared/ui/, shared/theme/ and shared/query/. Tailwind official pages currently describe v4 @theme; inspect the actual installed major and do not upgrade silently.

Proposed canonical API v1 reconciliation, pending instructor review:
Use /api/v1 and catalog spelling. Recovered ECOS-19 contains both /api/v1/... and later /api/.../catalogue routes, and requestId versus correlationId errors. Map these explicitly in a versioned teaching adapter; no aliases, route implementation or compatibility are assumed. Canonical safe error is {code, message, fieldErrors, requestId, retryable}. Later correlationId is mapped to requestId without copying unsafe body text. Expected version and reviewed revision remain distinct.
The proposed acceptance record binds applicationId, expectedVersion, reviewedRevision, ratingRevision, quoteId, scenarioHash, configurationHash, sourceVersion, ruleVersion, termsHash, totalMinor, currency and consent to the authenticated owner. Exact field names/available DTOs must be reconciled at preflight; client owner/amount is never authority. The later source's SUBMISSION_PENDING/dispatch-evidence boundary supersedes the earlier shorthand that returned SUBMITTED immediately on submit. These are proposed teaching interfaces, not claims about existing endpoints.

Known local disposable target; synthetic database name; required config keys and schema compatibility; no cloud credentials, monthly budget or paid target authorization.

Instructor ownership: supply typed DTOs and public-port signatures, exact synthetic inputs and visible fixed acceptance fixtures, fake Clock/deterministic scheduler, isolated PostgreSQL wiring where durability matters, read-only mock/model ports, safe fixture reset and an evidence serializer. CAP-28 · Day 171 · 2027-04-02 · Smoke-test the configured customer journey

Execution/readiness gate: PROPOSED_NOT_PREPARED and NOT_RUN. The earlier mapped health capability is contingent on prerequisite evidence. At this audit the current repository has React fixture mode and a Spring /health seam, not verified CoverStory product wiring. Existing frontend decoders, cancellation/stale-response handling, session reset, safe errors and accessibility scaffolds may be reused only after inspection. OperatorApi/EventStatus require explicit replacement or adapter; product modules, public interfaces and forbidden-import/cycle checks remain planned instructor prerequisites.
The published Java 21/Maven and embedded PostgreSQL starter, including reported commit d623bf4bd16c6b437aa9e8908b2454c5e0256410, establishes only narrow scaffolding. Historical TODO failures, reported later fixes, this mapping and recovered design documents do not prove a solvable exercise or completed product. Before assignment, inspect the current checkout, prepare the named fixture/glue, reconcile exact API/command/test selectors and independently rehearse the full day inside its budget. If a predecessor is HOLD or physical evidence is absent, the dependent integrated result remains blocked. An explicitly isolated contract exercise may continue but cannot close that product gate.
The user-requested journey/audit/analytics/encryption schema is also proposed. An existing fixture-mode UI is not proof that these endpoints, transactions, keys or controls exist; instructor preparation and candidate-bound evidence are required.

### One concrete daily outcome

Complete one smoke assertion seam and execute the prepared bounded customer journey on the available local target.

### Earlier mapped prerequisites

- CAP-24, Day 166 (2027-03-28): reviewed evidence required.
- CAP-27, Day 170 (2027-04-01): reviewed evidence required.

### Recovered source rules and explicit teaching choices

- [ECOS-20](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-20), sections: Signals and proposed targets; Capacity and benchmark; Failure and recovery matrix; QA acceptance matrix.
- [ECOS-44](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-44), sections: Scope; Acceptance criteria.
- [ECOS-63](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-63), sections: Acceptance criteria; Outcome.
- [ECOS-65](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-65), sections: Onboarding and proposal boundary; Dependencies and evidence.
- [ECOS-66](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-66), sections: Refund destination and mock wallet; Dependencies and evidence.
- [ECOS-68](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-68), sections: Renewal and cancellation; Dependencies and evidence.

Recovered product constraints for this slice:
- React → Spring modular monolith → PostgreSQL. Catalog, Shortlist, Application, Payments, Policy and Support own their data and communicate through public interfaces; no cross-module repositories. Initial runtime has no shared cache, broker or second database.
- Unknown, Verified and Synthetic describe distinct evidence states. Historical ECOS illustrations/tariffs and teaching fixture prices are not current payable quotes. Unsupported scenarios show Quote unavailable; source version, scenario and terms remain attributable.
- Product money is integer minor units plus currency. Preserve original versus edited rating/configuration revisions. Every changed amount, terms, options or revision requires explicit review and exact acceptance, including changes of 1 or 100 paise. The historical 100-paise threshold is an escalation boundary, not permission to accept small changes silently.
- Confirmed mock payment unlocks onboarding only. Explicit final submit requires complete disclosures, confirmed extraction corrections, no unresolved questions, exact current reviewed revision and reconciled confirmed/pending payment allocations. Commit SUBMISSION_PENDING and dispatch intent together. SUBMITTED requires external mock dispatch evidence; ISSUED/active-cover language requires simulated issuance/effective-cover evidence.
- Serialize cancellation with dispatch claim. Unknown/in-flight dispatch must be reconciled before claiming unsubmitted cancellation or refundable entitlement. Origin refund and wallet credit consume one unique adjustment allocation and cannot both happen. Never reroute an uncertain origin refund to a new wallet credit.
- Application net settled = confirmed external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed wallet credits allocated to the application. Pending effects reserve funds. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations, never negative; a wallet-funded portion is not also counted as an external capture.
- Renewal creates a fresh linked application and quote and leaves the old policy unchanged. A renewal nudge cannot charge, create a real mandate or promise continuous/backdated cover.
- All insurer/payment decisions and funds remain mock/simulated. Assistance is source-grounded, read-only and owner-scoped; it cannot underwrite, mutate confirmed answers, submit proposals or move money. No real PII, medical documents, credentials, provider calls, cloud spending or launch is authorized.
These are constraints on the bounded daily seam, not additional daily implementation tasks.

User-requested extension, proposed 14 October 2026:
Journey UUIDs identify records and never authorize access. ApplicationRevision and the quote own answers and accepted terms; journey is a server-maintained navigation projection, not a second mutable draft. Anonymous discovery keeps only public device-local selections; after login an explicit owned handoff validates the source/scenario. GET /api/v1/me/journeys returns minimal owned resume summaries, limit 1–50, default 20, with owner-bound cursors. GET /api/v1/journeys/{id} returns the same safe 404 for missing and foreign IDs. Reload/new session recomputes allowed actions from authoritative domain state.
A server-validated domain transition, required transaction audit, journey projection and journey step event share one PostgreSQL unit of work through public interfaces. Unique (journey_id, sequence) and (journey_id, causation_id, event_code) prevent duplicate advancement. Transaction audit references actual payment/journal/adjustment/submission/renewal effects, retains failed/unknown/reconciled observations and appends corrections. Browser clicks and client timestamps never prove or order these effects.
POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most ten per batch, maximum 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Schema 1 permits only event_id, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id when ownership permits, event_name PAGE_VIEW or CONTROL_CLICK, allowlisted page_id/step_code/target_id, optional bounded duration/client time and policy metadata. No arbitrary properties, forms, health answers, amounts, email, tokens, raw URLs/referrers or DOM text. Server receive time is authoritative for receipt only. Exact event-ID replay is DUPLICATE; changed payload conflicts 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT. Invalid schema is 400, oversized body 413, rate limit 429. A 202 receipt is RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY and says nothing about business success. Browser queue is capped at twenty events and three attempts; loss/drop/reordering is allowed and cannot block checkout or owned resume. Policy-disabled clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without persisted payload. Retention/purpose/consent rules are configurable; no third-party destination or indefinite storage is assumed.
Selected synthetic consumer payloads use the prepared maintained AEAD/envelope port, proposed AES-256-GCM with a 12-byte IV and 128-bit tag. Owner checks precede decrypt. AAD binds immutable opaque object ID plus object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version; it is not secret and never enters logs/analytics. Store ciphertext and wrapped data key, never plaintext fallback or wrapping key in the database/browser/repository. IV uniqueness is required under each data key outside fixed test-vector mode. Rotation preserves business IDs/content and has its own envelope revision. In-memory test keys prove only their process lifetime; restart/restore recovery is BLOCKED without a prepared authorized retained teaching-key mechanism. Missing key is KEY_UNAVAILABLE, not empty data or recovery success. Field encryption does not prove deployment TLS, encrypted volumes/backups or legal compliance; those remain explicit configuration/evidence gates. No real key creation, KMS grant, credential or security-setting mutation is authorized.
These additions replace existing seam work; they do not add minutes. The exact new interfaces and fixtures are teaching proposals, distinct from recovered ECOS rules.
Preserve ApplicationRevision's recovered composite key: journey (application_id, application_revision) references ApplicationRevision (application_id, revision). Do not add a revision UUID or mutable plaintext journey copy. Initial journey statuses are ACTIVE, WAITING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED and EXPIRED. Current steps use the shared registry, including FINAL_REVIEW rather than an invented REVIEW step. The analytics allowlist uses lower-case page and control IDs from the versioned registry. PAGE_VIEW requires target_id absent. optional_duration_ms is an integer from 0 through 300000, with booleans invalid; client_time is absent or a valid aware timestamp, never authoritative order.
A pending operation reference is durable before an external mock call. A definite provider failure is committed with its FAILED state and audit observation in the result transaction. If that transaction rolls back, its audit row also rolls back; the prior pending/unknown reference remains for reconciliation. Never fabricate a definite outcome or claim a rolled-back audit row persisted.
Every model/isolated experiment is a bounded CoverStory module or engineering-evidence seam in the same capstone, feeding its actual ADR/release gate. It is not a detached toy project. Frontend exercises show component/state ownership, contract/data flow, route/reload/resume behavior, accessibility, safe errors and tests. Operating exercises show configuration/key boundaries, CI/rollback, SLO/failure, backups, capacity/cost evidence and ownership at the scope actually exercised.
Latest frontend teaching stack: TanStack React Query v5 owns server state and its in-memory cache. Form edits and router/UI state remain separate; no duplicate global store for fetched journey/application/quote data. SPA refresh uses session/bootstrap plus authenticated refetch and server-valid journey resume, not an assumed SSR hydration path. Query keys include bounded resource/version and owner/session scope; never put consumer answers or raw tokens in keys. Sensitive server-state cache is not persisted to browser storage. Cancel and clear owner-scoped queries on logout, expiry or owner change; late responses cannot repopulate a new session. Guard mutations with current domain/journey versions and exact accepted terms, then invalidate/refetch the affected server state. Cached data never authorizes payment, dispatch or issuance.
Shared UI uses parameterized accessible primitives and feature compositions, with Tailwind design tokens and finite typed variants. Avoid arbitrary dynamically constructed class names or a separate per-screen styling system. Use verified open-source Inter with system-ui fallback and readable hierarchy/spacing; Proxima Nova is no longer a dependency or licensing gate. Query, Tailwind and font packages are planned until the current repository and instructor scaffold are inspected. These changes replace the same frontend-state/design tasks and add no minutes.
Frontend stack details: one stable QueryClient at the app boundary; each domain owns typed key/options factories and query hooks. Shared primitives do not fetch from other domains. Preserve URL/deep-link filters. Set finite staleTime, gcTime and retry for each data class; 401/403/validation errors do not loop and writes have no blanket retry. Background refetch must not overwrite unsaved local form input. Optional persistence is restricted to a separately supplied synthetic public-reference experiment with a version buster and finite maxAge/gcTime; private caches and queued mutations remain excluded. No Next.js, TanStack Start or SSR is added.
Use Inter source and SIL Open Font License, retaining copyright/OFL with any later distributed assets. Font-display swap and observed fallback/layout-shift checks belong to the bounded design task. Shared paths are frontend/src/coverstory/shared/ui/, shared/theme/ and shared/query/. Tailwind official pages currently describe v4 @theme; inspect the actual installed major and do not upgrade silently.

Proposed canonical API v1 reconciliation, pending instructor review:
Use /api/v1 and catalog spelling. Recovered ECOS-19 contains both /api/v1/... and later /api/.../catalogue routes, and requestId versus correlationId errors. Map these explicitly in a versioned teaching adapter; no aliases, route implementation or compatibility are assumed. Canonical safe error is {code, message, fieldErrors, requestId, retryable}. Later correlationId is mapped to requestId without copying unsafe body text. Expected version and reviewed revision remain distinct.
The proposed acceptance record binds applicationId, expectedVersion, reviewedRevision, ratingRevision, quoteId, scenarioHash, configurationHash, sourceVersion, ruleVersion, termsHash, totalMinor, currency and consent to the authenticated owner. Exact field names/available DTOs must be reconciled at preflight; client owner/amount is never authority. The later source's SUBMISSION_PENDING/dispatch-evidence boundary supersedes the earlier shorthand that returned SUBMITTED immediately on submit. These are proposed teaching interfaces, not claims about existing endpoints.

At most 20 synthetic requests/concurrency 2/60s; existing discovery, quote review, mock payment, onboarding, final-submit and status fixtures; one cross-owner denial and payment-unknown branch.

Instructor ownership: supply typed DTOs and public-port signatures, exact synthetic inputs and visible fixed acceptance fixtures, fake Clock/deterministic scheduler, isolated PostgreSQL wiring where durability matters, read-only mock/model ports, safe fixture reset and an evidence serializer. Historical TODO failures, reported later fixes, this mapping and recovered design documents do not prove a solvable exercise or completed product. The user-requested journey/audit/analytics/encryption schema is also proposed. An existing fixture-mode UI is not proof that these endpoints, transactions, keys or controls exist; instructor preparation and candidate-bound evidence are required.

### One concrete daily outcome

Complete a local fault-observation seam, inject one reversible database-unavailable fault through the supplied harness and verify safe readiness plus recovery.

### Earlier mapped prerequisites

- CAP-28, Day 171 (2027-04-02): reviewed evidence required.

### Recovered source rules and explicit teaching choices

- [ECOS-7](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-7), sections: Requirements and acceptance.
- [ECOS-15](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-15), sections: Decision and requirements; Validation and revisit trigger.
- [ECOS-20](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-20), sections: Signals and proposed targets; Capacity and benchmark; Failure and recovery matrix; QA acceptance matrix.
- [ECOS-44](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-44), sections: Scope; Acceptance criteria.
- [ECOS-62](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-62), sections: Acceptance criteria; Outcome.

Recovered product constraints for this slice:
- React → Spring modular monolith → PostgreSQL. Catalog, Shortlist, Application, Payments, Policy and Support own their data and communicate through public interfaces; no cross-module repositories. Initial runtime has no shared cache, broker or second database.
- Unknown, Verified and Synthetic describe distinct evidence states. Historical ECOS illustrations/tariffs and teaching fixture prices are not current payable quotes. Unsupported scenarios show Quote unavailable; source version, scenario and terms remain attributable.
- Product money is integer minor units plus currency. Preserve original versus edited rating/configuration revisions. Every changed amount, terms, options or revision requires explicit review and exact acceptance, including changes of 1 or 100 paise. The historical 100-paise threshold is an escalation boundary, not permission to accept small changes silently.
- Confirmed mock payment unlocks onboarding only. Explicit final submit requires complete disclosures, confirmed extraction corrections, no unresolved questions, exact current reviewed revision and reconciled confirmed/pending payment allocations. Commit SUBMISSION_PENDING and dispatch intent together. SUBMITTED requires external mock dispatch evidence; ISSUED/active-cover language requires simulated issuance/effective-cover evidence.
- Serialize cancellation with dispatch claim. Unknown/in-flight dispatch must be reconciled before claiming unsubmitted cancellation or refundable entitlement. Origin refund and wallet credit consume one unique adjustment allocation and cannot both happen. Never reroute an uncertain origin refund to a new wallet credit.
- Application net settled = confirmed external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed wallet credits allocated to the application. Pending effects reserve funds. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations, never negative; a wallet-funded portion is not also counted as an external capture.
- Renewal creates a fresh linked application and quote and leaves the old policy unchanged. A renewal nudge cannot charge, create a real mandate or promise continuous/backdated cover.
- All insurer/payment decisions and funds remain mock/simulated. Assistance is source-grounded, read-only and owner-scoped; it cannot underwrite, mutate confirmed answers, submit proposals or move money. No real PII, medical documents, credentials, provider calls, cloud spending or launch is authorized.
These are constraints on the bounded daily seam, not additional daily implementation tasks.

User-requested extension, proposed 14 October 2026:
Journey UUIDs identify records and never authorize access. ApplicationRevision and the quote own answers and accepted terms; journey is a server-maintained navigation projection, not a second mutable draft. Anonymous discovery keeps only public device-local selections; after login an explicit owned handoff validates the source/scenario. GET /api/v1/me/journeys returns minimal owned resume summaries, limit 1–50, default 20, with owner-bound cursors. GET /api/v1/journeys/{id} returns the same safe 404 for missing and foreign IDs. Reload/new session recomputes allowed actions from authoritative domain state.
A server-validated domain transition, required transaction audit, journey projection and journey step event share one PostgreSQL unit of work through public interfaces. Unique (journey_id, sequence) and (journey_id, causation_id, event_code) prevent duplicate advancement. Transaction audit references actual payment/journal/adjustment/submission/renewal effects, retains failed/unknown/reconciled observations and appends corrections. Browser clicks and client timestamps never prove or order these effects.
POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most ten per batch, maximum 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Schema 1 permits only event_id, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id when ownership permits, event_name PAGE_VIEW or CONTROL_CLICK, allowlisted page_id/step_code/target_id, optional bounded duration/client time and policy metadata. No arbitrary properties, forms, health answers, amounts, email, tokens, raw URLs/referrers or DOM text. Server receive time is authoritative for receipt only. Exact event-ID replay is DUPLICATE; changed payload conflicts 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT. Invalid schema is 400, oversized body 413, rate limit 429. A 202 receipt is RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY and says nothing about business success. Browser queue is capped at twenty events and three attempts; loss/drop/reordering is allowed and cannot block checkout or owned resume. Policy-disabled clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without persisted payload. Retention/purpose/consent rules are configurable; no third-party destination or indefinite storage is assumed.
Selected synthetic consumer payloads use the prepared maintained AEAD/envelope port, proposed AES-256-GCM with a 12-byte IV and 128-bit tag. Owner checks precede decrypt. AAD binds immutable opaque object ID plus object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version; it is not secret and never enters logs/analytics. Store ciphertext and wrapped data key, never plaintext fallback or wrapping key in the database/browser/repository. IV uniqueness is required under each data key outside fixed test-vector mode. Rotation preserves business IDs/content and has its own envelope revision. In-memory test keys prove only their process lifetime; restart/restore recovery is BLOCKED without a prepared authorized retained teaching-key mechanism. Missing key is KEY_UNAVAILABLE, not empty data or recovery success. Field encryption does not prove deployment TLS, encrypted volumes/backups or legal compliance; those remain explicit configuration/evidence gates. No real key creation, KMS grant, credential or security-setting mutation is authorized.
These additions replace existing seam work; they do not add minutes. The exact new interfaces and fixtures are teaching proposals, distinct from recovered ECOS rules.
Preserve ApplicationRevision's recovered composite key: journey (application_id, application_revision) references ApplicationRevision (application_id, revision). Do not add a revision UUID or mutable plaintext journey copy. Initial journey statuses are ACTIVE, WAITING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED and EXPIRED. Current steps use the shared registry, including FINAL_REVIEW rather than an invented REVIEW step. The analytics allowlist uses lower-case page and control IDs from the versioned registry. PAGE_VIEW requires target_id absent. optional_duration_ms is an integer from 0 through 300000, with booleans invalid; client_time is absent or a valid aware timestamp, never authoritative order.
A pending operation reference is durable before an external mock call. A definite provider failure is committed with its FAILED state and audit observation in the result transaction. If that transaction rolls back, its audit row also rolls back; the prior pending/unknown reference remains for reconciliation. Never fabricate a definite outcome or claim a rolled-back audit row persisted.
Every model/isolated experiment is a bounded CoverStory module or engineering-evidence seam in the same capstone, feeding its actual ADR/release gate. It is not a detached toy project. Frontend exercises show component/state ownership, contract/data flow, route/reload/resume behavior, accessibility, safe errors and tests. Operating exercises show configuration/key boundaries, CI/rollback, SLO/failure, backups, capacity/cost evidence and ownership at the scope actually exercised.
Latest frontend teaching stack: TanStack React Query v5 owns server state and its in-memory cache. Form edits and router/UI state remain separate; no duplicate global store for fetched journey/application/quote data. SPA refresh uses session/bootstrap plus authenticated refetch and server-valid journey resume, not an assumed SSR hydration path. Query keys include bounded resource/version and owner/session scope; never put consumer answers or raw tokens in keys. Sensitive server-state cache is not persisted to browser storage. Cancel and clear owner-scoped queries on logout, expiry or owner change; late responses cannot repopulate a new session. Guard mutations with current domain/journey versions and exact accepted terms, then invalidate/refetch the affected server state. Cached data never authorizes payment, dispatch or issuance.
Shared UI uses parameterized accessible primitives and feature compositions, with Tailwind design tokens and finite typed variants. Avoid arbitrary dynamically constructed class names or a separate per-screen styling system. Use verified open-source Inter with system-ui fallback and readable hierarchy/spacing; Proxima Nova is no longer a dependency or licensing gate. Query, Tailwind and font packages are planned until the current repository and instructor scaffold are inspected. These changes replace the same frontend-state/design tasks and add no minutes.
Frontend stack details: one stable QueryClient at the app boundary; each domain owns typed key/options factories and query hooks. Shared primitives do not fetch from other domains. Preserve URL/deep-link filters. Set finite staleTime, gcTime and retry for each data class; 401/403/validation errors do not loop and writes have no blanket retry. Background refetch must not overwrite unsaved local form input. Optional persistence is restricted to a separately supplied synthetic public-reference experiment with a version buster and finite maxAge/gcTime; private caches and queued mutations remain excluded. No Next.js, TanStack Start or SSR is added.

Shared paths are frontend/src/coverstory/shared/ui/, shared/theme/ and shared/query/.
