- [ECOS-48](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-48), sections: Scope; Acceptance criteria.
- [ECOS-63](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-63), sections: Acceptance criteria; Outcome.

Recovered product constraints for this slice:
- React → Spring modular monolith → PostgreSQL. Catalog, Shortlist, Application, Payments, Policy and Support own their data and communicate through public interfaces; no cross-module repositories. Initial runtime has no shared cache, broker or second database.
- Unknown, Verified and Synthetic describe distinct evidence states. Historical ECOS illustrations/tariffs and teaching fixture prices are not current payable quotes. Unsupported scenarios show Quote unavailable; source version, scenario and terms remain attributable.
- Product money is integer minor units plus currency. Preserve original versus edited rating/configuration revisions. Every changed amount, terms, options or revision requires explicit review and exact acceptance, including changes of 1 or 100 paise. The historical 100-paise threshold is an escalation boundary, not permission to accept small changes silently.
- Confirmed mock payment unlocks onboarding only. Explicit final submit requires complete disclosures, confirmed extraction corrections, no unresolved questions, exact current reviewed revision and reconciled confirmed/pending payment allocations. Commit SUBMISSION_PENDING and dispatch intent together. SUBMITTED requires external mock dispatch evidence; ISSUED/active-cover language requires simulated issuance/effective-cover evidence.
- Serialize cancellation with dispatch claim. Unknown/in-flight dispatch must be reconciled before claiming unsubmitted cancellation or refundable entitlement. Origin refund and wallet credit consume one unique adjustment allocation and cannot both happen. Never reroute an uncertain origin refund to a new wallet credit.
- Application net settled = confirmed external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed wallet credits allocated to the application. Pending effects reserve funds. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations, never negative; a wallet-funded portion is not also counted as an external capture.
- Renewal creates a fresh linked application and quote and leaves the old policy unchanged. A renewal nudge cannot charge, create a real mandate or promise continuous/backdated cover.
- All insurer/payment decisions and funds remain mock/simulated. Assistance is source-grounded, read-only and owner-scoped; it cannot underwrite, mutate confirmed answers, submit proposals or move money. No real PII, medical documents, credentials, provider calls, cloud spending or launch is authorized.
These are constraints on the bounded daily seam, not additional daily implementation tasks.

User-requested extension, proposed 14 October 2026:
Journey UUIDs identify records and never authorize access. ApplicationRevision and the quote own answers and accepted terms; journey is a server-maintained navigation projection, not a second mutable draft. Anonymous discovery keeps only public device-local selections; after login an explicit owned handoff validates the source/scenario. GET /api/v1/me/journeys returns minimal owned resume summaries, limit 1–50, default 20, with owner-bound cursors. GET /api/v1/journeys/{id} returns the same safe 404 for missing and foreign IDs. Reload/new session recomputes allowed actions from authoritative domain state.
A server-validated domain transition, required transaction audit, journey projection and journey step event share one PostgreSQL unit of work through public interfaces. Unique (journey_id, sequence) and (journey_id, causation_id, event_code) prevent duplicate advancement. Transaction audit references actual payment/journal/adjustment/submission/renewal effects, retains failed/unknown/reconciled observations and appends corrections. Browser clicks and client timestamps never prove or order these effects.
POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most ten per batch, maximum 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Schema 1 permits only event_id, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id when ownership permits, event_name PAGE_VIEW or CONTROL_CLICK, allowlisted page_id/step_code/target_id, optional bounded duration/client time and policy metadata. No arbitrary properties, forms, health answers, amounts, email, tokens, raw URLs/referrers or DOM text. Server receive time is authoritative for receipt only. Exact event-ID replay is DUPLICATE; changed payload conflicts 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT. Invalid schema is 400, oversized body 413, rate limit 429. A 202 receipt is RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY and says nothing about business success. Browser queue is capped at twenty events and three attempts; loss/drop/reordering is allowed and cannot block checkout or owned resume. Policy-disabled clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without persisted payload. Retention/purpose/consent rules are configurable; no third-party destination or indefinite storage is assumed.
Selected synthetic consumer payloads use the prepared maintained AEAD/envelope port, proposed AES-256-GCM with a 12-byte IV and 128-bit tag. Owner checks precede decrypt. AAD binds immutable opaque object ID plus object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version; it is not secret and never enters logs/analytics. Store ciphertext and wrapped data key, never plaintext fallback or wrapping key in the database/browser/repository. IV uniqueness is required under each data key outside fixed test-vector mode. Rotation preserves business IDs/content and has its own envelope revision. In-memory test keys prove only their process lifetime; restart/restore recovery is BLOCKED without a prepared authorized retained teaching-key mechanism. Missing key is KEY_UNAVAILABLE, not empty data or recovery success. Field encryption does not prove deployment TLS, encrypted volumes/backups or legal compliance; those remain explicit configuration/evidence gates. No real key creation, KMS grant, credential or security-setting mutation is authorized.
These additions replace existing seam work; they do not add minutes. The exact new interfaces and fixtures are teaching proposals, distinct from recovered ECOS rules.
Preserve ApplicationRevision's recovered composite key: journey (application_id, application_revision) references ApplicationRevision (application_id, revision). Do not add a revision UUID or mutable plaintext journey copy. Initial journey statuses are ACTIVE, WAITING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED and EXPIRED. Current steps use the shared registry, including FINAL_REVIEW rather than an invented REVIEW step. The analytics allowlist uses lower-case page and control IDs from the versioned registry. PAGE_VIEW requires target_id absent. optional_duration_ms is an integer from 0 through 300000, with booleans invalid; client_time is absent or a valid aware timestamp, never authoritative order.
A pending operation reference is durable before an external mock call. A definite provider failure is committed with its FAILED state and audit observation in the result transaction. If that transaction rolls back, its audit row also rolls back; the prior pending/unknown reference remains for reconciliation. Never fabricate a definite outcome or claim a rolled-back audit row persisted.
Every model/isolated experiment is a bounded CoverStory module or engineering-evidence seam in the same capstone, feeding its actual ADR/release gate. It is not a detached toy project. Frontend exercises show component/state ownership, contract/data flow, route/reload/resume behavior, accessibility, safe errors and tests. Operating exercises show configuration/key boundaries, CI/rollback, SLO/failure, backups, capacity/cost evidence and ownership at the scope actually exercised.
Latest frontend teaching stack: TanStack React Query v5 owns server state and its in-memory cache. Form edits and router/UI state remain separate; no duplicate global store for fetched journey/application/quote data. SPA refresh uses session/bootstrap plus authenticated refetch and server-valid journey resume, not an assumed SSR hydration path. Query keys include bounded resource/version and owner/session scope; never put consumer answers or raw tokens in keys. Sensitive server-state cache is not persisted to browser storage. Cancel and clear owner-scoped queries on logout, expiry or owner change; late responses cannot repopulate a new session. Guard mutations with current domain/journey versions and exact accepted terms, then invalidate/refetch the affected server state. Cached data never authorizes payment, dispatch or issuance.

Avoid arbitrary dynamically constructed class names or a separate per-screen styling system. Use verified open-source Inter with system-ui fallback and readable hierarchy/spacing; Proxima Nova is no longer a dependency or licensing gate. Query, Tailwind and font packages are planned until the current repository and instructor scaffold are inspected. These changes replace the same frontend-state/design tasks and add no minutes.
Frontend stack details: one stable QueryClient at the app boundary; each domain owns typed key/options factories and query hooks. Shared primitives do not fetch from other domains. Preserve URL/deep-link filters. Set finite staleTime, gcTime and retry for each data class; 401/403/validation errors do not loop and writes have no blanket retry. Background refetch must not overwrite unsaved local form input. Optional persistence is restricted to a separately supplied synthetic public-reference experiment with a version buster and finite maxAge/gcTime; private caches and queued mutations remain excluded. No Next.js, TanStack Start or SSR is added.

Shared paths are frontend/src/coverstory/shared/ui/, shared/theme/ and shared/query/. Proposed canonical API v1 reconciliation, pending instructor review:
Use /api/v1 and catalog spelling. Recovered ECOS-19 contains both /api/v1/... and later /api/.../catalogue routes, and requestId versus correlationId errors. Map these explicitly in a versioned teaching adapter; no aliases, route implementation or compatibility are assumed. Canonical safe error is {code, message, fieldErrors, requestId, retryable}. Later correlationId is mapped to requestId without copying unsafe body text. Expected version and reviewed revision remain distinct.
The proposed acceptance record binds applicationId, expectedVersion, reviewedRevision, ratingRevision, quoteId, scenarioHash, configurationHash, sourceVersion, ruleVersion, termsHash, totalMinor, currency and consent to the authenticated owner. Exact field names/available DTOs must be reconciled at preflight; client owner/amount is never authority. The later source's SUBMISSION_PENDING/dispatch-evidence boundary supersedes the earlier shorthand that returned SUBMITTED immediately on submit. These are proposed teaching interfaces, not claims about existing endpoints.

### One concrete daily outcome

Implement one optimistic-concurrency seam for a synthetic catalogue/rule configuration fixture, preserving public/private separation.

### Earlier mapped prerequisites

- CAP-191, Day 184 (2027-04-15): reviewed evidence required.

### Recovered source rules and explicit teaching choices

- [ECOS-10](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-10), sections: Decision and requirements; Validation and revisit trigger; Onboarding and proposal boundary.
- [ECOS-19](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-19), sections: Context and modules; API v1; Configuration, wallet and policy lifecycle contract.
- [ECOS-54](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-54), sections: Acceptance criteria.
- [ECOS-62](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-62), sections: Acceptance criteria; Outcome.

Recovered product constraints for this slice:
- React → Spring modular monolith → PostgreSQL. Catalog, Shortlist, Application, Payments, Policy and Support own their data and communicate through public interfaces; no cross-module repositories. Initial runtime has no shared cache, broker or second database.
- Unknown, Verified and Synthetic describe distinct evidence states. Historical ECOS illustrations/tariffs and teaching fixture prices are not current payable quotes. Unsupported scenarios show Quote unavailable; source version, scenario and terms remain attributable.
- Product money is integer minor units plus currency. Preserve original versus edited rating/configuration revisions. Every changed amount, terms, options or revision requires explicit review and exact acceptance, including changes of 1 or 100 paise. The historical 100-paise threshold is an escalation boundary, not permission to accept small changes silently.
- Confirmed mock payment unlocks onboarding only. Explicit final submit requires complete disclosures, confirmed extraction corrections, no unresolved questions, exact current reviewed revision and reconciled confirmed/pending payment allocations. Commit SUBMISSION_PENDING and dispatch intent together. SUBMITTED requires external mock dispatch evidence; ISSUED/active-cover language requires simulated issuance/effective-cover evidence.
- Serialize cancellation with dispatch claim. Unknown/in-flight dispatch must be reconciled before claiming unsubmitted cancellation or refundable entitlement. Origin refund and wallet credit consume one unique adjustment allocation and cannot both happen. Never reroute an uncertain origin refund to a new wallet credit.
- Application net settled = confirmed external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed wallet credits allocated to the application. Pending effects reserve funds. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations, never negative; a wallet-funded portion is not also counted as an external capture.
- Renewal creates a fresh linked application and quote and leaves the old policy unchanged. A renewal nudge cannot charge, create a real mandate or promise continuous/backdated cover.
- All insurer/payment decisions and funds remain mock/simulated. Assistance is source-grounded, read-only and owner-scoped; it cannot underwrite, mutate confirmed answers, submit proposals or move money. No real PII, medical documents, credentials, provider calls, cloud spending or launch is authorized.
These are constraints on the bounded daily seam, not additional daily implementation tasks.

User-requested extension, proposed 14 October 2026:
Journey UUIDs identify records and never authorize access. ApplicationRevision and the quote own answers and accepted terms; journey is a server-maintained navigation projection, not a second mutable draft. Anonymous discovery keeps only public device-local selections; after login an explicit owned handoff validates the source/scenario. GET /api/v1/me/journeys returns minimal owned resume summaries, limit 1–50, default 20, with owner-bound cursors. GET /api/v1/journeys/{id} returns the same safe 404 for missing and foreign IDs. Reload/new session recomputes allowed actions from authoritative domain state.
A server-validated domain transition, required transaction audit, journey projection and journey step event share one PostgreSQL unit of work through public interfaces. Unique (journey_id, sequence) and (journey_id, causation_id, event_code) prevent duplicate advancement. Transaction audit references actual payment/journal/adjustment/submission/renewal effects, retains failed/unknown/reconciled observations and appends corrections. Browser clicks and client timestamps never prove or order these effects.
POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most ten per batch, maximum 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Schema 1 permits only event_id, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id when ownership permits, event_name PAGE_VIEW or CONTROL_CLICK, allowlisted page_id/step_code/target_id, optional bounded duration/client time and policy metadata. No arbitrary properties, forms, health answers, amounts, email, tokens, raw URLs/referrers or DOM text. Server receive time is authoritative for receipt only. Exact event-ID replay is DUPLICATE; changed payload conflicts 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT. Invalid schema is 400, oversized body 413, rate limit 429. A 202 receipt is RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY and says nothing about business success. Browser queue is capped at twenty events and three attempts; loss/drop/reordering is allowed and cannot block checkout or owned resume. Policy-disabled clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without persisted payload. Retention/purpose/consent rules are configurable; no third-party destination or indefinite storage is assumed.
Selected synthetic consumer payloads use the prepared maintained AEAD/envelope port, proposed AES-256-GCM with a 12-byte IV and 128-bit tag. Owner checks precede decrypt. AAD binds immutable opaque object ID plus object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version; it is not secret and never enters logs/analytics. Store ciphertext and wrapped data key, never plaintext fallback or wrapping key in the database/browser/repository. IV uniqueness is required under each data key outside fixed test-vector mode. Rotation preserves business IDs/content and has its own envelope revision. In-memory test keys prove only their process lifetime; restart/restore recovery is BLOCKED without a prepared authorized retained teaching-key mechanism. Missing key is KEY_UNAVAILABLE, not empty data or recovery success. Field encryption does not prove deployment TLS, encrypted volumes/backups or legal compliance; those remain explicit configuration/evidence gates. No real key creation, KMS grant, credential or security-setting mutation is authorized.
These additions replace existing seam work; they do not add minutes. The exact new interfaces and fixtures are teaching proposals, distinct from recovered ECOS rules.
Preserve ApplicationRevision's recovered composite key: journey (application_id, application_revision) references ApplicationRevision (application_id, revision). Do not add a revision UUID or mutable plaintext journey copy. Initial journey statuses are ACTIVE, WAITING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED and EXPIRED. Current steps use the shared registry, including FINAL_REVIEW rather than an invented REVIEW step. The analytics allowlist uses lower-case page and control IDs from the versioned registry. PAGE_VIEW requires target_id absent. optional_duration_ms is an integer from 0 through 300000, with booleans invalid; client_time is absent or a valid aware timestamp, never authoritative order.
A pending operation reference is durable before an external mock call. A definite provider failure is committed with its FAILED state and audit observation in the result transaction. If that transaction rolls back, its audit row also rolls back; the prior pending/unknown reference remains for reconciliation. Never fabricate a definite outcome or claim a rolled-back audit row persisted.
Every model/isolated experiment is a bounded CoverStory module or engineering-evidence seam in the same capstone, feeding its actual ADR/release gate. It is not a detached toy project. Frontend exercises show component/state ownership, contract/data flow, route/reload/resume behavior, accessibility, safe errors and tests. SPA refresh uses session/bootstrap plus authenticated refetch and server-valid journey resume, not an assumed SSR hydration path. Cancel and clear owner-scoped queries on logout, expiry or owner change; late responses cannot repopulate a new session. Guard mutations with current domain/journey versions and exact accepted terms, then invalidate/refetch the affected server state. Cached data never authorizes payment, dispatch or issuance.

Avoid arbitrary dynamically constructed class names or a separate per-screen styling system. Use verified open-source Inter with system-ui fallback and readable hierarchy/spacing; Proxima Nova is no longer a dependency or licensing gate. Preserve URL/deep-link filters. Set finite staleTime, gcTime and retry for each data class; 401/403/validation errors do not loop and writes have no blanket retry. Background refetch must not overwrite unsaved local form input. Optional persistence is restricted to a separately supplied synthetic public-reference experiment with a version buster and finite maxAge/gcTime; private caches and queued mutations remain excluded. Use /api/v1 and catalog spelling. Recovered ECOS-19 contains both /api/v1/... and later /api/.../catalogue routes, and requestId versus correlationId errors. Map these explicitly in a versioned teaching adapter; no aliases, route implementation or compatibility are assumed. Canonical safe error is {code, message, fieldErrors, requestId, retryable}. The proposed acceptance record binds applicationId, expectedVersion, reviewedRevision, ratingRevision, quoteId, scenarioHash, configurationHash, sourceVersion, ruleVersion, termsHash, totalMinor, currency and consent to the authenticated owner. Every changed amount, terms, options or revision requires explicit review and exact acceptance, including changes of 1 or 100 paise. The historical 100-paise threshold is an escalation boundary, not permission to accept small changes silently.

Explicit final submit requires complete disclosures, confirmed extraction corrections, no unresolved questions, exact current reviewed revision and reconciled confirmed/pending payment allocations. Commit SUBMISSION_PENDING and dispatch intent together. SUBMITTED requires external mock dispatch evidence; ISSUED/active-cover language requires simulated issuance/effective-cover evidence.
- Serialize cancellation with dispatch claim. Unknown/in-flight dispatch must be reconciled before claiming unsubmitted cancellation or refundable entitlement. Origin refund and wallet credit consume one unique adjustment allocation and cannot both happen. Never reroute an uncertain origin refund to a new wallet credit.
- Application net settled = confirmed external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed wallet credits allocated to the application. Pending effects reserve funds. Unique (journey_id, sequence) and (journey_id, causation_id, event_code) prevent duplicate advancement. Transaction audit references actual payment/journal/adjustment/submission/renewal effects, retains failed/unknown/reconciled observations and appends corrections. POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most ten per batch, maximum 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Schema 1 permits only event_id, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id when ownership permits, event_name PAGE_VIEW or CONTROL_CLICK, allowlisted page_id/step_code/target_id, optional bounded duration/client time and policy metadata. Browser queue is capped at twenty events and three attempts; loss/drop/reordering is allowed and cannot block checkout or owned resume. Policy-disabled clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without persisted payload. Selected synthetic consumer payloads use the prepared maintained AEAD/envelope port, proposed AES-256-GCM with a 12-byte IV and 128-bit tag. Owner checks precede decrypt. AAD binds immutable opaque object ID plus object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version; it is not secret and never enters logs/analytics. Store ciphertext and wrapped data key, never plaintext fallback or wrapping key in the database/browser/repository. IV uniqueness is required under each data key outside fixed test-vector mode. Rotation preserves business IDs/content and has its own envelope revision. In-memory test keys prove only their process lifetime; restart/restore recovery is BLOCKED without a prepared authorized retained teaching-key mechanism. Missing key is KEY_UNAVAILABLE, not empty data or recovery success. Field encryption does not prove deployment TLS, encrypted volumes/backups or legal compliance; those remain explicit configuration/evidence gates. No real key creation, KMS grant, credential or security-setting mutation is authorized.

- [ECOS-14](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-14), sections: Decision and requirements; Cost, operations, migration and reversal; Validation and revisit trigger.
- [ECOS-20](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-20), sections: Signals and proposed targets; Capacity and benchmark; Failure and recovery matrix; QA acceptance matrix.
- [ECOS-62](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-62), sections: Acceptance criteria; Outcome.

Recovered product constraints for this slice:
- React → Spring modular monolith → PostgreSQL. Catalog, Shortlist, Application, Payments, Policy and Support own their data and communicate through public interfaces; no cross-module repositories. Initial runtime has no shared cache, broker or second database.
- Unknown, Verified and Synthetic describe distinct evidence states. Historical ECOS illustrations/tariffs and teaching fixture prices are not current payable quotes. Unsupported scenarios show Quote unavailable; source version, scenario and terms remain attributable.
- Product money is integer minor units plus currency. Preserve original versus edited rating/configuration revisions. Every changed amount, terms, options or revision requires explicit review and exact acceptance, including changes of 1 or 100 paise. The historical 100-paise threshold is an escalation boundary, not permission to accept small changes silently.
- Confirmed mock payment unlocks onboarding only. Explicit final submit requires complete disclosures, confirmed extraction corrections, no unresolved questions, exact current reviewed revision and reconciled confirmed/pending payment allocations. Commit SUBMISSION_PENDING and dispatch intent together. SUBMITTED requires external mock dispatch evidence; ISSUED/active-cover language requires simulated issuance/effective-cover evidence.
- Serialize cancellation with dispatch claim. Unknown/in-flight dispatch must be reconciled before claiming unsubmitted cancellation or refundable entitlement. Origin refund and wallet credit consume one unique adjustment allocation and cannot both happen. Never reroute an uncertain origin refund to a new wallet credit.
- Application net settled = confirmed external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed wallet credits allocated to the application. Pending effects reserve funds. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations, never negative; a wallet-funded portion is not also counted as an external capture.
- Renewal creates a fresh linked application and quote and leaves the old policy unchanged. A renewal nudge cannot charge, create a real mandate or promise continuous/backdated cover.
- All insurer/payment decisions and funds remain mock/simulated. Assistance is source-grounded, read-only and owner-scoped; it cannot underwrite, mutate confirmed answers, submit proposals or move money. No real PII, medical documents, credentials, provider calls, cloud spending or launch is authorized.
These are constraints on the bounded daily seam, not additional daily implementation tasks.

User-requested extension, proposed 14 October 2026:
Journey UUIDs identify records and never authorize access. ApplicationRevision and the quote own answers and accepted terms; journey is a server-maintained navigation projection, not a second mutable draft. Anonymous discovery keeps only public device-local selections; after login an explicit owned handoff validates the source/scenario. GET /api/v1/me/journeys returns minimal owned resume summaries, limit 1–50, default 20, with owner-bound cursors. GET /api/v1/journeys/{id} returns the same safe 404 for missing and foreign IDs. Reload/new session recomputes allowed actions from authoritative domain state.
A server-validated domain transition, required transaction audit, journey projection and journey step event share one PostgreSQL unit of work through public interfaces. Unique (journey_id, sequence) and (journey_id, causation_id, event_code) prevent duplicate advancement. Transaction audit references actual payment/journal/adjustment/submission/renewal effects, retains failed/unknown/reconciled observations and appends corrections. Browser clicks and client timestamps never prove or order these effects.
POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most ten per batch, maximum 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Schema 1 permits only event_id, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id when ownership permits, event_name PAGE_VIEW or CONTROL_CLICK, allowlisted page_id/step_code/target_id, optional bounded duration/client time and policy metadata. No arbitrary properties, forms, health answers, amounts, email, tokens, raw URLs/referrers or DOM text. Server receive time is authoritative for receipt only. Exact event-ID replay is DUPLICATE; changed payload conflicts 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT. Invalid schema is 400, oversized body 413, rate limit 429. A 202 receipt is RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY and says nothing about business success. Browser queue is capped at twenty events and three attempts; loss/drop/reordering is allowed and cannot block checkout or owned resume. Policy-disabled clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without persisted payload. Retention/purpose/consent rules are configurable; no third-party destination or indefinite storage is assumed.
Selected synthetic consumer payloads use the prepared maintained AEAD/envelope port, proposed AES-256-GCM with a 12-byte IV and 128-bit tag. Owner checks precede decrypt. AAD binds immutable opaque object ID plus object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version; it is not secret and never enters logs/analytics. Store ciphertext and wrapped data key, never plaintext fallback or wrapping key in the database/browser/repository. IV uniqueness is required under each data key outside fixed test-vector mode. Rotation preserves business IDs/content and has its own envelope revision. In-memory test keys prove only their process lifetime; restart/restore recovery is BLOCKED without a prepared authorized retained teaching-key mechanism. Missing key is KEY_UNAVAILABLE, not empty data or recovery success. Field encryption does not prove deployment TLS, encrypted volumes/backups or legal compliance; those remain explicit configuration/evidence gates. No real key creation, KMS grant, credential or security-setting mutation is authorized.
These additions replace existing seam work; they do not add minutes. The exact new interfaces and fixtures are teaching proposals, distinct from recovered ECOS rules.
Preserve ApplicationRevision's recovered composite key: journey (application_id, application_revision) references ApplicationRevision (application_id, revision). Do not add a revision UUID or mutable plaintext journey copy. Initial journey statuses are ACTIVE, WAITING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED and EXPIRED. Current steps use the shared registry, including FINAL_REVIEW rather than an invented REVIEW step. The analytics allowlist uses lower-case page and control IDs from the versioned registry. PAGE_VIEW requires target_id absent. optional_duration_ms is an integer from 0 through 300000, with booleans invalid; client_time is absent or a valid aware timestamp, never authoritative order.
A pending operation reference is durable before an external mock call. A definite provider failure is committed with its FAILED state and audit observation in the result transaction. If that transaction rolls back, its audit row also rolls back; the prior pending/unknown reference remains for reconciliation. Never fabricate a definite outcome or claim a rolled-back audit row persisted.
Every model/isolated experiment is a bounded CoverStory module or engineering-evidence seam in the same capstone, feeding its actual ADR/release gate. It is not a detached toy project. Frontend exercises show component/state ownership, contract/data flow, route/reload/resume behavior, accessibility, safe errors and tests. SPA refresh uses session/bootstrap plus authenticated refetch and server-valid journey resume, not an assumed SSR hydration path. Use /api/v1 and catalog spelling. Recovered ECOS-19 contains both /api/v1/... and later /api/.../catalogue routes, and requestId versus correlationId errors. Ten callers request owner A, generation 5 through one shared loader. Fake time starts at 0; load completes at 80 ms. Caller 1 deadline is 50 ms; the other deadlines are 100 ms. In the no-expiry case the lease remains valid. In a separate token case L1 expires at 60 ms and L2 is acquired at 61 ms. All cached data is synthetic nonpersonal configuration.

Expected: One backend load; nine receive value at 80 ms, caller 1 times out at 50 ms without cancelling other waiters.
State: PROPOSED_EXPECTATION_NOT_OBSERVED. Fresh named fixture state, counters and fixed clock per case unless an explicit sequence is stated.

State: PROPOSED_EXPECTATION_NOT_OBSERVED. Fresh named fixture state, counters and fixed clock per case unless an explicit sequence is stated.

State: PROPOSED_EXPECTATION_NOT_OBSERVED. Fresh named fixture state, counters and fixed clock per case unless an explicit sequence is stated.

Transaction audit references actual payment/journal/adjustment/submission/renewal effects, retains failed/unknown/reconciled observations and appends corrections. Browser clicks and client timestamps never prove or order these effects.
POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most ten per batch, maximum 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Schema 1 permits only event_id, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id when ownership permits, event_name PAGE_VIEW or CONTROL_CLICK, allowlisted page_id/step_code/target_id, optional bounded duration/client time and policy metadata. No arbitrary properties, forms, health answers, amounts, email, tokens, raw URLs/referrers or DOM text. Server receive time is authoritative for receipt only. Exact event-ID replay is DUPLICATE; changed payload conflicts 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT. Invalid schema is 400, oversized body 413, rate limit 429. A 202 receipt is RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY and says nothing about business success. Browser queue is capped at twenty events and three attempts; loss/drop/reordering is allowed and cannot block checkout or owned resume. Policy-disabled clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without persisted payload. Retention/purpose/consent rules are configurable; no third-party destination or indefinite storage is assumed.
Selected synthetic consumer payloads use the prepared maintained AEAD/envelope port, proposed AES-256-GCM with a 12-byte IV and 128-bit tag. Owner checks precede decrypt. AAD binds immutable opaque object ID plus object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version; it is not secret and never enters logs/analytics. Store ciphertext and wrapped data key, never plaintext fallback or wrapping key in the database/browser/repository. IV uniqueness is required under each data key outside fixed test-vector mode. Rotation preserves business IDs/content and has its own envelope revision. In-memory test keys prove only their process lifetime; restart/restore recovery is BLOCKED without a prepared authorized retained teaching-key mechanism. Missing key is KEY_UNAVAILABLE, not empty data or recovery success. Field encryption does not prove deployment TLS, encrypted volumes/backups or legal compliance; those remain explicit configuration/evidence gates. No real key creation, KMS grant, credential or security-setting mutation is authorized.
These additions replace existing seam work; they do not add minutes. The exact new interfaces and fixtures are teaching proposals, distinct from recovered ECOS rules.
Preserve ApplicationRevision's recovered composite key: journey (application_id, application_revision) references ApplicationRevision (application_id, revision). Do not add a revision UUID or mutable plaintext journey copy. Initial journey statuses are ACTIVE, WAITING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED and EXPIRED. Current steps use the shared registry, including FINAL_REVIEW rather than an invented REVIEW step. The analytics allowlist uses lower-case page and control IDs from the versioned registry. PAGE_VIEW requires target_id absent. optional_duration_ms is an integer from 0 through 300000, with booleans invalid; client_time is absent or a valid aware timestamp, never authoritative order.

Guard mutations with current domain/journey versions and exact accepted terms, then invalidate/refetch the affected server state. Cached data never authorizes payment, dispatch or issuance.

Query, Tailwind and font packages are planned until the current repository and instructor scaffold are inspected. These changes replace the same frontend-state/design tasks and add no minutes.
Frontend stack details: one stable QueryClient at the app boundary; each domain owns typed key/options factories and query hooks. Shared primitives do not fetch from other domains. Preserve URL/deep-link filters. Set finite staleTime, gcTime and retry for each data class; 401/403/validation errors do not loop and writes have no blanket retry. Background refetch must not overwrite unsaved local form input. Optional persistence is restricted to a separately supplied synthetic public-reference experiment with a version buster and finite maxAge/gcTime; private caches and queued mutations remain excluded. No Next.js, TanStack Start or SSR is added.
Use Inter source and SIL Open Font License, retaining copyright/OFL with any later distributed assets. Font-display swap and observed fallback/layout-shift checks belong to the bounded design task. Use /api/v1 and catalog spelling. Recovered ECOS-19 contains both /api/v1/... and later /api/.../catalogue routes, and requestId versus correlationId errors. Map these explicitly in a versioned teaching adapter; no aliases, route implementation or compatibility are assumed. Canonical safe error is {code, message, fieldErrors, requestId, retryable}. Exact field names/available DTOs must be reconciled at preflight; client owner/amount is never authority. The later source's SUBMISSION_PENDING/dispatch-evidence boundary supersedes the earlier shorthand that returned SUBMITTED immediately on submit. These are proposed teaching interfaces, not claims about existing endpoints.

### Concrete proposed inputs and output

Ingress budget is 200 ms, with 20 ms reserved for returning the response. Admission takes 30 ms and cache lookup takes 40 ms. The database operation needs at least 60 ms. Adapters honor their supplied nonnegative timeouts. Elapsed time uses a monotonic clock; wall time is only logged. A negative case consumes 130 ms before the final 20 ms reserve, leaving only 50 ms for the database.

ApplicationRevision and the quote own answers and accepted terms; journey is a server-maintained navigation projection, not a second mutable draft. Anonymous discovery keeps only public device-local selections; after login an explicit owned handoff validates the source/scenario. Transaction audit references actual payment/journal/adjustment/submission/renewal effects, retains failed/unknown/reconciled observations and appends corrections. Browser clicks and client timestamps never prove or order these effects.
POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most ten per batch, maximum 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Schema 1 permits only event_id, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id when ownership permits, event_name PAGE_VIEW or CONTROL_CLICK, allowlisted page_id/step_code/target_id, optional bounded duration/client time and policy metadata. A 202 receipt is RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY and says nothing about business success. Browser queue is capped at twenty events and three attempts; loss/drop/reordering is allowed and cannot block checkout or owned resume. Policy-disabled clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without persisted payload. Retention/purpose/consent rules are configurable; no third-party destination or indefinite storage is assumed.

Store ciphertext and wrapped data key, never plaintext fallback or wrapping key in the database/browser/repository. IV uniqueness is required under each data key outside fixed test-vector mode. Rotation preserves business IDs/content and has its own envelope revision. Missing key is KEY_UNAVAILABLE, not empty data or recovery success. New CoverStory outbox key is owner, application, reviewed revision and dispatch operation. Row cs-dispatch-7 starts PENDING. Worker w1 owns lease L1 until 100 ms; w2 may acquire L2 at 100 ms. Every send carries the same stable business operation reference. A mock receiver stores one effect and returns the same reference on duplicate delivery. A separate cancellation case commits before either dispatch claim.

Output: DispatchLeaseFence produces the task-specific state and case outcomes below, plus docs/evidence/coverstory/CAP-197/result.json. The receipt includes state, candidateIdentity, cases, mode, measurements, newBoundaryTest, architectureDeltaRef, history. All expected examples are proposed tests, not observed runs.

### Learner TODO

- Complete the lease-token conditional completion seam for the existing SQL dispatch outbox; optional Kafka transport stays an isolated adapter experiment.
- Write the expected output for one changed/boundary input before implementing the single prepared TODO seam. Preserve the fixed positive and negative cases.

- Use the existing 15-minute canonical Top Interview 150 retention slot for due reviews in saved order. Preserve original attempt/solve history; Java/DSA objectives assigned inside the practical task are not silently removed.

### Fixed acceptance cases

CAP-197-CS-01. Given: Current token publishes to mock receiver and receives evidence
Expected: Commit completion only if token still owns claim; pending state advances only with the recorded external mock reference.
State: PROPOSED_EXPECTATION_NOT_OBSERVED. Fresh named fixture state, counters and fixed clock per case unless an explicit sequence is stated.

CAP-197-CS-02. Given: Expired w1 returns after w2 claimed
Expected: Reject stale completion; count duplicate transport attempt and retain dedup/reconciliation evidence.
State: PROPOSED_EXPECTATION_NOT_OBSERVED. Fresh named fixture state, counters and fixed clock per case unless an explicit sequence is stated.

CAP-197-CS-03. Given: Cancellation commits before dispatch claim or dispatch is uncertain
Expected: Cancel/invalidate queued work atomically; if in-flight/UNKNOWN, block unsubmitted/refund claims until reconciliation.
State: PROPOSED_EXPECTATION_NOT_OBSERVED. Fresh named fixture state, counters and fixed clock per case unless an explicit sequence is stated.

### Planned instructor scaffold

Instructor ownership: supply typed DTOs and public-port signatures, exact synthetic inputs and visible fixed acceptance fixtures, fake Clock/deterministic scheduler, isolated PostgreSQL wiring where durability matters, read-only mock/model ports, safe fixture reset and an evidence serializer. Reuse inspected test wiring; setup smoke must pass independently of learner TODOs. Supply one named TODO seam, not a completed learner algorithm, SQL solution or hidden implementation. Independently derive the expected outputs and run a private solvability witness, keeping that solution out of learner files. Missing or contradictory fixtures mean HOLD_READINESS. Do not silently weaken tests.
Learner boundary: inspect the prepared contract, implement or test only the named seam, run all fixed cases and one learner-chosen boundary case whose expected result is written first, and retain actual PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN evidence. Reading-only completion is insufficient. At most two implementation files plus focused tests may change; preflight must reduce optional breadth explicitly if that does not fit. Show local SQL atomic intent plus external mock boundary; at-least-once transport is not exactly-once business effect.
Update a supplied existing view with at most three changed facts; at most six entities/classes/components or ten sequence messages. ER views show keys/cardinality; module/UML views show responsibility and dependency direction; sequence/data flow names the relevant trust/transaction boundary.
Tie one changed fact to an actual daily test/measurement receipt; no diagram-only completion.
Interview: Explain the invariant behind fence competing proposal dispatch workers, one rejected alternative, the observed or unobserved boundary, and what evidence would change the decision.
At most five minutes replace existing practical documentation/evidence explanation; at most three minutes replace existing reflection/explain-back. No added time. On Sunday the interview explanation is individual evidence, not mandatory DSM.

## Active CoverStory learning contract · semantic migration draft

CAP-198 · Day 191 · 2027-04-22 · Deduplicate business effects across replays

Execution/readiness gate: PROPOSED_NOT_PREPARED and NOT_RUN. The earlier mapped health capability is contingent on prerequisite evidence. At this audit the current repository has React fixture mode and a Spring /health seam, not verified CoverStory product wiring. Existing frontend decoders, cancellation/stale-response handling, session reset, safe errors and accessibility scaffolds may be reused only after inspection. OperatorApi/EventStatus require explicit replacement or adapter; product modules, public interfaces and forbidden-import/cycle checks remain planned instructor prerequisites.
The published Java 21/Maven and embedded PostgreSQL starter, including reported commit d623bf4bd16c6b437aa9e8908b2454c5e0256410, establishes only narrow scaffolding. Historical TODO failures, reported later fixes, this mapping and recovered design documents do not prove a solvable exercise or completed product. Before assignment, inspect the current checkout, prepare the named fixture/glue, reconcile exact API/command/test selectors and independently rehearse the full day inside its budget. If a predecessor is HOLD or physical evidence is absent, the dependent integrated result remains blocked. An explicitly isolated contract exercise may continue but cannot close that product gate.
The user-requested journey/audit/analytics/encryption schema is also proposed. An existing fixture-mode UI is not proof that these endpoints, transactions, keys or controls exist; instructor preparation and candidate-bound evidence are required.

### One concrete daily outcome

Implement composite durable receipt uniqueness for simulated proposal callbacks and refund effects; distinguish transport replay epochs from business-operation identity.

### Earlier mapped prerequisites

- CAP-12, Day 152 (2027-03-14): reviewed evidence required.
- CAP-197, Day 190 (2027-04-21): reviewed evidence required.

### Recovered source rules and explicit teaching choices

- [ECOS-10](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-10), sections: Decision and requirements; Validation and revisit trigger; Onboarding and proposal boundary.
- [ECOS-12](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-12), sections: State and consistency; Detail changes and money reconciliation; Refund destination and mock wallet.
- [ECOS-13](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-13), sections: Decision and requirements; Validation and revisit trigger.
- [ECOS-19](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-19), sections: Context and modules; API v1; Configuration, wallet and policy lifecycle contract.
- [ECOS-32](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-32), sections: Scope; Acceptance criteria.
- [ECOS-64](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-64), sections: Onboarding and proposal boundary; Refund destination and mock wallet.
- [ECOS-66](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-66), sections: Refund destination and mock wallet; Dependencies and evidence.

Recovered product constraints for this slice:
- React → Spring modular monolith → PostgreSQL. Catalog, Shortlist, Application, Payments, Policy and Support own their data and communicate through public interfaces; no cross-module repositories. Initial runtime has no shared cache, broker or second database.
- Unknown, Verified and Synthetic describe distinct evidence states. Historical ECOS illustrations/tariffs and teaching fixture prices are not current payable quotes. Unsupported scenarios show Quote unavailable; source version, scenario and terms remain attributable.
- Product money is integer minor units plus currency. Preserve original versus edited rating/configuration revisions. Every changed amount, terms, options or revision requires explicit review and exact acceptance, including changes of 1 or 100 paise. The historical 100-paise threshold is an escalation boundary, not permission to accept small changes silently.
- Confirmed mock payment unlocks onboarding only. Explicit final submit requires complete disclosures, confirmed extraction corrections, no unresolved questions, exact current reviewed revision and reconciled confirmed/pending payment allocations. Commit SUBMISSION_PENDING and dispatch intent together. SUBMITTED requires external mock dispatch evidence; ISSUED/active-cover language requires simulated issuance/effective-cover evidence.
- Serialize cancellation with dispatch claim. Unknown/in-flight dispatch must be reconciled before claiming unsubmitted cancellation or refundable entitlement. Origin refund and wallet credit consume one unique adjustment allocation and cannot both happen. Never reroute an uncertain origin refund to a new wallet credit.
- Application net settled = confirmed external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed wallet credits allocated to the application. Pending effects reserve funds. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations, never negative; a wallet-funded portion is not also counted as an external capture.
- Renewal creates a fresh linked application and quote and leaves the old policy unchanged. A renewal nudge cannot charge, create a real mandate or promise continuous/backdated cover.
- All insurer/payment decisions and funds remain mock/simulated. Assistance is source-grounded, read-only and owner-scoped; it cannot underwrite, mutate confirmed answers, submit proposals or move money. No real PII, medical documents, credentials, provider calls, cloud spending or launch is authorized.
These are constraints on the bounded daily seam, not additional daily implementation tasks.

User-requested extension, proposed 14 October 2026:
Journey UUIDs identify records and never authorize access. ApplicationRevision and the quote own answers and accepted terms; journey is a server-maintained navigation projection, not a second mutable draft. Anonymous discovery keeps only public device-local selections; after login an explicit owned handoff validates the source/scenario. GET /api/v1/me/journeys returns minimal owned resume summaries, limit 1–50, default 20, with owner-bound cursors. GET /api/v1/journeys/{id} returns the same safe 404 for missing and foreign IDs. Reload/new session recomputes allowed actions from authoritative domain state.
A server-validated domain transition, required transaction audit, journey projection and journey step event share one PostgreSQL unit of work through public interfaces. Unique (journey_id, sequence) and (journey_id, causation_id, event_code) prevent duplicate advancement. Transaction audit references actual payment/journal/adjustment/submission/renewal effects, retains failed/unknown/reconciled observations and appends corrections. Browser clicks and client timestamps never prove or order these effects.
POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most ten per batch, maximum 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Schema 1 permits only event_id, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id when ownership permits, event_name PAGE_VIEW or CONTROL_CLICK, allowlisted page_id/step_code/target_id, optional bounded duration/client time and policy metadata. No arbitrary properties, forms, health answers, amounts, email, tokens, raw URLs/referrers or DOM text. Server receive time is authoritative for receipt only. Exact event-ID replay is DUPLICATE; changed payload conflicts 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT. Invalid schema is 400, oversized body 413, rate limit 429. A 202 receipt is RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY and says nothing about business success. Browser queue is capped at twenty events and three attempts; loss/drop/reordering is allowed and cannot block checkout or owned resume. Policy-disabled clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without persisted payload. Retention/purpose/consent rules are configurable; no third-party destination or indefinite storage is assumed.
Selected synthetic consumer payloads use the prepared maintained AEAD/envelope port, proposed AES-256-GCM with a 12-byte IV and 128-bit tag. Owner checks precede decrypt. AAD binds immutable opaque object ID plus object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version; it is not secret and never enters logs/analytics. Store ciphertext and wrapped data key, never plaintext fallback or wrapping key in the database/browser/repository. IV uniqueness is required under each data key outside fixed test-vector mode. Rotation preserves business IDs/content and has its own envelope revision. In-memory test keys prove only their process lifetime; restart/restore recovery is BLOCKED without a prepared authorized retained teaching-key mechanism. Missing key is KEY_UNAVAILABLE, not empty data or recovery success. Field encryption does not prove deployment TLS, encrypted volumes/backups or legal compliance; those remain explicit configuration/evidence gates. No real key creation, KMS grant, credential or security-setting mutation is authorized.
These additions replace existing seam work; they do not add minutes. The exact new interfaces and fixtures are teaching proposals, distinct from recovered ECOS rules.
Preserve ApplicationRevision's recovered composite key: journey (application_id, application_revision) references ApplicationRevision (application_id, revision). Do not add a revision UUID or mutable plaintext journey copy. Initial journey statuses are ACTIVE, WAITING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED and EXPIRED. Current steps use the shared registry, including FINAL_REVIEW rather than an invented REVIEW step. The analytics allowlist uses lower-case page and control IDs from the versioned registry. PAGE_VIEW requires target_id absent. optional_duration_ms is an integer from 0 through 300000, with booleans invalid; client_time is absent or a valid aware timestamp, never authoritative order.
A pending operation reference is durable before an external mock call. A definite provider failure is committed with its FAILED state and audit observation in the result transaction. If that transaction rolls back, its audit row also rolls back; the prior pending/unknown reference remains for reconciliation. Never fabricate a definite outcome or claim a rolled-back audit row persisted.
Every model/isolated experiment is a bounded CoverStory module or engineering-evidence seam in the same capstone, feeding its actual ADR/release gate. It is not a detached toy project. Frontend exercises show component/state ownership, contract/data flow, route/reload/resume behavior, accessibility, safe errors and tests. Operating exercises show configuration/key boundaries, CI/rollback, SLO/failure, backups, capacity/cost evidence and ownership at the scope actually exercised.
Latest frontend teaching stack: TanStack React Query v5 owns server state and its in-memory cache. Form edits and router/UI state remain separate; no duplicate global store for fetched journey/application/quote data. SPA refresh uses session/bootstrap plus authenticated refetch and server-valid journey resume, not an assumed SSR hydration path. Query keys include bounded resource/version and owner/session scope; never put consumer answers or raw tokens in keys. Sensitive server-state cache is not persisted to browser storage. Cancel and clear owner-scoped queries on logout, expiry or owner change; late responses cannot repopulate a new session. Guard mutations with current domain/journey versions and exact accepted terms, then invalidate/refetch the affected server state. Cached data never authorizes payment, dispatch or issuance.
Shared UI uses parameterized accessible primitives and feature compositions, with Tailwind design tokens and finite typed variants. Avoid arbitrary dynamically constructed class names or a separate per-screen styling system. Use verified open-source Inter with system-ui fallback and readable hierarchy/spacing; Proxima Nova is no longer a dependency or licensing gate. Query, Tailwind and font packages are planned until the current repository and instructor scaffold are inspected. These changes replace the same frontend-state/design tasks and add no minutes.
Frontend stack details: one stable QueryClient at the app boundary; each domain owns typed key/options factories and query hooks. Shared primitives do not fetch from other domains. Preserve URL/deep-link filters. Set finite staleTime, gcTime and retry for each data class; 401/403/validation errors do not loop and writes have no blanket retry. Background refetch must not overwrite unsaved local form input. Optional persistence is restricted to a separately supplied synthetic public-reference experiment with a version buster and finite maxAge/gcTime; private caches and queued mutations remain excluded. No Next.js, TanStack Start or SSR is added.
Use Inter source and SIL Open Font License, retaining copyright/OFL with any later distributed assets. Font-display swap and observed fallback/layout-shift checks belong to the bounded design task. Shared paths are frontend/src/coverstory/shared/ui/, shared/theme/ and shared/query/. Tailwind official pages currently describe v4 @theme; inspect the actual installed major and do not upgrade silently.

Proposed canonical API v1 reconciliation, pending instructor review:
Use /api/v1 and catalog spelling. Recovered ECOS-19 contains both /api/v1/... and later /api/.../catalogue routes, and requestId versus correlationId errors. Map these explicitly in a versioned teaching adapter; no aliases, route implementation or compatibility are assumed. Canonical safe error is {code, message, fieldErrors, requestId, retryable}. Later correlationId is mapped to requestId without copying unsafe body text. Expected version and reviewed revision remain distinct.
The proposed acceptance record binds applicationId, expectedVersion, reviewedRevision, ratingRevision, quoteId, scenarioHash, configurationHash, sourceVersion, ruleVersion, termsHash, totalMinor, currency and consent to the authenticated owner. Exact field names/available DTOs must be reconciled at preflight; client owner/amount is never authority. The later source's SUBMISSION_PENDING/dispatch-evidence boundary supersedes the earlier shorthand that returned SUBMITTED immediately on submit. These are proposed teaching interfaces, not claims about existing endpoints.

### Concrete proposed inputs and output

New fixture deliveries are owner A / application 1 / revision 1 / operation 1 / transport epoch 0, its duplicate, the same business operation at transport epoch 1, and owner B with the same text IDs at epoch 0. Business-effect identity excludes transport epoch. Expected total effects are two: one for A and one for B. Transport receipts retain every declared epoch and duplicate observation. Receipt and local effect share one SQL transaction.

Output: BusinessEffectReceipt produces the task-specific state and case outcomes below, plus docs/evidence/coverstory/CAP-198/result.json. The receipt includes state, candidateIdentity, cases, mode, measurements, newBoundaryTest, architectureDeltaRef, history. All expected examples are proposed tests, not observed runs.

### Learner TODO

- Implement composite durable receipt uniqueness for simulated proposal callbacks and refund effects; distinguish transport replay epochs from business-operation identity.
- Write the expected output for one changed/boundary input before implementing the single prepared TODO seam. Preserve the fixed positive and negative cases.
- Run the fixed acceptance cases and added boundary test, inspect the relevant real state or controlled observation, and write the actual evidence receipt. Keep a truthful blocker if setup or timebox fails.
- Use the existing 15-minute canonical Top Interview 150 retention slot for due reviews in saved order. Preserve original attempt/solve history; Java/DSA objectives assigned inside the practical task are not silently removed.

### Fixed acceptance cases

CAP-198-CS-01. Given: Same logical operation arrives twice or via a new transport replay epoch
Expected: Persist transport evidence but apply dispatch/refund business effect once; epoch never authorizes a second economic effect.
State: PROPOSED_EXPECTATION_NOT_OBSERVED. Fresh named fixture state, counters and fixed clock per case unless an explicit sequence is stated.

CAP-198-CS-02. Given: Different owner has the same application/operation text IDs
Expected: Keep independent authorized identity and receipt, with no collision or leakage.
State: PROPOSED_EXPECTATION_NOT_OBSERVED. Fresh named fixture state, counters and fixed clock per case unless an explicit sequence is stated.

CAP-198-CS-03. Given: Receipt insert or ledger/transition fails before commit
Expected: Roll back both; after restart durable replay resolves once on actual PostgreSQL, or physical proof remains NOT_RUN.
State: PROPOSED_EXPECTATION_NOT_OBSERVED. Fresh named fixture state, counters and fixed clock per case unless an explicit sequence is stated.

### Planned instructor scaffold

### One concrete daily outcome

Complete the local repair-proposal validator for one quarantined synthetic dispatch/status message without publishing or replaying it.

### Earlier mapped prerequisites

### Recovered source rules and explicit teaching choices

- [ECOS-13](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-13), sections: Decision and requirements; Validation and revisit trigger.
- [ECOS-19](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-19), sections: Context and modules; API v1; Configuration, wallet and policy lifecycle contract.
- [ECOS-35](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-35), sections: Scope; Acceptance criteria.
- [ECOS-64](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-64), sections: Onboarding and proposal boundary; Refund destination and mock wallet.

Recovered product constraints for this slice:
- React → Spring modular monolith → PostgreSQL. Catalog, Shortlist, Application, Payments, Policy and Support own their data and communicate through public interfaces; no cross-module repositories. Initial runtime has no shared cache, broker or second database.
- Unknown, Verified and Synthetic describe distinct evidence states. Historical ECOS illustrations/tariffs and teaching fixture prices are not current payable quotes. Unsupported scenarios show Quote unavailable; source version, scenario and terms remain attributable.
- Product money is integer minor units plus currency. Preserve original versus edited rating/configuration revisions. Every changed amount, terms, options or revision requires explicit review and exact acceptance, including changes of 1 or 100 paise. The historical 100-paise threshold is an escalation boundary, not permission to accept small changes silently.
- Confirmed mock payment unlocks onboarding only. Explicit final submit requires complete disclosures, confirmed extraction corrections, no unresolved questions, exact current reviewed revision and reconciled confirmed/pending payment allocations. Commit SUBMISSION_PENDING and dispatch intent together. SUBMITTED requires external mock dispatch evidence; ISSUED/active-cover language requires simulated issuance/effective-cover evidence.
- Serialize cancellation with dispatch claim. Unknown/in-flight dispatch must be reconciled before claiming unsubmitted cancellation or refundable entitlement. Origin refund and wallet credit consume one unique adjustment allocation and cannot both happen. Never reroute an uncertain origin refund to a new wallet credit.
- Application net settled = confirmed external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed wallet credits allocated to the application. Pending effects reserve funds. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations, never negative; a wallet-funded portion is not also counted as an external capture.
- Renewal creates a fresh linked application and quote and leaves the old policy unchanged. A renewal nudge cannot charge, create a real mandate or promise continuous/backdated cover.
- All insurer/payment decisions and funds remain mock/simulated. Assistance is source-grounded, read-only and owner-scoped; it cannot underwrite, mutate confirmed answers, submit proposals or move money. No real PII, medical documents, credentials, provider calls, cloud spending or launch is authorized.
These are constraints on the bounded daily seam, not additional daily implementation tasks.

User-requested extension, proposed 14 October 2026:
Journey UUIDs identify records and never authorize access. ApplicationRevision and the quote own answers and accepted terms; journey is a server-maintained navigation projection, not a second mutable draft. Anonymous discovery keeps only public device-local selections; after login an explicit owned handoff validates the source/scenario. GET /api/v1/me/journeys returns minimal owned resume summaries, limit 1–50, default 20, with owner-bound cursors. GET /api/v1/journeys/{id} returns the same safe 404 for missing and foreign IDs. Reload/new session recomputes allowed actions from authoritative domain state.
A server-validated domain transition, required transaction audit, journey projection and journey step event share one PostgreSQL unit of work through public interfaces. Unique (journey_id, sequence) and (journey_id, causation_id, event_code) prevent duplicate advancement. Transaction audit references actual payment/journal/adjustment/submission/renewal effects, retains failed/unknown/reconciled observations and appends corrections. Browser clicks and client timestamps never prove or order these effects.
POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most ten per batch, maximum 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Schema 1 permits only event_id, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id when ownership permits, event_name PAGE_VIEW or CONTROL_CLICK, allowlisted page_id/step_code/target_id, optional bounded duration/client time and policy metadata. No arbitrary properties, forms, health answers, amounts, email, tokens, raw URLs/referrers or DOM text. Server receive time is authoritative for receipt only. Exact event-ID replay is DUPLICATE; changed payload conflicts 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT. Invalid schema is 400, oversized body 413, rate limit 429. A 202 receipt is RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY and says nothing about business success. Browser queue is capped at twenty events and three attempts; loss/drop/reordering is allowed and cannot block checkout or owned resume. Policy-disabled clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without persisted payload. Retention/purpose/consent rules are configurable; no third-party destination or indefinite storage is assumed.
Selected synthetic consumer payloads use the prepared maintained AEAD/envelope port, proposed AES-256-GCM with a 12-byte IV and 128-bit tag. Owner checks precede decrypt. AAD binds immutable opaque object ID plus object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version; it is not secret and never enters logs/analytics. Store ciphertext and wrapped data key, never plaintext fallback or wrapping key in the database/browser/repository. IV uniqueness is required under each data key outside fixed test-vector mode. Rotation preserves business IDs/content and has its own envelope revision. In-memory test keys prove only their process lifetime; restart/restore recovery is BLOCKED without a prepared authorized retained teaching-key mechanism. Missing key is KEY_UNAVAILABLE, not empty data or recovery success. Field encryption does not prove deployment TLS, encrypted volumes/backups or legal compliance; those remain explicit configuration/evidence gates. No real key creation, KMS grant, credential or security-setting mutation is authorized.
These additions replace existing seam work; they do not add minutes. The exact new interfaces and fixtures are teaching proposals, distinct from recovered ECOS rules.
Preserve ApplicationRevision's recovered composite key: journey (application_id, application_revision) references ApplicationRevision (application_id, revision). Do not add a revision UUID or mutable plaintext journey copy. Initial journey statuses are ACTIVE, WAITING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED and EXPIRED. Current steps use the shared registry, including FINAL_REVIEW rather than an invented REVIEW step. The analytics allowlist uses lower-case page and control IDs from the versioned registry. PAGE_VIEW requires target_id absent. optional_duration_ms is an integer from 0 through 300000, with booleans invalid; client_time is absent or a valid aware timestamp, never authoritative order.
A pending operation reference is durable before an external mock call. A definite provider failure is committed with its FAILED state and audit observation in the result transaction. If that transaction rolls back, its audit row also rolls back; the prior pending/unknown reference remains for reconciliation. Never fabricate a definite outcome or claim a rolled-back audit row persisted.

Frontend exercises show component/state ownership, contract/data flow, route/reload/resume behavior, accessibility, safe errors and tests. Form edits and router/UI state remain separate; no duplicate global store for fetched journey/application/quote data. SPA refresh uses session/bootstrap plus authenticated refetch and server-valid journey resume, not an assumed SSR hydration path. Query keys include bounded resource/version and owner/session scope; never put consumer answers or raw tokens in keys. Sensitive server-state cache is not persisted to browser storage. Preserve URL/deep-link filters. Set finite staleTime, gcTime and retry for each data class; 401/403/validation errors do not loop and writes have no blanket retry. Optional persistence is restricted to a separately supplied synthetic public-reference experiment with a version buster and finite maxAge/gcTime; private caches and queued mutations remain excluded. The user-requested journey/audit/analytics/encryption schema is also proposed. An existing fixture-mode UI is not proof that these endpoints, transactions, keys or controls exist; instructor preparation and candidate-bound evidence are required.

### One concrete daily outcome

Complete bounded admission/offset coordination in an isolated Kafka consumer model over newly versioned CoverStory status-notification envelopes.

### Earlier mapped prerequisites

### Recovered source rules and explicit teaching choices

- [ECOS-20](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-20), sections: Signals and proposed targets; Capacity and benchmark; Failure and recovery matrix; QA acceptance matrix.

Recovered product constraints for this slice:
- React → Spring modular monolith → PostgreSQL. Catalog, Shortlist, Application, Payments, Policy and Support own their data and communicate through public interfaces; no cross-module repositories. Initial runtime has no shared cache, broker or second database.
- Unknown, Verified and Synthetic describe distinct evidence states. Historical ECOS illustrations/tariffs and teaching fixture prices are not current payable quotes. Unsupported scenarios show Quote unavailable; source version, scenario and terms remain attributable.
- Product money is integer minor units plus currency. Preserve original versus edited rating/configuration revisions. Every changed amount, terms, options or revision requires explicit review and exact acceptance, including changes of 1 or 100 paise. The historical 100-paise threshold is an escalation boundary, not permission to accept small changes silently.
- Confirmed mock payment unlocks onboarding only. Explicit final submit requires complete disclosures, confirmed extraction corrections, no unresolved questions, exact current reviewed revision and reconciled confirmed/pending payment allocations. Commit SUBMISSION_PENDING and dispatch intent together. SUBMITTED requires external mock dispatch evidence; ISSUED/active-cover language requires simulated issuance/effective-cover evidence.
- Serialize cancellation with dispatch claim. Unknown/in-flight dispatch must be reconciled before claiming unsubmitted cancellation or refundable entitlement. Origin refund and wallet credit consume one unique adjustment allocation and cannot both happen. Never reroute an uncertain origin refund to a new wallet credit.
- Application net settled = confirmed external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed wallet credits allocated to the application. Pending effects reserve funds. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations, never negative; a wallet-funded portion is not also counted as an external capture.
- Renewal creates a fresh linked application and quote and leaves the old policy unchanged. A renewal nudge cannot charge, create a real mandate or promise continuous/backdated cover.
- All insurer/payment decisions and funds remain mock/simulated. Assistance is source-grounded, read-only and owner-scoped; it cannot underwrite, mutate confirmed answers, submit proposals or move money. No real PII, medical documents, credentials, provider calls, cloud spending or launch is authorized.

Anonymous discovery keeps only public device-local selections; after login an explicit owned handoff validates the source/scenario. Reload/new session recomputes allowed actions from authoritative domain state.
A server-validated domain transition, required transaction audit, journey projection and journey step event share one PostgreSQL unit of work through public interfaces. Unique (journey_id, sequence) and (journey_id, causation_id, event_code) prevent duplicate advancement. Transaction audit references actual payment/journal/adjustment/submission/renewal effects, retains failed/unknown/reconciled observations and appends corrections. Browser clicks and client timestamps never prove or order these effects.
POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most ten per batch, maximum 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Schema 1 permits only event_id, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id when ownership permits, event_name PAGE_VIEW or CONTROL_CLICK, allowlisted page_id/step_code/target_id, optional bounded duration/client time and policy metadata. No arbitrary properties, forms, health answers, amounts, email, tokens, raw URLs/referrers or DOM text. Server receive time is authoritative for receipt only. Exact event-ID replay is DUPLICATE; changed payload conflicts 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT. Invalid schema is 400, oversized body 413, rate limit 429. A 202 receipt is RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY and says nothing about business success. Browser queue is capped at twenty events and three attempts; loss/drop/reordering is allowed and cannot block checkout or owned resume. Policy-disabled clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without persisted payload. Retention/purpose/consent rules are configurable; no third-party destination or indefinite storage is assumed.
Selected synthetic consumer payloads use the prepared maintained AEAD/envelope port, proposed AES-256-GCM with a 12-byte IV and 128-bit tag. Owner checks precede decrypt. AAD binds immutable opaque object ID plus object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version; it is not secret and never enters logs/analytics. Store ciphertext and wrapped data key, never plaintext fallback or wrapping key in the database/browser/repository. IV uniqueness is required under each data key outside fixed test-vector mode. Rotation preserves business IDs/content and has its own envelope revision. In-memory test keys prove only their process lifetime; restart/restore recovery is BLOCKED without a prepared authorized retained teaching-key mechanism. Missing key is KEY_UNAVAILABLE, not empty data or recovery success. Field encryption does not prove deployment TLS, encrypted volumes/backups or legal compliance; those remain explicit configuration/evidence gates. ## Active CoverStory learning contract · semantic migration draft

CAP-201 · Day 194 · 2027-04-25 · Version the bounded analytics ingestion contract

Execution/readiness gate: PROPOSED_NOT_PREPARED and NOT_RUN. The earlier mapped health capability is contingent on prerequisite evidence. At this audit the current repository has React fixture mode and a Spring /health seam, not verified CoverStory product wiring.
