## Active CoverStory learning contract · semantic migration draft

CAP-231 · Day 224 · 2027-05-25 · Reproduce one observed marketplace failure

Execution/readiness gate: PROPOSED_NOT_PREPARED and NOT_RUN. The earlier mapped health capability is contingent on prerequisite evidence. At this audit the current repository has React fixture mode and a Spring /health seam, not verified CoverStory product wiring. Existing frontend decoders, cancellation/stale-response handling, session reset, safe errors and accessibility scaffolds may be reused only after inspection. OperatorApi/EventStatus require explicit replacement or adapter; product modules, public interfaces and forbidden-import/cycle checks remain planned instructor prerequisites.
The published Java 21/Maven and embedded PostgreSQL starter, including reported commit d623bf4bd16c6b437aa9e8908b2454c5e0256410, establishes only narrow scaffolding. Historical TODO failures, reported later fixes, this mapping and recovered design documents do not prove a solvable exercise or completed product. Before assignment, inspect the current checkout, prepare the named fixture/glue, reconcile exact API/command/test selectors and independently rehearse the full day inside its budget. If a predecessor is HOLD or physical evidence is absent, the dependent integrated result remains blocked. An explicitly isolated contract exercise may continue but cannot close that product gate.
The user-requested journey/audit/analytics/encryption schema is also proposed. An existing fixture-mode UI is not proof that these endpoints, transactions, keys or controls exist; instructor preparation and candidate-bound evidence are required.

### One concrete daily outcome

Turn one genuine late-stage CoverStory failure into a deterministic regression and the smallest bounded repair.

### Earlier mapped prerequisites

- CAP-220, Day 213 (2027-05-14): reviewed evidence required.
- CAP-226, Day 219 (2027-05-20): reviewed evidence required.
- CAP-230, Day 223 (2027-05-24): reviewed evidence required.

### Recovered source rules and explicit teaching choices

- [ECOS-20](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-20), sections: Signals and proposed targets; Capacity and benchmark; Failure and recovery matrix; QA acceptance matrix.
- [ECOS-43](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-43), sections: Scope; Acceptance criteria.
- [ECOS-44](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-44), sections: Scope; Acceptance criteria.
- [ECOS-48](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-48), sections: Scope; Acceptance criteria.
- [ECOS-63](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-63), sections: Acceptance criteria; Outcome.

Recovered product constraints for this slice:
- React → Spring modular monolith → PostgreSQL. Catalog, Shortlist, Application, Payments, Policy and Support own their data and communicate through public interfaces; no cross-module repositories. Initial runtime has no shared cache, broker or second database.
- Unknown, Verified and Synthetic describe distinct evidence states. Historical ECOS illustrations/tariffs and teaching fixture prices are not current payable quotes. Unsupported scenarios show Quote unavailable; source version, scenario and terms remain attributable.
- Product money is integer minor units plus currency. Preserve original versus edited rating/configuration revisions. Every changed amount, terms, options or revision requires explicit review and exact acceptance, including changes of 1 or 100 paise. The historical 100-paise threshold is an escalation boundary, not permission to accept small changes silently.
- Confirmed mock payment unlocks onboarding only. Explicit final submit requires complete disclosures, confirmed extraction corrections, no unresolved questions, exact current reviewed revision and reconciled confirmed/pending payment allocations. Commit SUBMISSION_PENDING and dispatch intent together. SUBMITTED requires external mock dispatch evidence; ISSUED/active-cover language requires simulated issuance/effective-cover evidence.
- Serialize cancellation with dispatch claim. Unknown/in-flight dispatch must be reconciled before claiming unsubmitted cancellation or refundable entitlement. Origin refund and wallet credit consume one unique adjustment allocation and cannot both happen. Never reroute an uncertain origin refund to a new wallet credit.
- Application net settled = confirmed external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed wallet credits allocated to the application. Pending effects reserve funds. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations, never negative; a wallet-funded portion is not also counted as an external capture.
- Renewal creates a fresh linked application and quote and leaves the old policy unchanged. A renewal nudge cannot charge, create a real mandate or promise continuous/backdated cover.
- All insurer/payment decisions and funds remain mock/simulated. Assistance is source-grounded, read-only and owner-scoped; it cannot underwrite, mutate confirmed answers, submit proposals or move money. No real PII, medical documents, credentials, provider calls, cloud spending or launch is authorized.
These are constraints on the bounded daily seam, not additional daily implementation tasks.

User-requested extension, proposed 14 October 2026:
Journey UUIDs identify records and never authorize access. ApplicationRevision and the quote own answers and accepted terms; journey is a server-maintained navigation projection, not a second mutable draft. Anonymous discovery keeps only public device-local selections; after login an explicit owned handoff validates the source/scenario. GET /api/v1/me/journeys returns minimal owned resume summaries, limit 1–50, default 20, with owner-bound cursors. GET /api/v1/journeys/{id} returns the same safe 404 for missing and foreign IDs. Reload/new session recomputes allowed actions from authoritative domain state.
A server-validated domain transition, required transaction audit, journey projection and journey step event share one PostgreSQL unit of work through public interfaces. Unique (journey_id, sequence) and (journey_id, causation_id, event_code) prevent duplicate advancement. Transaction audit references actual payment/journal/adjustment/submission/renewal effects, retains failed/unknown/reconciled observations and appends corrections. Browser clicks and client timestamps never prove or order these effects.
POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most ten per batch, maximum 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Schema 1 permits only event_id, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id when ownership permits, event_name PAGE_VIEW or CONTROL_CLICK, allowlisted page_id/step_code/target_id, optional bounded duration/client time and policy metadata. No arbitrary properties, forms, health answers, amounts, email, tokens, raw URLs/referrers or DOM text. Server receive time is authoritative for receipt only. Exact event-ID replay is DUPLICATE; changed payload conflicts 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT. Invalid schema is 400, oversized body 413, rate limit 429. A 202 receipt is RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY and says nothing about business success. Browser queue is capped at twenty events and three attempts; loss/drop/reordering is allowed and cannot block checkout or owned resume. Policy-disabled clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without persisted payload. Retention/purpose/consent rules are configurable; no third-party destination or indefinite storage is assumed.
Selected synthetic consumer payloads use the prepared maintained AEAD/envelope port, proposed AES-256-GCM with a 12-byte IV and 128-bit tag. Owner checks precede decrypt. AAD binds immutable opaque object ID plus object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version; it is not secret and never enters logs/analytics. Store ciphertext and wrapped data key, never plaintext fallback or wrapping key in the database/browser/repository. IV uniqueness is required under each data key outside fixed test-vector mode. Rotation preserves business IDs/content and has its own envelope revision. In-memory test keys prove only their process lifetime; restart/restore recovery is BLOCKED without a prepared authorized retained teaching-key mechanism. Missing key is KEY_UNAVAILABLE, not empty data or recovery success. Field encryption does not prove deployment TLS, encrypted volumes/backups or legal compliance; those remain explicit configuration/evidence gates. No real key creation, KMS grant, credential or security-setting mutation is authorized.
These additions replace existing seam work; they do not add minutes. The exact new interfaces and fixtures are teaching proposals, distinct from recovered ECOS rules.
Preserve ApplicationRevision's recovered composite key: journey (application_id, application_revision) references ApplicationRevision (application_id, revision). Do not add a revision UUID or mutable plaintext journey copy. Initial journey statuses are ACTIVE, WAITING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED and EXPIRED. Current steps use the shared registry, including FINAL_REVIEW rather than an invented REVIEW step. The analytics allowlist uses lower-case page and control IDs from the versioned registry. PAGE_VIEW requires target_id absent. optional_duration_ms is an integer from 0 through 300000, with booleans invalid; client_time is absent or a valid aware timestamp, never authoritative order.
A pending operation reference is durable before an external mock call. A definite provider failure is committed with its FAILED state and audit observation in the result transaction. If that transaction rolls back, its audit row also rolls back; the prior pending/unknown reference remains for reconciliation. Never fabricate a definite outcome or claim a rolled-back audit row persisted.
Every model/isolated experiment is a bounded CoverStory module or engineering-evidence seam in the same capstone, feeding its actual ADR/release gate. It is not a detached toy project. Frontend exercises show component/state ownership, contract/data flow, route/reload/resume behavior, accessibility, safe errors and tests. Operating exercises show configuration/key boundaries, CI/rollback, SLO/failure, backups, capacity/cost evidence and ownership at the scope actually exercised.
Latest frontend teaching stack: TanStack React Query v5 owns server state and its in-memory cache. Form edits and router/UI state remain separate; no duplicate global store for fetched journey/application/quote data. SPA refresh uses session/bootstrap plus authenticated refetch and server-valid journey resume, not an assumed SSR hydration path. Query keys include bounded resource/version and owner/session scope; never put consumer answers or raw tokens in keys. Sensitive server-state cache is not persisted to browser storage. Cancel and clear owner-scoped queries on logout, expiry or owner change; late responses cannot repopulate a new session. Guard mutations with current domain/journey versions and exact accepted terms, then invalidate/refetch the affected server state. Cached data never authorizes payment, dispatch or issuance.
Shared UI uses parameterized accessible primitives and feature compositions, with Tailwind design tokens and finite typed variants. Avoid arbitrary dynamically constructed class names or a separate per-screen styling system. Use verified open-source Inter with system-ui fallback and readable hierarchy/spacing; Proxima Nova is no longer a dependency or licensing gate. Query, Tailwind and font packages are planned until the current repository and instructor scaffold are inspected. These changes replace the same frontend-state/design tasks and add no minutes.
Frontend stack details: one stable QueryClient at the app boundary; each domain owns typed key/options factories and query hooks. Shared primitives do not fetch from other domains. Preserve URL/deep-link filters. Set finite staleTime, gcTime and retry for each data class; 401/403/validation errors do not loop and writes have no blanket retry. Background refetch must not overwrite unsaved local form input. Optional persistence is restricted to a separately supplied synthetic public-reference experiment with a version buster and finite maxAge/gcTime; private caches and queued mutations remain excluded. No Next.js, TanStack Start or SSR is added.
Use Inter source and SIL Open Font License, retaining copyright/OFL with any later distributed assets. Font-display swap and observed fallback/layout-shift checks belong to the bounded design task. Use /api/v1 and catalog spelling. Recovered ECOS-19 contains both /api/v1/... and later /api/.../catalogue routes, and requestId versus correlationId errors. Map these explicitly in a versioned teaching adapter; no aliases, route implementation or compatibility are assumed. Canonical safe error is {code, message, fieldErrors, requestId, retryable}. Exact field names/available DTOs must be reconciled at preflight; client owner/amount is never authority. The later source's SUBMISSION_PENDING/dispatch-evidence boundary supersedes the earlier shorthand that returned SUBMITTED immediately on submit. These are proposed teaching interfaces, not claims about existing endpoints.

### Concrete proposed inputs and output

An actual failure receipt supplies failureId, observedAt, failingCommit, actual command, fixture digest, expected invariant and observed output. Scope is one component boundary, at most two implementation files and one focused test. Use only a synthetic or redacted replay input.

Output: ObservedFailureRegression produces the task-specific state and case outcomes below, plus docs/evidence/coverstory/CAP-231/result.json. The receipt includes state, candidateIdentity, cases, mode, measurements, newBoundaryTest, architectureDeltaRef, history. All expected examples are proposed tests, not observed runs.

Anonymous discovery keeps only public device-local selections; after login an explicit owned handoff validates the source/scenario. Browser clicks and client timestamps never prove or order these effects.

Schema 1 permits only event_id, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id when ownership permits, event_name PAGE_VIEW or CONTROL_CLICK, allowlisted page_id/step_code/target_id, optional bounded duration/client time and policy metadata. Browser queue is capped at twenty events and three attempts; loss/drop/reordering is allowed and cannot block checkout or owned resume. Policy-disabled clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without persisted payload. Retention/purpose/consent rules are configurable; no third-party destination or indefinite storage is assumed.

### Concrete proposed inputs and output

## Active CoverStory learning contract · semantic migration draft

CAP-233 · Day 226 · 2027-05-27 · Execute the dispatch architecture trade-off

Execution/readiness gate: PROPOSED_NOT_PREPARED and NOT_RUN. The earlier mapped health capability is contingent on prerequisite evidence. At this audit the current repository has React fixture mode and a Spring /health seam, not verified CoverStory product wiring. Existing frontend decoders, cancellation/stale-response handling, session reset, safe errors and accessibility scaffolds may be reused only after inspection. OperatorApi/EventStatus require explicit replacement or adapter; product modules, public interfaces and forbidden-import/cycle checks remain planned instructor prerequisites.
The published Java 21/Maven and embedded PostgreSQL starter, including reported commit d623bf4bd16c6b437aa9e8908b2454c5e0256410, establishes only narrow scaffolding. Historical TODO failures, reported later fixes, this mapping and recovered design documents do not prove a solvable exercise or completed product. Before assignment, inspect the current checkout, prepare the named fixture/glue, reconcile exact API/command/test selectors and independently rehearse the full day inside its budget. If a predecessor is HOLD or physical evidence is absent, the dependent integrated result remains blocked. An explicitly isolated contract exercise may continue but cannot close that product gate.
The user-requested journey/audit/analytics/encryption schema is also proposed. An existing fixture-mode UI is not proof that these endpoints, transactions, keys or controls exist; instructor preparation and candidate-bound evidence are required.

### One concrete daily outcome

Implement a bounded comparison of inline versus SQL-outbox dispatch under the same crash schedule, using new synthetic CoverStory operations and mock receiver.

### Earlier mapped prerequisites

- CAP-197, Day 190 (2027-04-21): reviewed evidence required.
- CAP-198, Day 191 (2027-04-22): reviewed evidence required.
- CAP-208, Day 201 (2027-05-02): reviewed evidence required.
- CAP-231, Day 224 (2027-05-25): reviewed evidence required.

### Recovered source rules and explicit teaching choices

- [ECOS-2](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-2), sections: Decision; Validation and reversal.
- [ECOS-10](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-10), sections: Decision and requirements; Validation and revisit trigger; Onboarding and proposal boundary.
- [ECOS-13](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-13), sections: Decision and requirements; Validation and revisit trigger.
- [ECOS-20](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-20), sections: Signals and proposed targets; Capacity and benchmark; Failure and recovery matrix; QA acceptance matrix.
- [ECOS-64](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-64), sections: Onboarding and proposal boundary; Refund destination and mock wallet.
- [ECOS-65](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-65), sections: Onboarding and proposal boundary; Dependencies and evidence.

Recovered product constraints for this slice:
- React → Spring modular monolith → PostgreSQL. Catalog, Shortlist, Application, Payments, Policy and Support own their data and communicate through public interfaces; no cross-module repositories. Initial runtime has no shared cache, broker or second database.
- Unknown, Verified and Synthetic describe distinct evidence states. Historical ECOS illustrations/tariffs and teaching fixture prices are not current payable quotes. Unsupported scenarios show Quote unavailable; source version, scenario and terms remain attributable.
- Product money is integer minor units plus currency. Preserve original versus edited rating/configuration revisions. Every changed amount, terms, options or revision requires explicit review and exact acceptance, including changes of 1 or 100 paise. The historical 100-paise threshold is an escalation boundary, not permission to accept small changes silently.
- Confirmed mock payment unlocks onboarding only. Explicit final submit requires complete disclosures, confirmed extraction corrections, no unresolved questions, exact current reviewed revision and reconciled confirmed/pending payment allocations. Commit SUBMISSION_PENDING and dispatch intent together. SUBMITTED requires external mock dispatch evidence; ISSUED/active-cover language requires simulated issuance/effective-cover evidence.
- Serialize cancellation with dispatch claim. Unknown/in-flight dispatch must be reconciled before claiming unsubmitted cancellation or refundable entitlement. Origin refund and wallet credit consume one unique adjustment allocation and cannot both happen. Never reroute an uncertain origin refund to a new wallet credit.
- Application net settled = confirmed external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed wallet credits allocated to the application. Pending effects reserve funds. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations, never negative; a wallet-funded portion is not also counted as an external capture.
- Renewal creates a fresh linked application and quote and leaves the old policy unchanged. A renewal nudge cannot charge, create a real mandate or promise continuous/backdated cover.
- All insurer/payment decisions and funds remain mock/simulated. Assistance is source-grounded, read-only and owner-scoped; it cannot underwrite, mutate confirmed answers, submit proposals or move money. No real PII, medical documents, credentials, provider calls, cloud spending or launch is authorized.
These are constraints on the bounded daily seam, not additional daily implementation tasks.

User-requested extension, proposed 14 October 2026:
Journey UUIDs identify records and never authorize access. ApplicationRevision and the quote own answers and accepted terms; journey is a server-maintained navigation projection, not a second mutable draft. Anonymous discovery keeps only public device-local selections; after login an explicit owned handoff validates the source/scenario. GET /api/v1/me/journeys returns minimal owned resume summaries, limit 1–50, default 20, with owner-bound cursors. GET /api/v1/journeys/{id} returns the same safe 404 for missing and foreign IDs. Reload/new session recomputes allowed actions from authoritative domain state.
A server-validated domain transition, required transaction audit, journey projection and journey step event share one PostgreSQL unit of work through public interfaces. Unique (journey_id, sequence) and (journey_id, causation_id, event_code) prevent duplicate advancement. Transaction audit references actual payment/journal/adjustment/submission/renewal effects, retains failed/unknown/reconciled observations and appends corrections. Browser clicks and client timestamps never prove or order these effects.
POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most ten per batch, maximum 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Schema 1 permits only event_id, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id when ownership permits, event_name PAGE_VIEW or CONTROL_CLICK, allowlisted page_id/step_code/target_id, optional bounded duration/client time and policy metadata. No arbitrary properties, forms, health answers, amounts, email, tokens, raw URLs/referrers or DOM text. Server receive time is authoritative for receipt only. Exact event-ID replay is DUPLICATE; changed payload conflicts 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT. Invalid schema is 400, oversized body 413, rate limit 429. A 202 receipt is RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY and says nothing about business success. Browser queue is capped at twenty events and three attempts; loss/drop/reordering is allowed and cannot block checkout or owned resume. Policy-disabled clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without persisted payload. Retention/purpose/consent rules are configurable; no third-party destination or indefinite storage is assumed.
Selected synthetic consumer payloads use the prepared maintained AEAD/envelope port, proposed AES-256-GCM with a 12-byte IV and 128-bit tag. Owner checks precede decrypt. AAD binds immutable opaque object ID plus object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version; it is not secret and never enters logs/analytics. Store ciphertext and wrapped data key, never plaintext fallback or wrapping key in the database/browser/repository. IV uniqueness is required under each data key outside fixed test-vector mode. Rotation preserves business IDs/content and has its own envelope revision. In-memory test keys prove only their process lifetime; restart/restore recovery is BLOCKED without a prepared authorized retained teaching-key mechanism. Missing key is KEY_UNAVAILABLE, not empty data or recovery success. Field encryption does not prove deployment TLS, encrypted volumes/backups or legal compliance; those remain explicit configuration/evidence gates. No real key creation, KMS grant, credential or security-setting mutation is authorized.
These additions replace existing seam work; they do not add minutes. The exact new interfaces and fixtures are teaching proposals, distinct from recovered ECOS rules.
Preserve ApplicationRevision's recovered composite key: journey (application_id, application_revision) references ApplicationRevision (application_id, revision). Do not add a revision UUID or mutable plaintext journey copy. Initial journey statuses are ACTIVE, WAITING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED and EXPIRED. Current steps use the shared registry, including FINAL_REVIEW rather than an invented REVIEW step. The analytics allowlist uses lower-case page and control IDs from the versioned registry. PAGE_VIEW requires target_id absent. optional_duration_ms is an integer from 0 through 300000, with booleans invalid; client_time is absent or a valid aware timestamp, never authoritative order.
A pending operation reference is durable before an external mock call. A definite provider failure is committed with its FAILED state and audit observation in the result transaction. If that transaction rolls back, its audit row also rolls back; the prior pending/unknown reference remains for reconciliation. Never fabricate a definite outcome or claim a rolled-back audit row persisted.
Every model/isolated experiment is a bounded CoverStory module or engineering-evidence seam in the same capstone, feeding its actual ADR/release gate. It is not a detached toy project. Frontend exercises show component/state ownership, contract/data flow, route/reload/resume behavior, accessibility, safe errors and tests. Operating exercises show configuration/key boundaries, CI/rollback, SLO/failure, backups, capacity/cost evidence and ownership at the scope actually exercised.
Latest frontend teaching stack: TanStack React Query v5 owns server state and its in-memory cache. Form edits and router/UI state remain separate; no duplicate global store for fetched journey/application/quote data. SPA refresh uses session/bootstrap plus authenticated refetch and server-valid journey resume, not an assumed SSR hydration path. Query keys include bounded resource/version and owner/session scope; never put consumer answers or raw tokens in keys. Sensitive server-state cache is not persisted to browser storage. Cancel and clear owner-scoped queries on logout, expiry or owner change; late responses cannot repopulate a new session. Guard mutations with current domain/journey versions and exact accepted terms, then invalidate/refetch the affected server state. Cached data never authorizes payment, dispatch or issuance.
Shared UI uses parameterized accessible primitives and feature compositions, with Tailwind design tokens and finite typed variants. Avoid arbitrary dynamically constructed class names or a separate per-screen styling system. Use verified open-source Inter with system-ui fallback and readable hierarchy/spacing; Proxima Nova is no longer a dependency or licensing gate. Query, Tailwind and font packages are planned until the current repository and instructor scaffold are inspected. These changes replace the same frontend-state/design tasks and add no minutes.
Frontend stack details: one stable QueryClient at the app boundary; each domain owns typed key/options factories and query hooks. Shared primitives do not fetch from other domains. Preserve URL/deep-link filters. Set finite staleTime, gcTime and retry for each data class; 401/403/validation errors do not loop and writes have no blanket retry. Background refetch must not overwrite unsaved local form input. Optional persistence is restricted to a separately supplied synthetic public-reference experiment with a version buster and finite maxAge/gcTime; private caches and queued mutations remain excluded. No Next.js, TanStack Start or SSR is added.
Use Inter source and SIL Open Font License, retaining copyright/OFL with any later distributed assets. Font-display swap and observed fallback/layout-shift checks belong to the bounded design task. Shared paths are frontend/src/coverstory/shared/ui/, shared/theme/ and shared/query/. Tailwind official pages currently describe v4 @theme; inspect the actual installed major and do not upgrade silently.

Proposed canonical API v1 reconciliation, pending instructor review:
Use /api/v1 and catalog spelling. Recovered ECOS-19 contains both /api/v1/... and later /api/.../catalogue routes, and requestId versus correlationId errors. Map these explicitly in a versioned teaching adapter; no aliases, route implementation or compatibility are assumed. Canonical safe error is {code, message, fieldErrors, requestId, retryable}. Later correlationId is mapped to requestId without copying unsafe body text. Expected version and reviewed revision remain distinct.
The proposed acceptance record binds applicationId, expectedVersion, reviewedRevision, ratingRevision, quoteId, scenarioHash, configurationHash, sourceVersion, ruleVersion, termsHash, totalMinor, currency and consent to the authenticated owner. Exact field names/available DTOs must be reconciled at preflight; client owner/amount is never authority. The later source's SUBMISSION_PENDING/dispatch-evidence boundary supersedes the earlier shorthand that returned SUBMITTED immediately on submit. These are proposed teaching interfaces, not claims about existing endpoints.

### Concrete proposed inputs and output

Two explicit, reviewed and reconciled synthetic submissions are cs-app1 / revision 1 and cs-app2 / revision 1. Inline design stores then sends; crash cs-app1 after the database commit. Outbox design atomically stores domain state and intent under the same crash schedule. Recovery redelivers cs-app1 once. The mock receiver deduplicates by owner, application, reviewed revision and business operation.

The user-requested journey/audit/analytics/encryption schema is also proposed. An existing fixture-mode UI is not proof that these endpoints, transactions, keys or controls exist; instructor preparation and candidate-bound evidence are required.

### One concrete daily outcome

Implement one bounded parameter validation seam in the existing owner-scoped diagnostics endpoint and connect only demonstrated work to an actual optional job description.

### Earlier mapped prerequisites

- CAP-232, Day 225 (2027-05-26): reviewed evidence required.
- CAP-233, Day 226 (2027-05-27): reviewed evidence required.

### Recovered source rules and explicit teaching choices

- [ECOS-11](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-11), sections: Decision and requirements; Authentication and resume; Validation and revisit trigger.
- [ECOS-19](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-19), sections: Context and modules; API v1; Configuration, wallet and policy lifecycle contract.
- [ECOS-36](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-36), sections: Scope; Acceptance criteria.
- [ECOS-48](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-48), sections: Scope; Acceptance criteria.

Recovered product constraints for this slice:
- React → Spring modular monolith → PostgreSQL. Catalog, Shortlist, Application, Payments, Policy and Support own their data and communicate through public interfaces; no cross-module repositories. Initial runtime has no shared cache, broker or second database.
- Unknown, Verified and Synthetic describe distinct evidence states. Historical ECOS illustrations/tariffs and teaching fixture prices are not current payable quotes. Unsupported scenarios show Quote unavailable; source version, scenario and terms remain attributable.
- Product money is integer minor units plus currency. Preserve original versus edited rating/configuration revisions. Every changed amount, terms, options or revision requires explicit review and exact acceptance, including changes of 1 or 100 paise. The historical 100-paise threshold is an escalation boundary, not permission to accept small changes silently.
- Confirmed mock payment unlocks onboarding only. Explicit final submit requires complete disclosures, confirmed extraction corrections, no unresolved questions, exact current reviewed revision and reconciled confirmed/pending payment allocations. Commit SUBMISSION_PENDING and dispatch intent together. SUBMITTED requires external mock dispatch evidence; ISSUED/active-cover language requires simulated issuance/effective-cover evidence.
- Serialize cancellation with dispatch claim. Unknown/in-flight dispatch must be reconciled before claiming unsubmitted cancellation or refundable entitlement. Origin refund and wallet credit consume one unique adjustment allocation and cannot both happen. Never reroute an uncertain origin refund to a new wallet credit.
- Application net settled = confirmed external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed wallet credits allocated to the application. Pending effects reserve funds. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations, never negative; a wallet-funded portion is not also counted as an external capture.
- Renewal creates a fresh linked application and quote and leaves the old policy unchanged. A renewal nudge cannot charge, create a real mandate or promise continuous/backdated cover.
- All insurer/payment decisions and funds remain mock/simulated. Assistance is source-grounded, read-only and owner-scoped; it cannot underwrite, mutate confirmed answers, submit proposals or move money. No real PII, medical documents, credentials, provider calls, cloud spending or launch is authorized.
These are constraints on the bounded daily seam, not additional daily implementation tasks.

User-requested extension, proposed 14 October 2026:
Journey UUIDs identify records and never authorize access. ApplicationRevision and the quote own answers and accepted terms; journey is a server-maintained navigation projection, not a second mutable draft. Anonymous discovery keeps only public device-local selections; after login an explicit owned handoff validates the source/scenario. GET /api/v1/me/journeys returns minimal owned resume summaries, limit 1–50, default 20, with owner-bound cursors. GET /api/v1/journeys/{id} returns the same safe 404 for missing and foreign IDs. Reload/new session recomputes allowed actions from authoritative domain state.
A server-validated domain transition, required transaction audit, journey projection and journey step event share one PostgreSQL unit of work through public interfaces. Unique (journey_id, sequence) and (journey_id, causation_id, event_code) prevent duplicate advancement. Transaction audit references actual payment/journal/adjustment/submission/renewal effects, retains failed/unknown/reconciled observations and appends corrections. Browser clicks and client timestamps never prove or order these effects.
POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most ten per batch, maximum 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Schema 1 permits only event_id, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id when ownership permits, event_name PAGE_VIEW or CONTROL_CLICK, allowlisted page_id/step_code/target_id, optional bounded duration/client time and policy metadata. No arbitrary properties, forms, health answers, amounts, email, tokens, raw URLs/referrers or DOM text. Server receive time is authoritative for receipt only. Exact event-ID replay is DUPLICATE; changed payload conflicts 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT. Invalid schema is 400, oversized body 413, rate limit 429. A 202 receipt is RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY and says nothing about business success. Browser queue is capped at twenty events and three attempts; loss/drop/reordering is allowed and cannot block checkout or owned resume. Policy-disabled clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without persisted payload. Retention/purpose/consent rules are configurable; no third-party destination or indefinite storage is assumed.
Selected synthetic consumer payloads use the prepared maintained AEAD/envelope port, proposed AES-256-GCM with a 12-byte IV and 128-bit tag. Owner checks precede decrypt. AAD binds immutable opaque object ID plus object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version; it is not secret and never enters logs/analytics. Store ciphertext and wrapped data key, never plaintext fallback or wrapping key in the database/browser/repository. IV uniqueness is required under each data key outside fixed test-vector mode. Rotation preserves business IDs/content and has its own envelope revision. In-memory test keys prove only their process lifetime; restart/restore recovery is BLOCKED without a prepared authorized retained teaching-key mechanism. Missing key is KEY_UNAVAILABLE, not empty data or recovery success. Field encryption does not prove deployment TLS, encrypted volumes/backups or legal compliance; those remain explicit configuration/evidence gates. No real key creation, KMS grant, credential or security-setting mutation is authorized.
These additions replace existing seam work; they do not add minutes. The exact new interfaces and fixtures are teaching proposals, distinct from recovered ECOS rules.
Preserve ApplicationRevision's recovered composite key: journey (application_id, application_revision) references ApplicationRevision (application_id, revision). Do not add a revision UUID or mutable plaintext journey copy. Initial journey statuses are ACTIVE, WAITING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED and EXPIRED. Current steps use the shared registry, including FINAL_REVIEW rather than an invented REVIEW step. The analytics allowlist uses lower-case page and control IDs from the versioned registry. PAGE_VIEW requires target_id absent. optional_duration_ms is an integer from 0 through 300000, with booleans invalid; client_time is absent or a valid aware timestamp, never authoritative order.
A pending operation reference is durable before an external mock call. A definite provider failure is committed with its FAILED state and audit observation in the result transaction. If that transaction rolls back, its audit row also rolls back; the prior pending/unknown reference remains for reconciliation. Never fabricate a definite outcome or claim a rolled-back audit row persisted.
Every model/isolated experiment is a bounded CoverStory module or engineering-evidence seam in the same capstone, feeding its actual ADR/release gate. It is not a detached toy project. Frontend exercises show component/state ownership, contract/data flow, route/reload/resume behavior, accessibility, safe errors and tests. Operating exercises show configuration/key boundaries, CI/rollback, SLO/failure, backups, capacity/cost evidence and ownership at the scope actually exercised.

Form edits and router/UI state remain separate; no duplicate global store for fetched journey/application/quote data. SPA refresh uses session/bootstrap plus authenticated refetch and server-valid journey resume, not an assumed SSR hydration path. Query keys include bounded resource/version and owner/session scope; never put consumer answers or raw tokens in keys. Sensitive server-state cache is not persisted to browser storage. Cancel and clear owner-scoped queries on logout, expiry or owner change; late responses cannot repopulate a new session. Guard mutations with current domain/journey versions and exact accepted terms, then invalidate/refetch the affected server state. Cached data never authorizes payment, dispatch or issuance.

Avoid arbitrary dynamically constructed class names or a separate per-screen styling system. Query, Tailwind and font packages are planned until the current repository and instructor scaffold are inspected. These changes replace the same frontend-state/design tasks and add no minutes.

Preserve URL/deep-link filters. Set finite staleTime, gcTime and retry for each data class; 401/403/validation errors do not loop and writes have no blanket retry. Background refetch must not overwrite unsaved local form input. Optional persistence is restricted to a separately supplied synthetic public-reference experiment with a version buster and finite maxAge/gcTime; private caches and queued mutations remain excluded. Use /api/v1 and catalog spelling. Recovered ECOS-19 contains both /api/v1/... and later /api/.../catalogue routes, and requestId versus correlationId errors. Map these explicitly in a versioned teaching adapter; no aliases, route implementation or compatibility are assumed. Canonical safe error is {code, message, fieldErrors, requestId, retryable}. Explain validation-before-work, ownership and backward-compatible default; independent code change matters more than rehearsed terminology.
Update a supplied existing view with at most three changed facts; at most six entities/classes/components or ten sequence messages. ER views show keys/cardinality; module/UML views show responsibility and dependency direction; sequence/data flow names the relevant trust/transaction boundary.
Tie one changed fact to an actual daily test/measurement receipt; no diagram-only completion.
Interview: Explain the invariant behind rehearse one timed product code change, one rejected alternative, the observed or unobserved boundary, and what evidence would change the decision.
At most five minutes replace existing practical documentation/evidence explanation; at most three minutes replace existing reflection/explain-back. No added time. On Sunday the interview explanation is individual evidence, not mandatory DSM.

### Active budget, bounds and evidence

Total 150 minutes: practical 95 (10 docs + 55 bounded build + 30 tests/evidence), AWS 30 (20 theory/source + 10 questions/explanations), DSA retention 15, DSM/design reflection 10. No additional time.

INSTRUCTOR_TIMEBOX_CHECK_REQUIRED. The exact AWS prefix above is unchanged. If the complete seam and fixed tests do not fit, mark OVER_CAPACITY and propose an explicit reviewed in-budget reduction before assignment. No silent deletion of acceptance cases or additional evening work.

Bounds: only a disposable, isolated local target and synthetic inputs. Hard maximum is 20 clients, 5000 requests and five minutes per load run; today's lower limits take precedence. Historical ECOS-15/20 12,000-request, ten-minute workload is not adopted. Any optional Redis/Kafka/replica/Kubernetes work is a removable isolated experiment or offline model with an ADR, evidence, fallback and rollback; it is not a baseline runtime requirement or a claim of adoption. Do not install or provision infrastructure as hidden learner work. Stop at invariant breach, the declared resource/error limit or deadline and retain failed/inconclusive observations.
Daily lower bound: {"max_clients": 2, "max_requests": 20, "max_seconds": 60, "mode": "focused deterministic or isolated local test; no external workload"}.

Evidence must name the actual commit or working-tree digest, runtime/tool versions, candidate/source/schema/configuration identities, fixture digest computed from actual UTF-8 bytes, UTC execution time, exact command and target, per-case expected/actual result, safe diagnostic output and limitations. Keep setup smoke, instructor solvability witness and learner acceptance separate. Preserve prior failures and distinguish OBSERVED_LOCAL, SIMULATED and NOT_RUN. Screenshots/measurements count only when actually produced. Physical SQL locking/durability, a browser interaction or restored data cannot be claimed from a pure fake. A release gate never authorizes release, deployment, insurer communication, payment or career action.

### Migration and preserved history

Migration/history: this is a semantic replacement of the active generic task body, not an added second project. Keep the original CAP ID, day/date, status and comments/history, native parent/component/sprint/relationship fields and certification allocation unchanged. Earlier generic learning fixtures and their original receipts remain historical regression evidence. Do not reinterpret old events, amounts, owners or source chunks as insurance records; new CoverStory fixtures and adapters have separate versions, provenance and conservation checks. Original narrative is preserved in the local review baseline and board history, not stacked below the active learner task. Dependency references here propose readiness checks only and do not mutate native links.

Day 228 · 2027-05-29 · verified curriculum snapshot 13 October 2026. This is a proposed learning allocation, not a learner-ready or completed assignment.

This is the single active certification allocation. It supersedes earlier conflicting course, review and budget allocations. No extra study block is added. Linked components have 0 additional scheduled minutes. Capstone acceptance outcomes, source history and 150-minute cap stay intact.

**Authoritative combined timebox: 150 minutes maximum.** Capstone focused docs 10m + bounded build 55m + tests/actual evidence 30m =95m; certification theory/source 20m + questions/explanations 10m =30m; DSA 15m; DSM/design reflection 10m.

All embedded historical component/timebox figures below are superseded only for current scheduling by this allocation. Retained component(s) share the same 95-minute capstone envelope; do not charge certification, DSA or DSM twice. The original IDs, dates, scaffold, acceptance cases and completion requirements remain. No extra evening or catch-up work is implied.

INSTRUCTOR_TIMEBOX_CHECK_REQUIRED. Keep the existing capstone acceptance contract; before assigning, prove its supplied scaffold and TODO fit the 95-minute docs/build/test envelope. If not, mark OVER_CAPACITY and propose an explicit in-budget reduction before the learner day; do not compress by assertion, add evening work, silently drop tests, or call the ticket learner-ready.

### Verified Udemy content selected for this day

PENDING_ENTITLEMENT_CHECK: Udemy catalog titles/sections/durations verified 13 October 2026; owned courses, subscription inclusion, playable access and prior attempts are unknown. If unavailable, use the linked official source in the same slot and record ACCESS_PENDING. No purchase or enrollment is authorized.

No new video is required. Use this slot for the stated topic-question or due-error review; stop early if there is no due work.

Use 20 minutes for a bounded topic question set or current-guide gap review, and 10 minutes for explained corrections. Use verified question IDs/ordinals from the ledger; repeated questions are review. Do not claim a complete mock or fresh-question availability until the actual pool is checked. These 30 minutes replace ordinary theory/practice; nothing is added.

### Official objective relevance, not a mastery claim

- [DVA-C02 task 3.1](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-certification/latest/developer-associate-02/developer-associate-02-domain3.html) · ROTATING_RECALL_SEED; USE_WEAKEST_DUE_OBJECTIVE; LEGACY_C02_REFERENCE_NOT_C03_ALIGNMENT. These are curriculum-relevance links; keep any existing no-direct-mapping label on today's capstone implementation.

### Practice-question source

- [Practice Test #4 (AWS Certified Developer Associate - DVA-C02) — candidate training source only](https://www.udemy.com/course/aws-certified-developer-associate-practice-tests-dva-c01/) · BOUNDED_TOPIC_PRACTICE_NOT_FULL_MOCK. Up to 2–3 verified unused questions if available; otherwise explicitly labeled review. Per-test inventory is unverified.

The 15-minute DSA allocation is minimum retention, not a replacement for assigned Java/Top150 outcomes. Relevant Java/DSA implementation and due reviews explicitly remain inside the practical build slice on the days that assign them. Preserve the canonical problem order and history; do not mark attempted as solved or silently remove original learning outcomes.

Log the actual lecture interval completed, exam/version/objective, question source and count, first-attempt score, one explained correction and due date; keep the capstone commit/command/fixture/pass-fail-not-run evidence separate. Do not reproduce proprietary question text.

Reading/watching only. Hands On denotes the instructor demonstration; it does not authorize account creation, credential generation, IAM/security changes, AWS spending, enrollment, purchase or exam booking. Real cloud labs require separately authorized access/budget.

Follow the official AWS Software Development Engineer pathway: optional Cloud Practitioner foundation check; AI Practitioner; Developer Associate; then readiness-gated DevOps Engineer Professional. Generative AI Developer Professional is a deeper extension, not an automatic extra exam. SAA content is selected architecture support only. Professional exams are not promised within this 228-day window.

The planned next study stage is Developer Associate C03. Carry unresolved AIF knowledge gaps in this same slot if needed; do not add minutes or claim AIF earned. Developer study does not require a prior AWS certificate. Every C02-derived lecture/question remains explicitly partial until the C03 guide and resource updates have been reconciled.

Exam goal and course completion are not readiness. Require the current official objective gap audit, actual relevant lab evidence, explained errors, and two fresh complete timed practice exams. A local planning threshold is 85% on each with no domain below 75%; these are not AWS scaled passing scores or guarantees. Keep question IDs/ordinals and usage history. No purchase or booking is authorized.

DVA-C03 full simulation requires 130 minutes. It is not added to today's unchanged capstone contract. A later explicitly rescoped simulation day can use 130m timed exam + 10m concrete capstone correction/regression evidence + 5m DSA recall + 5m DSM (Sunday: individual evidence), with explanation review in the next existing certification slot. Preserve legacy DVA Tests 5–6 unseen, but they do not qualify as C03 mocks unless the provider updates and verifies their C03 alignment. Until both scheduling and version alignment are resolved, full C03 simulation remains blocked.


### Official AWS pathway and version gate

[AWS role-based pathway, current homepage-linked 2026 PDF](https://d1.awsstatic.com/onedam/marketing-channels/website/aws/en_US/certification/approved/pdfs/AWS_certification_paths.pdf). [AWS eligibility policy](https://aws.amazon.com/certification/policies/before-testing/) confirms that these are recommended paths, not mandatory certification prerequisites. The course sequence follows the Software Development Engineer row.

Follow the official AWS Software Development Engineer pathway: optional Cloud Practitioner foundation check; AI Practitioner; Developer Associate; then readiness-gated DevOps Engineer Professional. Generative AI Developer Professional is a deeper extension, not an automatic extra exam. SAA content is selected architecture support only. Professional exams are not promised within this 228-day window.

Target Developer Associate DVA-C03 for the planned 2027 window. AWS announces registration/full guide on 27 October 2026 and GA delivery on 1 December 2026; DVA-C02 ends 30 November 2026. As verified 13 October 2026, the Maarek teaching course and practice pack are still labeled DVA-C02. Their assigned material is stable-concept preparation only; C03 task-level alignment, updated questions and full coverage are unverified. Do not relabel C02 question scores as C03 readiness.

[AWS Developer Associate page](https://aws.amazon.com/certification/certified-developer-associate/) · [AWS September 2026 update](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/training-and-certification/september-2026-new-offerings/).

Target Developer Associate DVA-C03 for the planned 2027 window. AWS announces registration/full guide on 27 October 2026 and GA delivery on 1 December 2026; DVA-C02 ends 30 November 2026. As verified 13 October 2026, the Maarek teaching course and practice pack are still labeled DVA-C02. Their assigned material is stable-concept preparation only; C03 task-level alignment, updated questions and full coverage are unverified. Do not relabel C02 question scores as C03 readiness. Recheck the official guide and current Udemy curriculum before this stage. The slot may be replaced by a verified C03 delta topic only after its exact objective and source are recorded; never invent future lecture titles or treat this provisional C02 mapping as complete C03 coverage.

Next AWS pathway stage: DevOps Engineer Professional (DOP-C02), readiness-gated. Compare demonstrated AWS provisioning/operations and SDLC experience with AWS's recommended 2+ years; keep the Maarek DOP course as a later resource, not an automatic exam or a complete course squeezed into this window. GenAI Developer Professional (AIP-C01) is the deeper extension; AWS recommends 2+ years of production-app experience and 1 year implementing GenAI. Both professional exams last 180 minutes, exceeding the current 150-minute daily cap, so a future full-simulation/exam session needs an explicit scheduling exception or later plan. No mandatory certificate prerequisites are implied.

Later resource only: [AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional 2026 - DOP-C02](https://www.udemy.com/course/aws-certified-devops-engineer-professional-hands-on/), catalog duration 17h 3m 42s. [Official DOP guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-certification/latest/devops-engineer-professional-02/devops-engineer-professional-02.html). No full-course assignment or exam booking is implied.

### Question-pool and repeat control

Candidate training source: [Practice Test #4 (AWS Certified Developer Associate - DVA-C02)](https://www.udemy.com/course/aws-certified-developer-associate-practice-tests-dva-c01/). Rotate training Tests 1, 2, 3, 4; reserve Tests 5, 6 unseen for full-readiness simulations. The catalog verified test titles, not the per-test question inventory. Pool alignment: DVA-C02_LEGACY_PRACTICE_ONLY_NOT_C03_READY.

Use section quizzes first. Rotate candidate training tests only if the player permits bounded topic practice. Inspect test inventory and the saved attempt ledger first. Record course/test ID, platform question ID or stable test/version/ordinal, objective, first-seen date, attempt count, result and review due date. Count only actually unseen questions as fresh; once the available training pool is exhausted, use logged error review or separately sourced official questions and state the change. Never draw from reserved tests without moving the readiness gate. No question-text copying.

Do not assume unlimited fresh questions or a fixed per-test question count. If the player does not support bounded topic selection, use a relevant section quiz or explicitly labeled error review; do not start a full mock in a 30-minute slot.

## Active CoverStory learning contract · semantic migration draft

CAP-235 · Day 228 · 2027-05-29 · Assess Phase 1 CoverStory and switch readiness

Execution/readiness gate: PROPOSED_NOT_PREPARED and NOT_RUN. The earlier mapped health capability is contingent on prerequisite evidence. At this audit the current repository has React fixture mode and a Spring /health seam, not verified CoverStory product wiring. Existing frontend decoders, cancellation/stale-response handling, session reset, safe errors and accessibility scaffolds may be reused only after inspection. OperatorApi/EventStatus require explicit replacement or adapter; product modules, public interfaces and forbidden-import/cycle checks remain planned instructor prerequisites.
The published Java 21/Maven and embedded PostgreSQL starter, including reported commit d623bf4bd16c6b437aa9e8908b2454c5e0256410, establishes only narrow scaffolding. Historical TODO failures, reported later fixes, this mapping and recovered design documents do not prove a solvable exercise or completed product. Before assignment, inspect the current checkout, prepare the named fixture/glue, reconcile exact API/command/test selectors and independently rehearse the full day inside its budget. If a predecessor is HOLD or physical evidence is absent, the dependent integrated result remains blocked. An explicitly isolated contract exercise may continue but cannot close that product gate.
The user-requested journey/audit/analytics/encryption schema is also proposed. An existing fixture-mode UI is not proof that these endpoints, transactions, keys or controls exist; instructor preparation and candidate-bound evidence are required.

### One concrete daily outcome

Assess the Phase 1 switch-readiness checkpoint against existing candidate-bound evidence and run only the prepared bounded smoke; do not implement missing product features during this checkpoint. Day 228 closes this 228-day phase, not all future mastery. The approved deep-mastery phase runs from 30 May 2027 through 29 May 2028. Every acceptance, HOLD and evidence gate below remains unchanged and applies to the actual Phase 1 candidate; completing this assessment does not guarantee job readiness or an offer.

### Earlier mapped prerequisites

- CAP-38, Day 183 (2027-04-14): reviewed evidence required.
- CAP-220, Day 213 (2027-05-14): reviewed evidence required.
- CAP-226, Day 219 (2027-05-20): reviewed evidence required.
- CAP-230, Day 223 (2027-05-24): reviewed evidence required.
- CAP-231, Day 224 (2027-05-25): reviewed evidence required.
- CAP-232, Day 225 (2027-05-26): reviewed evidence required.
- CAP-234, Day 227 (2027-05-28): reviewed evidence required.

### Recovered source rules and explicit teaching choices

- [ECOS-2](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-2), sections: Decision; Validation and reversal.
- [ECOS-19](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-19), sections: Context and modules; API v1; Configuration, wallet and policy lifecycle contract.
- [ECOS-20](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-20), sections: Signals and proposed targets; Capacity and benchmark; Failure and recovery matrix; QA acceptance matrix.
- [ECOS-48](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-48), sections: Scope; Acceptance criteria.
- [ECOS-50](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-50), sections: Requirement → work → decision → evidence; Release review.
- [ECOS-63](https://dwait-to-adwait.youtrack.cloud/issue/ECOS-63), sections: Acceptance criteria; Outcome.

Recovered product constraints for this slice:
- React → Spring modular monolith → PostgreSQL. Catalog, Shortlist, Application, Payments, Policy and Support own their data and communicate through public interfaces; no cross-module repositories. Initial runtime has no shared cache, broker or second database.
- Unknown, Verified and Synthetic describe distinct evidence states. Historical ECOS illustrations/tariffs and teaching fixture prices are not current payable quotes. Unsupported scenarios show Quote unavailable; source version, scenario and terms remain attributable.
- Product money is integer minor units plus currency. Preserve original versus edited rating/configuration revisions. Every changed amount, terms, options or revision requires explicit review and exact acceptance, including changes of 1 or 100 paise. The historical 100-paise threshold is an escalation boundary, not permission to accept small changes silently.
- Confirmed mock payment unlocks onboarding only. Explicit final submit requires complete disclosures, confirmed extraction corrections, no unresolved questions, exact current reviewed revision and reconciled confirmed/pending payment allocations. Commit SUBMISSION_PENDING and dispatch intent together. SUBMITTED requires external mock dispatch evidence; ISSUED/active-cover language requires simulated issuance/effective-cover evidence.
- Serialize cancellation with dispatch claim. Unknown/in-flight dispatch must be reconciled before claiming unsubmitted cancellation or refundable entitlement. Origin refund and wallet credit consume one unique adjustment allocation and cannot both happen. Never reroute an uncertain origin refund to a new wallet credit.
- Application net settled = confirmed external captures + applied wallet debits − confirmed origin refunds − confirmed wallet credits allocated to the application. Pending effects reserve funds. Wallet available = confirmed credits − confirmed debits − active reservations, never negative; a wallet-funded portion is not also counted as an external capture.
- Renewal creates a fresh linked application and quote and leaves the old policy unchanged. A renewal nudge cannot charge, create a real mandate or promise continuous/backdated cover.
- All insurer/payment decisions and funds remain mock/simulated. Assistance is source-grounded, read-only and owner-scoped; it cannot underwrite, mutate confirmed answers, submit proposals or move money. No real PII, medical documents, credentials, provider calls, cloud spending or launch is authorized.
These are constraints on the bounded daily seam, not additional daily implementation tasks.

User-requested extension, proposed 14 October 2026:
Journey UUIDs identify records and never authorize access. ApplicationRevision and the quote own answers and accepted terms; journey is a server-maintained navigation projection, not a second mutable draft. Anonymous discovery keeps only public device-local selections; after login an explicit owned handoff validates the source/scenario. GET /api/v1/me/journeys returns minimal owned resume summaries, limit 1–50, default 20, with owner-bound cursors. GET /api/v1/journeys/{id} returns the same safe 404 for missing and foreign IDs. Reload/new session recomputes allowed actions from authoritative domain state.
A server-validated domain transition, required transaction audit, journey projection and journey step event share one PostgreSQL unit of work through public interfaces. Unique (journey_id, sequence) and (journey_id, causation_id, event_code) prevent duplicate advancement. Transaction audit references actual payment/journal/adjustment/submission/renewal effects, retains failed/unknown/reconciled observations and appends corrections. Browser clicks and client timestamps never prove or order these effects.
POST /api/v1/analytics/events accepts one event or at most ten per batch, maximum 8 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Schema 1 permits only event_id, pseudonymous_session_id, validated_journey_id when ownership permits, event_name PAGE_VIEW or CONTROL_CLICK, allowlisted page_id/step_code/target_id, optional bounded duration/client time and policy metadata. No arbitrary properties, forms, health answers, amounts, email, tokens, raw URLs/referrers or DOM text. Server receive time is authoritative for receipt only. Exact event-ID replay is DUPLICATE; changed payload conflicts 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT. Invalid schema is 400, oversized body 413, rate limit 429. A 202 receipt is RECEIVED, DUPLICATE or DISCARDED_BY_POLICY and says nothing about business success. Browser queue is capped at twenty events and three attempts; loss/drop/reordering is allowed and cannot block checkout or owned resume. Policy-disabled clients emit nothing; defensive arrivals are discarded without persisted payload. Retention/purpose/consent rules are configurable; no third-party destination or indefinite storage is assumed.
Selected synthetic consumer payloads use the prepared maintained AEAD/envelope port, proposed AES-256-GCM with a 12-byte IV and 128-bit tag. Owner checks precede decrypt. AAD binds immutable opaque object ID plus object revision, payload kind and encryption schema version; it is not secret and never enters logs/analytics. Store ciphertext and wrapped data key, never plaintext fallback or wrapping key in the database/browser/repository. IV uniqueness is required under each data key outside fixed test-vector mode. Rotation preserves business IDs/content and has its own envelope revision. In-memory test keys prove only their process lifetime; restart/restore recovery is BLOCKED without a prepared authorized retained teaching-key mechanism. Missing key is KEY_UNAVAILABLE, not empty data or recovery success. Field encryption does not prove deployment TLS, encrypted volumes/backups or legal compliance; those remain explicit configuration/evidence gates. No real key creation, KMS grant, credential or security-setting mutation is authorized.
These additions replace existing seam work; they do not add minutes. The exact new interfaces and fixtures are teaching proposals, distinct from recovered ECOS rules.
Preserve ApplicationRevision's recovered composite key: journey (application_id, application_revision) references ApplicationRevision (application_id, revision). Do not add a revision UUID or mutable plaintext journey copy. Initial journey statuses are ACTIVE, WAITING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED and EXPIRED. Current steps use the shared registry, including FINAL_REVIEW rather than an invented REVIEW step. The analytics allowlist uses lower-case page and control IDs from the versioned registry. PAGE_VIEW requires target_id absent. optional_duration_ms is an integer from 0 through 300000, with booleans invalid; client_time is absent or a valid aware timestamp, never authoritative order.
A pending operation reference is durable before an external mock call. A definite provider failure is committed with its FAILED state and audit observation in the result transaction. If that transaction rolls back, its audit row also rolls back; the prior pending/unknown reference remains for reconciliation. Never fabricate a definite outcome or claim a rolled-back audit row persisted.
Every model/isolated experiment is a bounded CoverStory module or engineering-evidence seam in the same capstone, feeding its actual ADR/release gate. It is not a detached toy project. Frontend exercises show component/state ownership, contract/data flow, route/reload/resume behavior, accessibility, safe errors and tests. Operating exercises show configuration/key boundaries, CI/rollback, SLO/failure, backups, capacity/cost evidence and ownership at the scope actually exercised.
Latest frontend teaching stack: TanStack React Query v5 owns server state and its in-memory cache. Form edits and router/UI state remain separate; no duplicate global store for fetched journey/application/quote data. SPA refresh uses session/bootstrap plus authenticated refetch and server-valid journey resume, not an assumed SSR hydration path. Query keys include bounded resource/version and owner/session scope; never put consumer answers or raw tokens in keys. Sensitive server-state cache is not persisted to browser storage. Cancel and clear owner-scoped queries on logout, expiry or owner change; late responses cannot repopulate a new session. Guard mutations with current domain/journey versions and exact accepted terms, then invalidate/refetch the affected server state. Cached data never authorizes payment, dispatch or issuance.
Shared UI uses parameterized accessible primitives and feature compositions, with Tailwind design tokens and finite typed variants. Avoid arbitrary dynamically constructed class names or a separate per-screen styling system. Use verified open-source Inter with system-ui fallback and readable hierarchy/spacing; Proxima Nova is no longer a dependency or licensing gate. Query, Tailwind and font packages are planned until the current repository and instructor scaffold are inspected. These changes replace the same frontend-state/design tasks and add no minutes.
Frontend stack details: one stable QueryClient at the app boundary; each domain owns typed key/options factories and query hooks. Shared primitives do not fetch from other domains. Preserve URL/deep-link filters. Set finite staleTime, gcTime and retry for each data class; 401/403/validation errors do not loop and writes have no blanket retry. Background refetch must not overwrite unsaved local form input. Optional persistence is restricted to a separately supplied synthetic public-reference experiment with a version buster and finite maxAge/gcTime; private caches and queued mutations remain excluded. No Next.js, TanStack Start or SSR is added.
Use Inter source and SIL Open Font License, retaining copyright/OFL with any later distributed assets. Font-display swap and observed fallback/layout-shift checks belong to the bounded design task. Shared paths are frontend/src/coverstory/shared/ui/, shared/theme/ and shared/query/. Tailwind official pages currently describe v4 @theme; inspect the actual installed major and do not upgrade silently.

Proposed canonical API v1 reconciliation, pending instructor review:
Use /api/v1 and catalog spelling. Recovered ECOS-19 contains both /api/v1/... and later /api/.../catalogue routes, and requestId versus correlationId errors. Map these explicitly in a versioned teaching adapter; no aliases, route implementation or compatibility are assumed. Canonical safe error is {code, message, fieldErrors, requestId, retryable}. Later correlationId is mapped to requestId without copying unsafe body text. Expected version and reviewed revision remain distinct.
The proposed acceptance record binds applicationId, expectedVersion, reviewedRevision, ratingRevision, quoteId, scenarioHash, configurationHash, sourceVersion, ruleVersion, termsHash, totalMinor, currency and consent to the authenticated owner. Exact field names/available DTOs must be reconciled at preflight; client owner/amount is never authority. The later source's SUBMISSION_PENDING/dispatch-evidence boundary supersedes the earlier shorthand that returned SUBMITTED immediately on submit. These are proposed teaching interfaces, not claims about existing endpoints.

### Concrete proposed inputs and output

Use the exact actual candidate identity: code, schema, source bundle, dataset, gate policy and frontend build. Eight mandatory evidence classes are customer journey; ownership and revoked-session denial; dispatch/effect/cache correctness; bounded capacity and telemetry; AI receipt integrity and sliced quality; compatible restore; React diagnostic lifecycle; and fresh code-change/review evidence. Smoke permits at most 20 requests, two clients and 60 seconds. Audit at most five historical claims. An actual target job description is optional. Within customer-journey and ownership classes, require SPA bootstrap/refetch resume, zero sensitive persisted cache, durable transaction/journey history, policy-respecting lossy analytics and encrypted-payload access/rotation/recovery evidence. Technical deployment TLS/storage/key claims remain NOT_RUN unless actually verified; no local encryption test can silently satisfy them.

Output: FinalReadinessGate produces the task-specific state and case outcomes below, plus docs/evidence/coverstory/CAP-235/result.json. The receipt includes state, candidateIdentity, cases, mode, measurements, newBoundaryTest, architectureDeltaRef, history. All expected examples are proposed tests, not observed runs.

### Learner TODO

- Complete the final dated gate on existing candidate-bound evidence and run only the prepared bounded smoke; do not implement missing product features on the final day.
- Write the expected output for one changed/boundary input before implementing the single prepared TODO seam. Preserve the fixed positive and negative cases.
- Run the fixed acceptance cases and added boundary test, inspect the relevant real state or controlled observation, and write the actual evidence receipt. Keep a truthful blocker if setup or timebox fails.
- Use the existing 15-minute canonical Top Interview 150 retention slot for due reviews in saved order. Preserve original attempt/solve history; Java/DSA objectives assigned inside the practical task are not silently removed.

### Fixed acceptance cases

CAP-235-CS-01. Given: All eight current classes pass with no critical hold and all claims supported
Expected: Issue a dated 29 May 2027 RELEASE_REVIEW_ELIGIBLE decision for the demonstrated local product scope; deployment, real payment and insurer communication actions remain zero.
State: PROPOSED_EXPECTATION_NOT_OBSERVED. Fresh named fixture state, counters and fixed clock per case unless an explicit sequence is stated.

CAP-235-CS-02. Given: Any class fails, is not run, belongs to another candidate or has incompatible restore evidence
Expected: Record HOLD with exact reasons; seven of eight is insufficient and calendar completion is not evidence.
State: PROPOSED_EXPECTATION_NOT_OBSERVED. Fresh named fixture state, counters and fixed clock per case unless an explicit sequence is stated.

CAP-235-CS-03. Given: The 14 April CAP-38 checkpoint held but current evidence passes
Expected: Keep the original dated HOLD and issue a new decision linked to resolving evidence; do not backdate readiness.
State: PROPOSED_EXPECTATION_NOT_OBSERVED. Fresh named fixture state, counters and fixed clock per case unless an explicit sequence is stated.

CAP-235-CS-04. Given: Technical evidence passes but no actual job description is available
Expected: Record TARGET_ALIGNMENT_UNVERIFIED and exactly one evidence-backed next gap with a proposed success test; no job application, exam purchase or automatic schedule extension.
State: PROPOSED_EXPECTATION_NOT_OBSERVED. Fresh named fixture state, counters and fixed clock per case unless an explicit sequence is stated.

CAP-235-CS-05. Given: Analytics reports payment success but server payment/audit state is UNKNOWN, or encryption key is unavailable after process restart
Expected: Keep the authoritative unknown/reconciliation state and HOLD the applicable readiness class. Browser observations never create a paid state; missing key is KEY_UNAVAILABLE, not a successful empty restore.
State: PROPOSED_EXPECTATION_NOT_OBSERVED. Fresh named fixture state, counters and fixed clock per case unless an explicit sequence is stated.

### Planned instructor scaffold

Instructor ownership: supply typed DTOs and public-port signatures, exact synthetic inputs and visible fixed acceptance fixtures, fake Clock/deterministic scheduler, isolated PostgreSQL wiring where durability matters, read-only mock/model ports, safe fixture reset and an evidence serializer. Reuse inspected test wiring; setup smoke must pass independently of learner TODOs. Supply one named TODO seam, not a completed learner algorithm, SQL solution or hidden implementation. Independently derive the expected outputs and run a private solvability witness, keeping that solution out of learner files. Missing or contradictory fixtures mean HOLD_READINESS. Do not silently weaken tests.
Learner boundary: inspect the prepared contract, implement or test only the named seam, run all fixed cases and one learner-chosen boundary case whose expected result is written first, and retain actual PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN evidence. Reading-only completion is insufficient. At most two implementation files plus focused tests may change; preflight must reduce optional breadth explicitly if that does not fit. No after-hours catch-up or extra study block.

- implementation: src/main/java/capstone/coverstory/application/FinalReadinessGate.java
- test: src/test/java/capstone/coverstory/application/FinalReadinessGateTest.java
- fixtures: src/test/resources/coverstory/late-v1/CAP-235/cases.json

# Day 348 · 26 Sep 2027 — Cancel one slow query without poisoning the pool (150m)

## Tangible learner task

## What deepens prior learning

All contention schedules use at most 8 sessions, 600 requests and 180 seconds total.

- Foreign context is denied before decrypt and reveals no private rows.

- A preflighted approved disposable local environment and the actual existing public module contracts.
- The exact synthetic input/fault fixture above, with mechanical data loading and explicit safety limits.
- Written acceptance constraints and review; no implementation solution or step-by-step fault diagnosis.

Learner owns:
- Author and execute fresh ownership, generation and boundary cases for the learner's final filter implementation.
- The necessary bounded implementation/query/model or diagnostic commands and at least one meaningful adversarial test.
- The explanation, evidence and assistance record; scaffold conformance alone is not independent mastery.

## Dependencies and readiness

Earlier references: P2-361

Actual repository paths, commands, installed versions, fixture/oracle readiness and timing must be verified by the implementation owner. A correct/defective oracle self-check and in-budget rehearsal are prerequisites. Missing setup is BLOCKED_NOT_READY, never hidden learner overtime.

- OWASP and PostgreSQL documentation — Authorization tests and consistency. Refresh official section against the installed version before assignment; no dependency upgrade implied.

- 10m: Read the focused installed-version reference and inspect the pinned contract
- 15m: State the hypothesis or design and select exact expected observations
- 35m: Author the bounded implementation, query, model or diagnostic experiment independently
- 25m: Execute normal and adversarial checks; compare actual with expected
- 10m: Record candidate-bound evidence, assistance and unresolved limitations

AWS: Evidence-based architecture trade-offs across security, reliability, performance, operation and cost. Topic: Least privilege, key availability and separation of public/private data. Scenario: Using this day’s exact synthetic inputs for challenge the final variation adversarially, explain one relevant cloud design option and its failure/correctness boundary; justify keeping the local modular-monolith baseline when the extra service is unnecessary. Answer the day’s design prompt with a matching current official reference. Use 10m official reading, 15m scenario/questions and 5m error-log review. Refresh the actual current official guide, accessible course version and learner history before assigning a lesson. No future exact lesson/exam version is invented and no exam is booked.

DSA: continue the existing canonical Top Interview 150 history/order. Use the 15m next allowed problem or due retention exercise; log an honest attempt, and mark solved only with its actual evidence. Longer interview tasks in this primary do not replace or double-count this separate minimum.

Which edge case most threatens correctness rather than convenience?

Cases:foreignprivatecontext, sourcegeneration 8→9 between pages, page size 0, emptyvalidfilterresult. No hidden implementation solution is supplied.

Complete only this named seam/experiment. Do not add evening work, new infrastructure or missing adjacent features.

Actual candidate/data/environment identifiers, verified command, expected/actual observations, failure/repair, assistance received and limitations. Distinguish simulated, fixture-only and actual runtime evidence. Do not label copied/generated implementation as independently authored.

Synthetic/mock provider operations only. UUIDs do not authorize access. Preserve exact accepted revisions, immutable money effects, atomic required domain/audit/journey changes, separate lossy analytics, memory-only private browser cache and authorized key availability.
